"""Read-only database queries for the shopper-facing API."""

from db import get_connection

from datetime import datetime, timezone


def get_product(barcode: str) -> dict | None:
    """Return core product data with optional enrichment fields."""
    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    p.item_code,
                    p.name,
                    p.manufacturer,
                    p.manufacturer_country,
                    p.item_type,
                    pe.local_name,
                    pe.name_he,
                    pe.name_en,
                    pe.brand_he,
                    pe.brand_en,
                    pe.family_he,
                    pe.family_en,
                    pe.department_he,
                    pe.category_he,
                    pe.subcategory_he,
                    pe.description_he,
                    pe.description_en,
                    pe.ingredients_he,
                    pe.ingredients_en
                FROM products AS p
                LEFT JOIN product_enrichment AS pe
                    ON pe.item_code = p.item_code
                WHERE p.item_code = %s
                """,
                (barcode,),
            )

            row = cur.fetchone()
            if row is None:
                return None

            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            return dict(zip(columns, row))


def get_prices(barcode: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Return current prices and store details for an enriched product."""
    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    p.item_code,
                    p.chain_id,
                    p.store_id,
                    c.name_he_normalized AS chain_name_he,
                    c.name_en_normalized AS chain_name_en,
                    c.brands,
                    s.store_name,
                    s.address,
                    s.city,
                    s.latitude,
                    s.longitude,
                    p.price,
                    p.unit_price,
                    p.quantity,
                    p.unit_qty,
                    p.unit_measure,
                    p.weighted,
                    p.package_quantity,
                    p.allow_discount,
                    p.status,
                    p.price_update_time,
                    p.last_sale_datetime,
                    p.updated_at
                FROM prices AS p
                JOIN stores AS s
                    ON s.chain_id = p.chain_id
                   AND s.store_id = p.store_id
                JOIN chains AS c
                    ON c.chain_id = p.chain_id
                WHERE p.item_code = %s
                ORDER BY p.price ASC NULLS LAST, p.chain_id, p.store_id
                """,
                (barcode,),
            )

            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cur.fetchall()]



def get_prices_for_products(item_codes: list[str]) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
    """Return current prices grouped by product barcode in one query."""
    if not item_codes:
        return {}

    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    p.item_code,
                    p.chain_id,
                    p.store_id,
                    p.price
                FROM prices AS p
                WHERE p.item_code = ANY(%s)
                  AND p.price > 0
                ORDER BY
                    p.item_code,
                    p.price ASC,
                    p.chain_id,
                    p.store_id
                """,
                (item_codes,),
            )

            prices_by_item: dict[str, list[dict]] = {
                item_code: [] for item_code in item_codes
            }

            for item_code, chain_id, store_id, price in cur.fetchall():
                prices_by_item[item_code].append(
                    {
                        "item_code": item_code,
                        "chain_id": chain_id,
                        "store_id": store_id,
                        "price": price,
                    }
                )

            return prices_by_item



def get_promotions(barcode: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Return currently valid promotions for a product barcode."""
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    pi.item_code,
                    p.chain_id,
                    p.promotion_id,
                    p.store_id,
                    c.name_he_normalized AS chain_name_he,
                    c.name_en_normalized AS chain_name_en,
                    c.brands,
                    s.store_name,
                    s.address,
                    s.city,
                    p.description,
                    p.start_datetime,
                    p.end_datetime,
                    p.club_id,
                    p.additional_is_coupon,
                    p.allow_multiple_discounts,
                    p.additional_restrictions,
                    p.remarks,
                    pg.group_id,
                    pg.min_purchase_amount,
                    pg.discount_type,
                    pi.min_qty,
                    pi.max_qty,
                    pi.discount_rate,
                    pi.discounted_price,
                    pi.discounted_price_per_mida,
                    pi.is_weighted
                FROM promotion_items AS pi
                JOIN promotion_groups AS pg
                    ON pg.chain_id = pi.chain_id
                   AND pg.promotion_id = pi.promotion_id
                   AND pg.store_id = pi.store_id
                   AND pg.group_id = pi.group_id
                JOIN promotions AS p
                    ON p.chain_id = pi.chain_id
                   AND p.promotion_id = pi.promotion_id
                   AND p.store_id = pi.store_id
                JOIN stores AS s
                    ON s.chain_id = p.chain_id
                   AND s.store_id = p.store_id
                JOIN chains AS c
                    ON c.chain_id = p.chain_id
                WHERE pi.item_code = %s
                  AND (p.start_datetime IS NULL OR p.start_datetime <= %s)
                  AND (p.end_datetime IS NULL OR p.end_datetime >= %s)
                ORDER BY p.end_datetime NULLS LAST, p.chain_id, p.store_id
                """,
                (barcode, now, now),
            )

            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cur.fetchall()]


def get_enrichment(barcode: str) -> dict | None:
    """Return product enrichment and normalized nutrition, or None."""
    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT *
                FROM product_enrichment
                WHERE item_code = %s
                """,
                (barcode,),
            )
            row = cur.fetchone()

            if row is None:
                return None

            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            enrichment = dict(zip(columns, row))

            for field in ("category_path_he", "category_path_en"):
                if enrichment.get(field) is not None:
                    enrichment[field] = [
                        value
                        for value in enrichment[field]
                        if value is not None
                    ]

            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    source,
                    raw_label,
                    nutrient,
                    amount,
                    unit,
                    bound,
                    basis,
                    basis_raw,
                    flags,
                    is_canonical
                FROM product_nutrition
                WHERE item_code = %s
                ORDER BY source, basis, nutrient NULLS LAST, raw_label
                """,
                (barcode,),
            )
            nutrition_columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            enrichment["nutrition"] = [
                dict(zip(nutrition_columns, nutrition_row))
                for nutrition_row in cur.fetchall()
            ]

            return enrichment


def search(
    q: str,
    limit: int = 20,
    offset: int = 0,
) -> dict:
    """Search enriched products by barcode or Hebrew/English product name."""
    q = q.strip()

    if not q:
        return {"items": [], "total": 0, "limit": limit, "offset": offset}

    if limit < 1 or limit > 100:
        raise ValueError("limit must be between 1 and 100")
    if offset < 0:
        raise ValueError("offset must be non-negative")

    escaped_q = q.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")
    pattern = f"%{escaped_q}%"


    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM product_enrichment
                WHERE item_code ILIKE %s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
                   OR name_he ILIKE %s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
                   OR name_en ILIKE %s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
                """,
                (pattern, pattern, pattern),
            )
            total = cur.fetchone()[0]


            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    item_code,
                    name_he,
                    name_en,
                    brand_he,
                    brand_en,
                    category_he,
                    subcategory_he
                FROM product_enrichment
                WHERE item_code ILIKE %s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
                   OR name_he ILIKE %s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
                   OR name_en ILIKE %s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN item_code = %s THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                    name_he NULLS LAST,
                    item_code
                LIMIT %s OFFSET %s
                """,
                (pattern, pattern, pattern, q, limit, offset),
            )

            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            items = [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cur.fetchall()]

    return {
        "items": items,
        "total": total,
        "limit": limit,
        "offset": offset,
    }

def get_store_product_categories() -> list[dict]:
    """Return store-product categories in display order with product counts."""
    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    c.id,
                    c.name,
                    c.sort_order,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT m.item_code) AS count
                FROM store_product_categories AS c
                LEFT JOIN store_product_category_matches AS m
                    ON m.category_id = c.id
                GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.sort_order
                ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.name
                """
            )
            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cur.fetchall()]


def get_store_product_subcategories(
    category_id: int | None = None,
) -> list[dict]:
    """Return store-product subcategories with product counts."""
    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    sc.id,
                    sc.category_id,
                    c.name AS category,
                    sc.name,
                    sc.sort_order,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT (m.chain_id, m.store_id, m.item_code)) AS count
                FROM store_product_subcategories AS sc
                JOIN store_product_categories AS c
                    ON c.id = sc.category_id
                LEFT JOIN store_product_category_matches AS m
                    ON m.subcategory_id = sc.id
                WHERE (%s::SMALLINT IS NULL OR sc.category_id = %s::SMALLINT)
                GROUP BY
                    sc.id,
                    sc.category_id,
                    c.name,
                    sc.name,
                    sc.sort_order,
                    c.sort_order
                ORDER BY c.sort_order, sc.sort_order, sc.name
                """,
                (category_id, category_id),
            )
            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cur.fetchall()]





def get_store_products_by_subcategory(
    subcategory_id: int,
    limit: int = 20,
    offset: int = 0,
) -> dict:
    """Return distinct fresh products with store counts and best prices."""
    if not 1 <= limit <= 100:
        raise ValueError("limit must be between 1 and 100")
    if offset < 0:
        raise ValueError("offset must be non-negative")

    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                WITH matched AS (
                    SELECT
                        m.product_name,
                        m.chain_id,
                        m.store_id,
                        m.item_code,
                        p.price,
                        (
                            SELECT MIN(pi.discounted_price)
                            FROM promotion_items AS pi
                            JOIN promotions AS promo
                              ON promo.chain_id = pi.chain_id
                             AND promo.promotion_id = pi.promotion_id
                             AND promo.store_id = pi.store_id
                            WHERE pi.chain_id = m.chain_id
                              AND pi.store_id = m.store_id
                              AND pi.item_code = m.item_code
                              AND pi.discounted_price > 0
                              AND (
                                  promo.start_datetime IS NULL
                                  OR promo.start_datetime <= NOW()
                              )
                              AND (
                                  promo.end_datetime IS NULL
                                  OR promo.end_datetime >= NOW()
                              )
                        ) AS promo_price
                    FROM store_product_category_matches AS m
                    LEFT JOIN prices AS p
                      ON p.chain_id = m.chain_id
                     AND p.store_id = m.store_id
                     AND p.item_code = m.item_code
                    WHERE m.subcategory_id = %s
                ),
                grouped AS (
                    SELECT
                        product_name,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT (chain_id, store_id)) AS store_count,
                        MIN(price) FILTER (
                            WHERE price > 0
                        ) AS lowest_price,
                        MIN(promo_price) FILTER (
                            WHERE promo_price > 0
                        ) AS cheapest_promotion
                    FROM matched
                    GROUP BY product_name
                )
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grouped
                """,
                (subcategory_id,),
            )
            total = cur.fetchone()[0]

            cur.execute(
                """
                WITH matched AS (
                    SELECT
                        m.product_name,
                        m.chain_id,
                        m.store_id,
                        m.item_code,
                        p.price,
                        (
                            SELECT MIN(pi.discounted_price)
                            FROM promotion_items AS pi
                            JOIN promotions AS promo
                              ON promo.chain_id = pi.chain_id
                             AND promo.promotion_id = pi.promotion_id
                             AND promo.store_id = pi.store_id
                            WHERE pi.chain_id = m.chain_id
                              AND pi.store_id = m.store_id
                              AND pi.item_code = m.item_code
                              AND pi.discounted_price > 0
                              AND (
                                  promo.start_datetime IS NULL
                                  OR promo.start_datetime <= NOW()
                              )
                              AND (
                                  promo.end_datetime IS NULL
                                  OR promo.end_datetime >= NOW()
                              )
                        ) AS promo_price
                    FROM store_product_category_matches AS m
                    LEFT JOIN prices AS p
                      ON p.chain_id = m.chain_id
                     AND p.store_id = m.store_id
                     AND p.item_code = m.item_code
                    WHERE m.subcategory_id = %s
                )
                SELECT
                    product_name,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT (chain_id, store_id)) AS store_count,
                    MIN(price) FILTER (
                        WHERE price > 0
                    ) AS lowest_price,
                    MIN(promo_price) FILTER (
                        WHERE promo_price > 0
                    ) AS cheapest_promotion
                FROM matched
                GROUP BY product_name
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN MIN(price) FILTER (
                        WHERE price > 0
                    ) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                    MIN(price) FILTER (
                        WHERE price > 0
                    ) ASC,
                    product_name ASC
                LIMIT %s OFFSET %s
                """,
                (subcategory_id, limit, offset),
            )

            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            items = [
                dict(zip(columns, row))
                for row in cur.fetchall()
            ]

    return {
        "items": items,
        "total": total,
        "limit": limit,
        "offset": offset,
    }


def search_store_products(
    q: str,
    limit: int = 20,
    offset: int = 0,
) -> dict:
    """Search unbarcoded store products by name or item code."""
    if not 1 <= limit <= 100:
        raise ValueError("limit must be between 1 and 100")
    if offset < 0:
        raise ValueError("offset must be non-negative")

    q = q.strip()
    if not q:
        return {
            "items": [],
            "total": 0,
            "limit": limit,
            "offset": offset,
        }

    escaped_q = q.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")
    pattern = f"%{escaped_q}%"

    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM store_products
                WHERE name ILIKE %s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
                   OR item_code ILIKE %s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
                """,
                (pattern, pattern),
            )
            total = cur.fetchone()[0]

            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    sp.chain_id,
                    sp.store_id,
                    sp.item_code,
                    sp.name AS product_name,
                    c.name_he_normalized AS chain_name_he,
                    c.name_en_normalized AS chain_name_en,
                    c.brands,
                    s.store_name,
                    s.address,
                    s.city,
                    s.latitude,
                    s.longitude
                FROM store_products AS sp
                JOIN chains AS c
                    ON c.chain_id = sp.chain_id
                JOIN stores AS s
                    ON s.chain_id = sp.chain_id
                   AND s.store_id = sp.store_id
                WHERE sp.name ILIKE %s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
                   OR sp.item_code ILIKE %s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN sp.name ILIKE %s ESCAPE E'\\\\' THEN 0
                        ELSE 1
                    END,
                    sp.name,
                    sp.chain_id,
                    sp.store_id,
                    sp.item_code
                LIMIT %s OFFSET %s
                """,
                (
                    pattern,
                    pattern,
                    pattern,
                    limit,
                    offset,
                ),
            )
            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            items = [
                dict(zip(columns, row))
                for row in cur.fetchall()
            ]

    return {
        "items": items,
        "total": total,
        "limit": limit,
        "offset": offset,
    }

def get_packaged_product_categories() -> list[dict]:
    """Return packaged-product categories, excluding store products."""
    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    pe.category_he AS name,
                    COUNT(*) AS count,
                    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT pe.subcategory_he ORDER BY pe.subcategory_he)
                        FILTER (
                            WHERE pe.subcategory_he IS NOT NULL
                              AND BTRIM(pe.subcategory_he) <> ''
                        ) AS subcategories
                FROM product_enrichment AS pe
                WHERE pe.category_he IS NOT NULL
                  AND BTRIM(pe.category_he) <> ''
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM products AS p
                      WHERE p.item_code = pe.item_code
                  )
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM store_products AS sp
                      WHERE sp.item_code = pe.item_code
                  )
                GROUP BY pe.category_he
                ORDER BY pe.category_he
                """
            )
            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cur.fetchall()]


def get_fresh_product_detail(
    product_name: str,
    subcategory_id: int,
) -> list[dict]:
    """Return a fresh product's store prices and all active promotions."""
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    m.chain_id,
                    m.store_id,
                    m.item_code,
                    m.product_name,
                    m.category_id,
                    m.category,
                    m.subcategory_id,
                    m.subcategory,
                    c.name_he_normalized AS chain_name_he,
                    c.name_en_normalized AS chain_name_en,
                    c.brands,
                    s.store_name,
                    s.address,
                    s.city,
                    s.latitude,
                    s.longitude,
                    p.price,
                    p.unit_price,
                    COALESCE(
                        (
                            SELECT jsonb_agg(
                                jsonb_build_object(
                                    'promotion_id', promo.promotion_id,
                                    'description', promo.description,
                                    'discounted_price', pi.discounted_price,
                                    'discount_rate', pi.discount_rate,
                                    'min_qty', pi.min_qty,
                                    'max_qty', pi.max_qty,
                                    'group_id', pi.group_id,
                                    'club_id', promo.club_id,
                                    'start_datetime', promo.start_datetime,
                                    'end_datetime', promo.end_datetime
                                )
                                ORDER BY pi.discounted_price ASC NULLS LAST
                            )
                            FROM promotion_items pi
                            JOIN promotions promo
                              ON promo.chain_id = pi.chain_id
                             AND promo.store_id = pi.store_id
                             AND promo.promotion_id = pi.promotion_id
                            WHERE pi.chain_id = m.chain_id
                              AND pi.store_id = m.store_id
                              AND pi.item_code = m.item_code
                              AND pi.discounted_price > 0
                              AND (
                                  promo.start_datetime IS NULL
                                  OR promo.start_datetime <= %s
                              )
                              AND (
                                  promo.end_datetime IS NULL
                                  OR promo.end_datetime >= %s
                              )
                        ),
                        '[]'::jsonb
                    ) AS promotions
                FROM store_product_category_matches m
                JOIN chains c
                  ON c.chain_id = m.chain_id
                JOIN stores s
                  ON s.chain_id = m.chain_id
                 AND s.store_id = m.store_id
                LEFT JOIN prices p
                  ON p.chain_id = m.chain_id
                 AND p.store_id = m.store_id
                 AND p.item_code = m.item_code
                WHERE m.product_name = %s
                  AND m.subcategory_id = %s
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN p.price > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                    p.price ASC NULLS LAST,
                    c.name_he_normalized NULLS LAST,
                    s.store_name NULLS LAST,
                    m.chain_id,
                    m.store_id
                """,
                (now, now, product_name, subcategory_id),
            )

            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            return [
                dict(zip(columns, row))
                for row in cur.fetchall()
            ]



def get_packaged_products_by_category(
    category: str,
    limit: int = 40,
    offset: int = 0,
) -> dict:
    """Return packaged products in a category, excluding store products."""
    if not 1 <= limit <= 100:
        raise ValueError("limit must be between 1 and 100")
    if offset < 0:
        raise ValueError("offset must be non-negative")

    category = category.strip()
    if not category:
        return {"items": [], "total": 0, "limit": limit, "offset": offset}

    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM product_enrichment AS pe
                WHERE pe.category_he = %s
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM products AS p
                      WHERE p.item_code = pe.item_code
                  )
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM store_products AS sp
                      WHERE sp.item_code = pe.item_code
                  )
                """,
                (category,),
            )
            total = cur.fetchone()[0]

            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    pe.item_code,
                    pe.name_he,
                    pe.name_en,
                    pe.brand_he,
                    pe.brand_en,
                    pe.category_he,
                    pe.subcategory_he
                FROM product_enrichment AS pe
                WHERE pe.category_he = %s
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM products AS p
                      WHERE p.item_code = pe.item_code
                  )
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM store_products AS sp
                      WHERE sp.item_code = pe.item_code
                  )
                ORDER BY pe.name_he NULLS LAST, pe.item_code
                LIMIT %s OFFSET %s
                """,
                (category, limit, offset),
            )
            columns = [column.name for column in cur.description]
            items = [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cur.fetchall()]

    return {"items": items, "total": total, "limit": limit, "offset": offset}

_UNENRICHED_FROM = """
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM product_enrichment AS pe WHERE pe.item_code = p.item_code
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM store_products AS sp WHERE sp.item_code = p.item_code
    )
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM prices AS pr WHERE pr.item_code = p.item_code
    )
"""


def _query_unenriched(
    extra_where: str,
    params: dict,
    limit: int,
    offset: int,
) -> dict:
    """Shared count + page query for products without enrichment."""
    if not 1 <= limit <= 100:
        raise ValueError("limit must be between 1 and 100")
    if offset < 0:
        raise ValueError("offset must be non-negative")

    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) " + _UNENRICHED_FROM + extra_where,
                params,
            )
            total = cur.fetchone()[0]

            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    p.item_code,
                    p.name,
                    p.name AS name_he,      -- same key the enriched rows use
                    NULL::text AS name_en,
                    NULL::text AS brand_he,
                    NULL::text AS brand_en,
                    NULL::text AS category_he,
                    NULL::text AS subcategory_he
                """
                + _UNENRICHED_FROM
                + extra_where
                + """
                ORDER BY p.name NULLS LAST, p.item_code
                LIMIT %(limit)s OFFSET %(offset)s
                """,
                {**params, "limit": limit, "offset": offset},
            )
            columns = [c.name for c in cur.description]
            items = [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cur.fetchall()]

    return {"items": items, "total": total, "limit": limit, "offset": offset}


def get_unenriched_products(limit: int = 40, offset: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Browse products that have no enrichment row (no category known)."""
    return _query_unenriched("", {}, limit, offset)


def search_unenriched_products(
    q: str,
    limit: int = 20,
    offset: int = 0,
) -> dict:
    """Search products that have no enrichment row, by barcode or name."""
    q = q.strip()
    if not q:
        return {"items": [], "total": 0, "limit": limit, "offset": offset}

    escaped_q = q.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")

    return _query_unenriched(
        """
        AND (
            p.item_code ILIKE %(pat)s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
            OR p.name ILIKE %(pat)s ESCAPE E'\\\\'
        )
        """,
        {"pat": f"%{escaped_q}%"},
        limit,
        offset,
    )

def get_catalog_stats() -> dict:
    """Return the catalog statistics shown on the homepage."""
    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stores) AS total_stores,
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT brand)
                        FROM (
                            SELECT NULLIF(BTRIM(name_he_normalized), '') AS brand
                            FROM chains

                            UNION

                            SELECT NULLIF(BTRIM(b.brand), '') AS brand
                            FROM chains
                            CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(brands) AS b(brand)
                        ) AS all_brands
                        WHERE brand IS NOT NULL
                    ) AS total_brands,
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_name)
                        FROM store_product_category_matches
                    ) AS total_fresh_products
                """
            )
            row = cur.fetchone()

    return {
        "total_stores": row[0],
        "total_brands": row[1],
        "total_fresh_products": row[2],
    }

"""JSON API: everything the shopper UI does, without the HTML."""

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Path, Query

from api import queries, service
from api.schemas import (
    CatalogStats,
    FreshCategory,
    FreshProductDetail,
    FreshProductPage,
    FreshSubcategory,
    PackagedCategory,
    ProductDetail,
    ProductSearchPage,
    SearchResult,
    StoreProductSearchResult,
)
from api.service import get_product_detail

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1")

SMALLINT_MAX = 32767
INT_MAX = 2_147_483_647


# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Catalog
# ----------------------------------------------------------------

@router.get("/stats", response_model=CatalogStats, tags=["Catalog"])
def stats() -> dict:
    """Catalog totals shown on the homepage."""
    return queries.get_catalog_stats()


# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Packaged (barcoded) products
# ----------------------------------------------------------------

@router.get(
    "/categories/packaged",
    response_model=list[PackagedCategory],
    tags=["Packaged products"],
)
def packaged_categories() -> list[dict]:
    """Packaged-product categories with counts and their subcategories."""
    return queries.get_packaged_product_categories()


@router.get("/products", response_model=SearchResult, tags=["Packaged products"])
def products_by_category(
    category: str = Query(min_length=1, max_length=200),
    limit: int = Query(default=40, ge=1, le=100),
    offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0),
) -> dict:
    """Enriched packaged products in one category (by category name)."""
    return queries.get_packaged_products_by_category(
        category, limit=limit, offset=offset
    )


@router.get(
    "/products/search",
    response_model=ProductSearchPage,
    tags=["Packaged products"],
)
def search_products(
    q: str = Query(default="", max_length=200),
    limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
    offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0),
) -> dict:
    """Search enriched products; each hit has its cheapest price and store count."""
    result = service.search_products(q.strip(), limit=limit, offset=offset)
    return {
        "items": result["products"],
        "total": result["total"],
        "limit": result["limit"],
        "offset": result["offset"],
    }


@router.get(
    "/products/unenriched",
    response_model=SearchResult,
    tags=["Packaged products"],
)
def list_unenriched(
    q: str = Query(default="", max_length=200),
    limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
    offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0),
) -> dict:
    """Browse (no q) or search (q) products that have no enrichment data."""
    if q.strip():
        return queries.search_unenriched_products(q, limit=limit, offset=offset)
    return queries.get_unenriched_products(limit=limit, offset=offset)


# NOTE: must stay after /products/search and /products/unenriched.
@router.get(
    "/products/{barcode}",
    response_model=ProductDetail,
    tags=["Packaged products"],
)
def product_detail(barcode: str) -> ProductDetail:
    """Full detail for any barcode, enriched or not."""
    detail = get_product_detail(barcode)
    if detail is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Product not found")
    return detail

    response_model=list[FreshCategory],
    tags=["Fresh products"],

)
def fresh_subcategories(
    category_id: int = Path(ge=1, le=SMALLINT_MAX),

@router.get(
    "/fresh/products",
    response_model=FreshProductPage,
    tags=["Fresh products"],
)
def fresh_products(
    subcategory_id: int = Query(ge=1, le=INT_MAX),
    limit: int = Query(default=40, ge=1, le=100),

) -> dict:
    """Distinct fresh products in a subcategory, cheapest first."""

        subcategory_id, limit=limit, offset=offset
    )


@router.get(
    "/fresh/products/detail",
    response_model=FreshProductDetail,
    tags=["Fresh products"],
)
def fresh_product_detail(
    name: str = Query(min_length=1, max_length=300),
    subcategory_id: int = Query(ge=1, le=INT_MAX),
) -> FreshProductDetail:
    """A fresh product's price and active promotions in every store."""
    detail = service.get_fresh_product_detail(name, subcategory_id)
    if detail is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Fresh product not found")
    return detail

    "/fresh/search",
    response_model=StoreProductSearchResult,
    tags=["Fresh products"],

    q: str = Query(default="", max_length=200),
    limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
    offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0),

    return service.search_store_products(q, limit=limit, offset=offset)

"""HTML routes for the Metziah shopper interface."""

from pathlib import Path
import time
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, Request
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, HTMLResponse
from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates
from config import settings, APP_VERSION
from db import get_connection

from api.queries import (
    get_store_product_categories,
    get_fresh_product_detail,
    get_packaged_product_categories,
    get_packaged_products_by_category,
    get_store_product_subcategories,
    get_store_products_by_subcategory,
)
from api.service import get_product_detail, search_products

router = APIRouter()

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
IMAGES_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "data" / "images"
BRAND_IMAGES_DIR = IMAGES_DIR / "brands"
PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE = (
    Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "static" / "image-placeholder.svg"
)

templates = Jinja2Templates(
    directory=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "templates")
)
templates.env.policies["json.dumps_kwargs"]["ensure_ascii"] = False


_data_updated_cache: tuple[float, str] = (0.0, "—")


def get_data_updated() -> str:
    """Date of the latest loaded price file, cached for 5 minutes."""
    global _data_updated_cache
    ts, value = _data_updated_cache
    if time.monotonic() - ts < 300:
        return value
    try:
        with get_connection() as conn:
            with conn.cursor() as cur:
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT MAX(updated_at)::date FROM file_tracking "
                    "WHERE loaded AND file_type IN ('PriceFull', 'Price')"
                )
                row = cur.fetchone()
        value = row[0].isoformat() if row and row[0] else "—"
    except Exception:
        pass  # keep the last known value
    _data_updated_cache = (time.monotonic(), value)
    return value


templates.env.globals["app_version"] = f"{APP_VERSION}-{settings.ENV.upper()}"
templates.env.globals["data_updated"] = get_data_updated

def find_product_image(item_code: str) -> Path | None:
    """Find a product image using its item code."""
    if not item_code or not item_code.isascii() or not item_code.isalnum():
        return None

    candidate = IMAGES_DIR / "products" / f"{item_code}.jpg"
    
    return candidate if candidate.is_file() else None


def get_homepage_stats() -> dict[str, int]:
    """Return the catalog statistics displayed on the homepage."""
    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stores) AS total_stores,
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT brand)
                        FROM (
                            SELECT NULLIF(BTRIM(name_he_normalized), '') AS brand
                            FROM chains

                            UNION

                            SELECT NULLIF(BTRIM(b.brand), '') AS brand
                            FROM chains
                            CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(brands) AS b(brand)
                        ) AS all_brands
                        WHERE brand IS NOT NULL
                    ) AS total_brands,
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_name)
                        FROM store_product_category_matches
                    ) AS total_fresh_products
                """
            )
            row = cur.fetchone()

    return {
        "total_stores": row[0],
        "total_brands": row[1],
        "total_fresh_products": row[2],
    }


@router.get("/img/{item_code}", include_in_schema=False)
def product_image(item_code: str) -> FileResponse:
    """Serve a product image or a placeholder when none exists."""
    image_path = find_product_image(item_code)
    if image_path is not None:
        return FileResponse(image_path, media_type="image/jpeg")

    return FileResponse(PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE, media_type="image/svg+xml")


@router.get("/brand-logo/{brand_name}", include_in_schema=False)
def brand_logo(brand_name: str) -> FileResponse:
    """Serve a brand logo or the neutral image placeholder."""
    brand_name = brand_name.strip()

    if "\x00" in brand_name:
        return FileResponse(PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE, media_type="image/svg+xml")

    try:
        candidate = (BRAND_IMAGES_DIR / f"{brand_name}.jpg").resolve()

        if (
            candidate.parent == BRAND_IMAGES_DIR.resolve()
            and candidate.is_file()
        ):
            return FileResponse(candidate, media_type="image/jpeg")
    except (ValueError, OSError):
        pass

    return FileResponse(PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE, media_type="image/svg+xml")



@router.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse, include_in_schema=False)
def index(
    request: Request,
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
) -> HTMLResponse:
    """Render the shopper page and the selected category's products."""
    active_tab = request.query_params.get("tab", "")
    active_category = request.query_params.get("category", "")
    active_subcategory = request.query_params.get("subcategory", "")

    page_size = 40
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size

    subcategories = []
    fresh_products = []
    fresh_product_total = 0
    fresh_product_pages = 0

    if active_tab == "packaged":
        categories = get_packaged_product_categories()
    elif active_tab == "fresh":
        categories = get_store_product_categories()

        category_id = None
        subcategory_id = None

        try:
            if active_category:
                category_id = int(active_category)
            if active_subcategory:
                subcategory_id = int(active_subcategory)
        except ValueError:
            active_category = ""
            active_subcategory = ""
            category_id = None
            subcategory_id = None

        if category_id is not None:
            subcategories = get_store_product_subcategories(category_id)

        if subcategory_id is not None:
            valid_subcategory = any(
                int(subcategory["id"]) == subcategory_id
                for subcategory in subcategories
            )

            if valid_subcategory:
                result = get_store_products_by_subcategory(
                    subcategory_id,
                    limit=page_size,
                    offset=offset,
                )
                fresh_products = result["items"]
                fresh_product_total = result["total"]
                fresh_product_pages = (
                    fresh_product_total + page_size - 1
                ) // page_size
            else:
                active_subcategory = ""
    else:
        categories = []

    packaged_result = (
        get_packaged_products_by_category(
            active_category,
            limit=page_size,
            offset=offset,
        )
        if active_tab == "packaged" and active_category
        else {"items": [], "total": 0, "limit": page_size, "offset": offset}
    )

    packaged_product_pages = (
        packaged_result["total"] + page_size - 1
    ) // page_size

    stats = get_homepage_stats()

    return templates.TemplateResponse(
        request=request,
        name="index.html",
        context={
            **stats,
            "categories": categories,
            "active_tab": active_tab,
            "active_category": active_category,
            "products": packaged_result["items"],
            "product_total": packaged_result["total"],
            "product_pages": packaged_product_pages,
            "subcategories": subcategories,
            "active_subcategory": active_subcategory,
            "fresh_products": fresh_products,
            "fresh_product_total": fresh_product_total,
            "fresh_product_pages": fresh_product_pages,
            "page": page,
        },
    )



@router.get("/search", response_class=HTMLResponse, include_in_schema=False)
@router.get(
    "/partials/search-results",
    response_class=HTMLResponse,
    include_in_schema=False,
)
def search_results(
    request: Request,
    q: str = Query(default="", max_length=200),
) -> HTMLResponse:
    """Return HTML search results for HTMX."""
    query = q.strip()

    result = (
        search_products(query, limit=20, offset=0)
        if query
        else {"products": [], "total": 0, "limit": 20, "offset": 0}
    )

    return templates.TemplateResponse(
        request=request,
        name="partials/search_results.html",
        context={
            "products": result["products"],
            "total": result["total"],
            "query": query,
        },
    )


@router.get(
    "/product/{barcode}",
    response_class=HTMLResponse,
    include_in_schema=False,
)
def product_detail(request: Request, barcode: str) -> HTMLResponse:
    """Render packaged-product details, regular prices, and promotions."""
    detail = get_product_detail(barcode)

    if detail is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Product not found")

    product = detail.product
    enrichment = detail.enrichment

    sorted_prices = sorted(
        (
            price
            for price in detail.prices
            if price.price is not None and price.price > 0
        ),
        key=lambda price: price.price,
    )

    lowest_price = sorted_prices[0].price if sorted_prices else None

    prices_view = [
        {
            **price.model_dump(),
            "resolved_brand": price.shopper_brand or price.chain_name_he or "",
        }
        for price in sorted_prices
    ]

    promotions_view = [
        {
            **promo.model_dump(),
            "resolved_brand": promo.shopper_brand or promo.chain_name_he or "",
        }
        for promo in detail.promotions
        if promo.discounted_price is not None and promo.discounted_price > 0
    ]

    product_view = {
        "item_code": product.item_code,
        "name": (
            (enrichment.name_he if enrichment else None)
            or (enrichment.local_name if enrichment else None)
            or product.name_he
            or product.name_en
            or product.name
            or product.item_code
        ),
        "brand": (
            (enrichment.brand_he if enrichment else None)
            or product.brand_he
            or product.brand_en
        ),
        "category": (
            (enrichment.category_he if enrichment else None)
            or product.category_he
            or product.family_he
            or ""
        ),
        "subcategory": (
            (enrichment.subcategory_he if enrichment else None)
            or product.subcategory_he
            or ""
        ),
        "quantity": next(
            (p.get("quantity") for p in prices_view if p.get("quantity") is not None),
            None,
        ),
        "unit_qty": next(
            (p.get("unit_qty") for p in prices_view if p.get("unit_qty")),
            None,
        ),
        "manufacturer": product.manufacturer,
        "prices": prices_view,
        "promotions": promotions_view,
        "enrichment": enrichment,
    }

    return templates.TemplateResponse(
        request=request,
        name="product_detail.html",
        context={
            "product": product_view,
            "sorted_prices": prices_view,
            "lowest_price": lowest_price,
        },
    )


@router.get(
    "/fresh-product",
    response_class=HTMLResponse,
    include_in_schema=False,
)
def fresh_product_detail(
    request: Request,
    name: str = Query(min_length=1, max_length=300),
    subcategory_id: int = Query(gt=0),
) -> HTMLResponse:
    """Render a fresh product's prices and active promotions by store."""
    product_name = name.strip()

    if not product_name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Fresh product not found")

    stores = get_fresh_product_detail(
        product_name=product_name,
        subcategory_id=subcategory_id,
    )

    if not stores:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Fresh product not found")

    first_store = stores[0]

    valid_prices = [
        store["price"]
        for store in stores
        if store.get("price") is not None and store["price"] > 0
    ]
    lowest_price = min(valid_prices) if valid_prices else None

    promotions = [
        {
            **promotion,
            "store_name": store.get("store_name"),
            "chain_name_he": store.get("chain_name_he"),
        }
        for store in stores
        for promotion in (store.get("promotions") or [])
        if promotion.get("discounted_price") is not None
        and promotion["discounted_price"] > 0
    ]

    lowest_promotion = (
        min(promotions, key=lambda promotion: promotion["discounted_price"])
        if promotions
        else None
    )


    return templates.TemplateResponse(
        request=request,
        name="fresh_product_detail.html",
        context={
            "product_name": product_name,
            "category_id": first_store["category_id"],
            "subcategory_id": first_store["subcategory_id"],
            "category": first_store["category"],
            "subcategory": first_store["subcategory"],
            "stores": stores,
            "promotions": promotions,
            "lowest_price": lowest_price,
            "lowest_promotion": lowest_promotion,
        },
    )

"""Business logic for shopper-facing API responses."""

from api import queries
from api.schemas import (
    Price,
    Product,
    ProductDetail,
    ProductEnrichment,
    Promotion,
    StoreProduct,
    StoreProductCategory,
    StoreProductSearchResult,
    StoreProductSubcategory,
    FreshProductDetail,
    FreshStorePrice,
    FreshStorePromotion,
)

from utils.brand_resolution import resolve_shopper_brand

def get_product_detail(barcode: str) -> ProductDetail | None:
    """Combine product, price, promotion, and enrichment data."""
    product_data = queries.get_product(barcode)

    if product_data is None:
        return None

    prices = []
    for row in queries.get_prices(barcode):
        row = dict(row)

        # Exclude missing, zero, and negative regular prices.
        if row.get("price") is None or row["price"] <= 0:
            continue

        row["shopper_brand"] = resolve_shopper_brand(
            row.get("store_name"),
            row.get("brands"),
            row.get("chain_name_he"),
        )
        prices.append(Price.model_validate(row))

    promotions = []
    for row in queries.get_promotions(barcode):
        row = dict(row)

        discounted_price = row.get("discounted_price")
        if discounted_price is None or discounted_price <= 0:
            continue

        row["shopper_brand"] = resolve_shopper_brand(
            row.get("store_name"),
            row.get("brands"),
            row.get("chain_name_he"),
        )
        promotions.append(Promotion.model_validate(row))

    enrichment_data = queries.get_enrichment(barcode)

    return ProductDetail(
        product=Product.model_validate(product_data),
        prices=prices,
        promotions=promotions,
        enrichment=(
            ProductEnrichment.model_validate(enrichment_data)
            if enrichment_data is not None
            else None
        ),
    )



def search_products(
    q: str,
    limit: int = 20,
    offset: int = 0,
) -> dict:
    """Search products and prepare results for the shopper HTML template."""
    result = queries.search(q, limit=limit, offset=offset)
    products = []

    item_codes = [
        item["item_code"]
        for item in result["items"]
    ]
    prices_by_item = queries.get_prices_for_products(item_codes)

    for item in result["items"]:
        product = Product.model_validate(item)
        prices = prices_by_item.get(product.item_code, [])

        available_prices = [
            price["price"]
            for price in prices
            if price["price"] is not None and price["price"] > 0
        ]

        products.append(
            {
                "identifier": product.item_code,
                "brand": product.brand_he or product.brand_en,
                "category": (
                    product.category_he
                    or product.subcategory_he
                    or product.family_he
                    or ""
                ),
                "name": product.name_he or product.name_en or product.item_code,
                "min_price": min(available_prices) if available_prices else None,
                "store_count": len(
                    {
                        (price["chain_id"], price["store_id"])
                        for price in prices
                    }
                ),
            }
        )

    return {
        "products": products,
        "total": result["total"],
        "limit": result["limit"],
        "offset": result["offset"],
    }


def get_store_product_categories() -> list[StoreProductCategory]:
    """Return store-product categories in display order."""
    return [
        StoreProductCategory.model_validate(row)
        for row in queries.get_store_product_categories()
    ]


def get_store_product_subcategories(
    category_id: int | None = None,
) -> list[StoreProductSubcategory]:
    """Return subcategories, optionally filtered by category."""
    return [
        StoreProductSubcategory.model_validate(row)
        for row in queries.get_store_product_subcategories(category_id)
    ]



def search_store_products(
    q: str,
    limit: int = 20,
    offset: int = 0,
) -> StoreProductSearchResult:
    """Search store products and validate the paginated response."""
    result = queries.search_store_products(
        q,
        limit=limit,
        offset=offset,
    )

    items = []
    for row in result["items"]:
        row = dict(row)
        row["shopper_brand"] = resolve_shopper_brand(
            row.get("store_name"),
            row.get("brands"),
            row.get("chain_name_he"),
        )
        items.append(StoreProduct.model_validate(row))

    return StoreProductSearchResult(
        items=items,
        total=result["total"],
        limit=result["limit"],
        offset=result["offset"],
    )

def make_fresh_identifier(item_code: str) -> str:
    """Create an identifier for an enriched barcode product."""
    if not item_code or not item_code.strip() or ":" in item_code:
        raise ValueError("item_code must be non-empty and cannot contain ':'")

    return f"fresh:{item_code}"


def make_store_product_identifier(
    chain_id: str,
    store_id: str,
    item_code: str,
) -> str:
    """Create an identifier for a store-specific product."""
    parts = {
        "chain_id": chain_id,
        "store_id": store_id,
        "item_code": item_code,
    }

    for name, value in parts.items():
        if not value or not value.strip() or ":" in value:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{name} must be non-empty and cannot contain ':'"
            )

    return f"sp:{chain_id}:{store_id}:{item_code}"


def parse_product_identifier(identifier: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parse a fresh or store-product identifier."""
    if not identifier or not identifier.strip():
        raise ValueError("identifier must be non-empty")

    parts = identifier.split(":")

    if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0] == "fresh":
        item_code = parts[1]
        if not item_code.strip():
            raise ValueError("item_code must be non-empty")

        return {
            "type": "fresh",
            "item_code": item_code,
        }

    if len(parts) == 4 and parts[0] == "sp":
        _, chain_id, store_id, item_code = parts

        if not all(part.strip() for part in (chain_id, store_id, item_code)):
            raise ValueError(
                "chain_id, store_id, and item_code must be non-empty"
            )

        return {
            "type": "store_product",
            "chain_id": chain_id,
            "store_id": store_id,
            "item_code": item_code,
        }

    raise ValueError(f"Invalid product identifier: {identifier!r}")


def search_unenriched_products(q: str, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Search products without enrichment, shaped for the shopper template."""
    result = queries.search_unenriched_products(q, limit=limit, offset=offset)
    prices_by_item = queries.get_prices_for_products(
        [item["item_code"] for item in result["items"]]
    )

    products = []
    for item in result["items"]:
        prices = prices_by_item.get(item["item_code"], [])
        available = [p["price"] for p in prices if p["price"] and p["price"] > 0]
        products.append(
            {
                "identifier": item["item_code"],
                "brand": None,
                "category": "",
                "name": item["name"] or item["item_code"],
                "min_price": min(available) if available else None,
                "store_count": len({(p["chain_id"], p["store_id"]) for p in prices}),
            }
        )

    return {
        "products": products,
        "total": result["total"],
        "limit": result["limit"],
        "offset": result["offset"],
    }





def get_fresh_product_detail(
    name: str,
    subcategory_id: int,
) -> FreshProductDetail | None:
    """Fresh product: per-store prices plus all active promotions."""
    product_name = name.strip()
    if not product_name:
        return None

    rows = queries.get_fresh_product_detail(
        product_name=product_name,
        subcategory_id=subcategory_id,
    )
    if not rows:
        return None

    stores = []
    for row in rows:
        row = dict(row)
        row["shopper_brand"] = resolve_shopper_brand(
            row.get("store_name"),
            row.get("brands"),
            row.get("chain_name_he"),
        )
        stores.append(FreshStorePrice.model_validate(row))

    promotions = [
        FreshStorePromotion(
            **promotion.model_dump(),
            store_name=store.store_name,
            chain_name_he=store.chain_name_he,
        )
        for store in stores
        for promotion in store.promotions
        if promotion.discounted_price is not None
        and promotion.discounted_price > 0
    ]

    valid_prices = [
        store.price for store in stores
        if store.price is not None and store.price > 0
    ]

    first = rows[0]
    return FreshProductDetail(
        product_name=product_name,
        category_id=first["category_id"],
        category=first["category"],
        subcategory_id=first["subcategory_id"],
        subcategory=first["subcategory"],
        lowest_price=min(valid_prices) if valid_prices else None,
        lowest_promotion=(
            min(promotions, key=lambda promo: promo.discounted_price)
            if promotions
            else None
        ),
        stores=stores,
        promotions=promotions,
    )

"""
clients/binaprojects.py

HTTP client for Bina Projects.

Handles file discovery, download URL resolution, and file downloads,
including retry and fallback handling for the source's download endpoints.
"""

import logging
import time
from urllib.parse import urlparse, urlunparse

import requests


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class BinaProjectsClient:

    MAX_RETRIES = 3
    BACKOFF_SECONDS = [2, 4, 8]
    TIMEOUT = 30

    def __init__(
        self,
        source_url: str,
    ):
        self.source_url = source_url.rstrip("/")

        parsed = urlparse(self.source_url)

        self.base_url = urlunparse(
            (
                parsed.scheme,
                parsed.netloc,
                "",
                "",
                "",
                "",
            )
        )

        self.session = requests.Session()

    def _get_with_retry(
        self,
        url: str,
        **kwargs,
    ) -> requests.Response:

        last_exc = None

        for attempt in range(self.MAX_RETRIES):

            try:

                response = self.session.get(
                    url,
                    timeout=self.TIMEOUT,
                    **kwargs,
                )

                response.raise_for_status()

                logger.debug(
                    "GET %s -> HTTP %d",
                    response.url,
                    response.status_code,
                )

                return response

            except (
                requests.Timeout,
                requests.ConnectionError,
            ) as exc:

                last_exc = exc

                logger.warning(
                    "Attempt %d/%d failed for %s: %s",
                    attempt + 1,
                    self.MAX_RETRIES,
                    url,
                    exc,
                )

                if attempt < self.MAX_RETRIES - 1:
                    time.sleep(
                        self.BACKOFF_SECONDS[attempt]
                    )

            except requests.HTTPError:
                raise

        logger.error(
            "All %d attempts failed for %s",
            self.MAX_RETRIES,
            url,
        )

        raise last_exc

    # WFileType:
    # 1 = stores
    # 2 = prices
    # 3 = promo
    # 4 = pricefull
    # 5 = promofull

    def get_hok_files(
        self,
        store: str = "",
        date: str = "",
        file_type: int = 0,
    ) -> list[dict]:

        response = self._get_with_retry(
            f"{self.base_url}/MainIO_Hok.aspx",
            params={
                "wReshet": "",
                "WStore": store,
                "WDate": date,
                "WFileType": file_type,
            },
            headers={
                "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest",
            },
        )

        return response.json()

    def get_download_url(
        self,
        filename: str,
    ) -> str:

        response = self._get_with_retry(
            f"{self.base_url}/Download.aspx",
            params={
                "FileNm": filename,
            },
            headers={
                "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest",
            },
        )

        data = response.json()

        if not data or not data[0].get("SPath"):
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"No download URL returned for {filename}"
            )

        return data[0]["SPath"]

    def download_file(
        self,
        filename: str,
    ) -> bytes:

        direct_url = f"{self.base_url}/Download/{filename}"

        try:

            response = self._get_with_retry(
                direct_url,
            )

            return response.content

        except requests.HTTPError:

            logger.warning(
                "Direct Bina download failed for %s, "
                "falling back to Download.aspx",
                filename,
            )

            download_url = self.get_download_url(
                filename,
            )

            return self._get_with_retry(
                download_url,
            ).content

"""
clients/carrefour.py

HTTP client for Carrefour.

Handles file discovery from the Carrefour website and file downloads,
including parsing the source's HTML-based file metadata and retry
handling for transient HTTP failures.
"""

import asyncio
import logging
import re
import json

import httpx


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class CarrefourClient:

    MAX_RETRIES = 3
    BACKOFF_SECONDS = [2, 4, 8]
    TIMEOUT = httpx.Timeout(30.0)

    BASE_URL = "https://prices.carrefour.co.il"

    def __init__(self):
        self.base_url = self.BASE_URL

    async def _get_with_retry(
        self,
        url: str,
    ) -> httpx.Response:

        last_exc = None

        for attempt in range(self.MAX_RETRIES):

            try:
                async with httpx.AsyncClient(
                    timeout=self.TIMEOUT
                ) as client:

                    response = await client.get(url)
                    response.raise_for_status()

                    logger.debug(
                        "GET %s -> HTTP %d",
                        response.url,
                        response.status_code,
                    )

                    return response

            except (
                httpx.TimeoutException,
                httpx.ConnectError,
            ) as exc:

                last_exc = exc

                logger.warning(
                    "Attempt %d/%d failed for %s: %s",
                    attempt + 1,
                    self.MAX_RETRIES,
                    url,
                    exc,
                )

                if attempt < self.MAX_RETRIES - 1:
                    await asyncio.sleep(
                        self.BACKOFF_SECONDS[attempt]
                    )

            except httpx.HTTPStatusError:
                raise

        logger.error(
            "All %d attempts failed for %s",
            self.MAX_RETRIES,
            url,
        )

        raise last_exc

    async def get_files(
        self,
        date: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict:

        url = self.base_url

        if date:
            url = f"{url}/?date={date}"

        response = await self._get_with_retry(url)

        html = response.text

        path_match = re.search(
            r"const\s+path\s*=\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]",
            html,
        )

        files_match = re.search(
            r"const\s+files\s*=\s*(\[[\s\S]*?\])\s*;",
            html,
        )

        if not path_match:
            raise ValueError(
                "Could not find Carrefour 'path' in HTML"
            )

        if not files_match:
            raise ValueError(
                "Could not find Carrefour 'files' in HTML"
            )

        path = path_match.group(1)

        files = json.loads(
            files_match.group(1)
        )

        logger.info(
            "Carrefour: found %d files for path %s",
            len(files),
            path,
        )

        return {
            "path": path,
            "files": files,
        }

    async def download_file(
        self,
        url: str,
    ) -> bytes:

        response = await self._get_with_retry(url)

        return response.content

FILE: clients/html_client.py

"""
clients/html_client.py

Generic HTTP client for discovering downloadable files from
server-rendered HTML listing pages.

Supports anchor- and table-row-based extraction, configurable filename
sources, optional file-size extraction, and HTTP retry/backoff handling.
Publisher-specific filtering and filename logic are handled elsewhere.
"""


import asyncio
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urljoin, urlparse

import httpx
from lxml import html as lxml_html


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class Candidate:
    """
    One possible downloadable file.

    The client only extracts HTML structure and the filename
    according to the configured filename source.

    It does NOT decide whether the candidate is a Stores file.
    """

    text: str
    href: str
    filename: str | None = None
    file_size: str | None = None


class HtmlFileLinkClient:
    """
    Generic client for publishers whose file discovery works through
    server-rendered HTML pages.

    Extraction modes:

    anchor:
        Extracts one Candidate per <a href>.

    row:
        Extracts one Candidate per table row containing a download
        link. The filename is taken from the configured filename
        column when available.

    Filename sources:

    path:
        Filename comes from the URL path.

    query:
        Filename comes from a URL query parameter.

    row:
        Filename comes from the table row/cell.

    This client contains NO publisher-specific filename regex,
    Stores matching, chain ID parsing, date parsing, latest-file
    logic, or pagination.
    """

    MAX_RETRIES = 3
    BACKOFF_SECONDS = [2, 4, 8]
    TIMEOUT = httpx.Timeout(30.0)

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        base_url: str,
        extraction_mode: str = "anchor",
        filename_column: str | None = None,
        filename_source: str = "path",
        filename_param: str | None = None,
        file_size_column: int | None = None,
    ):
        self.name = name
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.extraction_mode = extraction_mode
        self.filename_column = filename_column
        self.filename_source = filename_source
        self.filename_param = filename_param
        self.file_size_column = file_size_column

    async def _get_with_retry(
        self,
        url: str,
        params: dict | None = None,
    ) -> httpx.Response:

        last_exc = None

        for attempt in range(self.MAX_RETRIES):
            try:
                async with httpx.AsyncClient(
                    timeout=self.TIMEOUT
                ) as client:

                    response = await client.get(
                        url,
                        params=params,
                    )

                    response.raise_for_status()

                    logger.debug(
                        "GET %s -> HTTP %d",
                        response.url,
                        response.status_code,
                    )

                    return response

            except (
                httpx.TimeoutException,
                httpx.ConnectError,
            ) as exc:

                last_exc = exc

                logger.warning(
                    "Attempt %d/%d failed for %s: %s",
                    attempt + 1,
                    self.MAX_RETRIES,
                    url,
                    exc,
                )

                if attempt < self.MAX_RETRIES - 1:
                    await asyncio.sleep(
                        self.BACKOFF_SECONDS[attempt]
                    )

            except httpx.HTTPStatusError:
                raise

        logger.error(
            "All %d attempts failed for %s",
            self.MAX_RETRIES,
            url,
        )

        raise last_exc

    def _extract_filename(
        self,
        href: str,
        text: str,
    ) -> str | None:
        """
        Extract a filename from an anchor according to
        filename_source.

        Used for anchor-based publishers.
        """

        if self.filename_source == "path":

            path = urlparse(href).path

            filename = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]

            return filename or None

        if self.filename_source == "query":

            if not self.filename_param:
                raise ValueError(
                    "filename_param is required when "
                    "filename_source='query'"
                )

            query = parse_qs(
                urlparse(href).query
            )

            values = query.get(
                self.filename_param
            )

            if not values:
                return None

            return values[0].strip() or None

        if self.filename_source == "row":
            return text or None

        raise ValueError(
            f"Unsupported filename source: "
            f"{self.filename_source!r}. "
            f"Expected 'path', 'query', or 'row'."
        )

    def _extract_anchor_mode(
        self,
        tree,
        page_url: str,
    ) -> list[Candidate]:

        candidates = []

        for anchor in tree.xpath("//a[@href]"):

            href = (
                anchor.get("href") or ""
            ).strip()

            if not href:
                continue

            absolute_href = urljoin(
                page_url,
                href,
            )

            text = (
                anchor.text_content() or ""
            ).strip()

            filename = self._extract_filename(
                absolute_href,
                text,
            )

            file_size = None

            if self.file_size_column is not None:
                row = anchor.xpath("ancestor::tr[1]")

                if row:
                    cells = row[0].xpath("./td")

                    if self.file_size_column < len(cells):
                        file_size = (
                            cells[self.file_size_column]
                            .text_content()
                            or ""
                        ).strip()

                        if not file_size:
                            file_size = None

            candidates.append(
                Candidate(
                    text=text,
                    href=absolute_href,
                    filename=filename,
                    file_size=file_size,
                )
            )

        return candidates

    def _extract_row_mode(
        self,
        tree,
        page_url: str,
    ) -> list[Candidate]:

        candidates = []

        for table in tree.xpath("//table"):

            headers = [
                (
                    header.text_content() or ""
                ).strip()
                for header in table.xpath(
                    ".//thead//th"
                )
            ]

            filename_index = None

            if self.filename_column:
                for index, header in enumerate(headers):

                    if header == self.filename_column:
                        filename_index = index
                        break

            for row in table.xpath(".//tr"):

                cells = row.xpath("./td")

                if not cells:
                    continue

                anchors = row.xpath(
                    ".//a[@href]"
                )

                if not anchors:
                    continue

                href = (
                    anchors[0].get("href") or ""
                ).strip()

                if not href:
                    continue

                absolute_href = urljoin(
                    page_url,
                    href,
                )

                if (
                    filename_index is not None
                    and filename_index < len(cells)
                ):
                    filename = (
                        cells[filename_index]
                        .text_content()
                        .strip()
                    )
                else:
                    filename = None

                    for cell in cells:
                        cell_text = (
                            cell.text_content()
                            or ""
                        ).strip()

                        if cell_text.startswith(
                            ("Price", "Promo", "Stores")
                        ):
                            filename = cell_text
                            break


                file_size = None

                if self.file_size_column is not None:
                    if self.file_size_column < len(cells):
                        file_size = (
                            cells[self.file_size_column]
                            .text_content()
                            or ""
                        ).strip()

                        if not file_size:
                            file_size = None

                candidates.append(
                    Candidate(
                        text=filename or "",
                        href=absolute_href,
                        filename=filename or None,
                        file_size=file_size,
                    )
                )

        return candidates

    async def get_candidates(
        self,
        params: dict | None = None,
    ) -> list[Candidate]:

        response = await self._get_with_retry(
            self.base_url,
            params=params,
        )

        tree = lxml_html.fromstring(
            response.text
        )

        if self.extraction_mode == "anchor":

            candidates = self._extract_anchor_mode(
                tree,
                str(response.url),
            )

        elif self.extraction_mode == "row":

            candidates = self._extract_row_mode(
                tree,
                str(response.url),
            )

        else:

            raise ValueError(
                f"Unsupported extraction mode: "
                f"{self.extraction_mode!r}. "
                f"Expected 'anchor' or 'row'."
            )

        logger.debug(
            "%s: %d candidates on %s",
            self.name,
            len(candidates),
            response.url,
        )

        return candidates
