            if ingredient
        ),
        None,
    )

    return {
        "company": company,
        "source": company,
        "source_file": source_file,

        "barcode": barcode,
        "local_barcode": local_barcode,
        "product_id": None,
        "id": None,
        "retailer_id": None,
        "supplier_id": None,

        "local_name": name,
        "name_he": name,
        "name_en": None,
        "name_ru": None,

        "brand_id": None,
        "brand_name_he": _text(_first(data.get(K_BRAND))),
        "brand_name_en": None,
        "brand_name_ru": None,

        "search_keywords": [],
        "family_search_keywords": [],

        "department_id": None,
        "department_external_id": None,
        "department_name": None,

        "family_id": None,
        "family_name_he": None,
        "family_name_en": None,
        "category_ids": [],
        "category_path_ids": [],
        "category_path_he": categories,
        "category_path_en": [],
        "categories_paths": [
            [{HE: category} for category in categories]
        ] if categories else [],

        "ingredients_he": ingredients,
        "ingredients_en": None,
        "ingredients_ru": None,
        "description_he": None,
        "description_en": None,
        "description_ru": None,

        "nutrition_facts": None,
        "nutrition_values": _nutrition_values(sections),

        "main_image_url": default_image["url"] if default_image else None,
        "images": images,
        "nutrition_image_url": None,
    }


def iter_products(
    path: Path,
    stats: dict[str, int] | None = None,
) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Yield parsed products; optionally count products without a valid GTIN."""
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        doc = json.load(f)

    if isinstance(doc, Mapping) and "item_code" in doc:
        products = [doc]
    elif isinstance(doc, Mapping) and isinstance(doc.get("products"), list):
        products = doc["products"]
    elif isinstance(doc, list):
        products = doc
    else:
        keys = list(doc)[:5] if isinstance(doc, Mapping) else type(doc).__name__
        raise ValueError(f"unrecognised type_1 layout (top-level: {keys})")

    # Company comes from the directory containing the JSON file.
    company = path.parent.name
    source_file = path.name

    for raw in products:
        if not isinstance(raw, Mapping):
            continue

        product = parse_product(
            dict(raw),
            company=company,
            source_file=source_file,
        )

        if stats is not None and product["barcode"] is None:
            stats["no_valid_gtin"] = stats.get("no_valid_gtin", 0) + 1

        yield product



====================================================================================================
FILE: parsers/product_page_type2.py
====================================================================================================


"""
parsers/product_page_type2.py

Parse type_2 product page dumps ( style: item_code / details / gs ...)
into the SAME flat record schema as parsers/product_json.py.

Import usage:
    from parsers.product_page_type2 import iter_products, parse_product
"""

import html
import json
import re
from collections.abc import Mapping
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterator

from database.records import is_valid_gtin

HE = "1"
BASE_URL = "https://www.rami-levy.co.il"
_TAG_RE = re.compile(r"<[^>]+>")
_WS_RE = re.compile(r"[ \t\r\f\v]+")
_LESS_THAN_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:פחות\s*מ[-־\s]*|<)")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
def _text(value: Any) -> str | None:
    """Stripped string or None (empty / whitespace-only -> None)."""
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
        return None
    value = str(value).strip()
    return value or None


def _dict(value: Any) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    return value if isinstance(value, Mapping) else {}


def _list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    return value if isinstance(value, list) else []


def _html_to_text(value: Any) -> str:
    s = html.unescape(_text(value) or "")
    s = s.replace("\xa0", " ")
    s = re.sub(r"(?i)<br\s*/?>|</p>|</li>|</div>", "\n", s)
    s = re.sub(_TAG_RE, " ", s)
    s = _WS_RE.sub(" ", s)
    s = re.sub(r" *\n *", "\n", s)
    return s.strip() or None


def _abs_url(url: Any) -> str | None:
    u = _text(url)
    if not u:
        return None
    return BASE_URL + u if u.startswith("/") else u


def _to_number(value: Any) -> int | float | str | None:
    """'6.3' -> 6.3, '182' -> 182, anything unparseable stays as the string."""
    s = _text(value)
    if s is None:
        return None
    try:
        f = float(s.replace(",", "."))
    except ValueError:
        return s
    return int(f) if f.is_integer() else f


def _ref(d: Any) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
    """(id, name) of a {name,id,sort,slug} object (department/group/subGroup)."""
    d = _dict(d)
    return d.get("id"), _text(d.get("name"))


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- barcode
def _resolve_barcode(raw: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
    """Return (barcode, local_barcode).

    The chain's own internal codes (12xxxxxxxxxxx) are not real GTINs, so a
    code only goes to `barcode` if it passes is_valid_gtin; otherwise it is
    kept in `local_barcode` so nothing is lost.
    """
    details = _dict(raw.get("details"))
    code = (
        _text(details.get("barcode"))
        or _text(raw.get("item_code"))
        or _text(raw.get("page_code"))
    )
    if code is None:
        return None, None
    if code.endswith(".0"):  # number serialised as float
        code = code[:-2]
    if is_valid_gtin(code):
        return code, None
    return None, code


# ------------------------------------------------------------- categories
def _category_path(details: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return the normalized department > group > subGroup hierarchy."""
    levels = (
        (details.get("department"), details.get("department_id")),
        (details.get("group"), details.get("group_id")),
        (details.get("subGroup"), details.get("sub_group_id")),
    )

    path: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for obj, fallback_id in levels:
        category_id, name = _ref(obj)
        if category_id is None:
            category_id = fallback_id

        # A category without a name is not useful in the category path.
        if not name:
            continue

        path.append({
            "id": category_id,
            "name_he": name,
        })

    return path


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- images
def _collect_images(raw: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    raw_images = {
        _text(url).rsplit("/", 1)[-1]: _text(url)
        for url in _list(raw.get("images"))
        if _text(url)
    }

    details = _dict(raw.get("details"))
    image_details = _dict(details.get("images"))

    images = []
    seen = set()

    for image_type in ("original", "trim", "small", "transparent"):
        relative_url = _text(image_details.get(image_type))
        if not relative_url:
            continue

        filename = relative_url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        url = raw_images.get(filename)

        if not url or url in seen:
            continue

        seen.add(url)
        images.append({
            "url": url,
            "type": image_type,
            "is_default": image_type == "original",
        })

    for item in _list(image_details.get("gallery")):
        if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
            continue

        relative_url = _text(item.get("url"))
        filename = relative_url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        url = raw_images.get(filename)

        if not url or url in seen:
            continue

        seen.add(url)
        images.append({**item, "url": url})

    return images

# ------------------------------------------------------------- nutrition
def _nutrition(gs: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """
    -> {"sizes":  [{"id", "names": {"1": basis}}],
        "values": [{"id", "names": {"1": nutrient},
                    "sizeValues": [{"sizeId", "unitOfMeasure": {"names": {"1": unit}},
                                    "value", "valueLessThan"}]}]}
    (same shape as the Carrefour / Tiv Taam dumps)
    """
    sizes: dict[Any, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    values: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for nutrient in _list(gs.get("Nutritional_Values")):
        if not isinstance(nutrient, Mapping):
            continue

        label = _text(nutrient.get("label"))
        if not label:
            continue

        size_values = []

        for field in _list(nutrient.get("fields")):
            if not isinstance(field, Mapping):
                continue

            size_id = _to_int(field.get("col_code"))
            basis = _text(field.get("col_label"))

            if size_id not in sizes:
                sizes[size_id] = {"id": size_id, "names": {HE: basis}}

            text = _text(field.get("text")) or ""

            size_values.append({
                "sizeId": size_id,
                "unitOfMeasure": {
                    "names": {HE: _text(field.get("UOM")) or ""}
                },
                "value": _to_number(field.get("value")),
                "valueLessThan": bool(_LESS_THAN_RE.match(text)),
            })

        if size_values:
            values.append({
                "id": _to_int(nutrient.get("code")),
                "names": {HE: label},
                "sizeValues": size_values,
            })

    if not values:
        return None

    return {"sizes": list(sizes.values()), "values": values}


def _to_int(value: Any) -> int | None:
    try:
        return int(str(value).strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


# --------------------------------------------------------------- keywords
def _keywords(gs: Mapping[str, Any], barcode_like: set[str]) -> list[str]:
    out: list[str] = []

    for tag in _list(gs.get("Search_Tags")):
        t = _text(tag)
        if t and t not in barcode_like and t not in out:
            out.append(t)

    return out


# ------------------------------------------------------------ description
def _description_he(details: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str | None:
    for key in ("full_desc", "short_desc"):
        d = _html_to_text(details.get(key))
        if d:
            return d

    # Fallback: "תיאור מוצר" property blocks.
    parts = []

    for prop in _list(details.get("properties")):
        if (
            isinstance(prop, Mapping)
            and _text(prop.get("property_parent_name")) == "תיאור מוצר"
        ):
            text = _html_to_text(prop.get("value"))
            if text:
                parts.append(text)

    return "\n\n".join(parts) or None


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ main
def parse_product(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    details = _dict(raw.get("details"))
    gs = _dict(details.get("gs"))

    barcode, local_barcode = _resolve_barcode(raw)
    images = _collect_images(raw)
    default_image = next((i for i in images if i["is_default"]), None)

    dept_id, dept_name = _ref(details.get("department"))
    if dept_id is None:
        dept_id = details.get("department_id")

    group_id, group_name = _ref(details.get("group"))
    if group_id is None:
        group_id = details.get("group_id")

    path = _category_path(details)
    nutrition_values = _nutrition(gs)

    local_name = _text(raw.get("name")) or _text(details.get("name"))
    name_he = local_name or _text(gs.get("name")) or _text(gs.get("short_name"))

    barcode_like = {
        x for x in (barcode, local_barcode, _text(raw.get("item_code")) if raw else None)
        if x
    }

    return {
        # --- identity ---
        "barcode": barcode,
        "local_barcode": local_barcode,
        "product_id": details.get("id"),
        "id": details.get("id"),
        "retailer_id": None,
        "supplier_id": None,

        # --- name ---
        "local_name": local_name,
        "name_he": name_he,
        "name_en": None,
        "name_ru": None,

        # --- brand ---
        "brand_id": None,
        "brand_name_he": _text(gs.get("BrandName")),
        "brand_name_en": None,
        "brand_name_ru": None,

        # --- search keywords ---
        "search_keywords": _keywords(gs, barcode_like),
        "family_search_keywords": [],

        # --- department ---
        "department_id": dept_id,
        "department_external_id": None,
        "department_name": dept_name,

        # --- family + categories ---
        "family_id": group_id,
        "family_name_he": group_name,
        "family_name_en": None,
        "category_ids": [c["id"] for c in path if c["id"] is not None],
        "category_path_ids": [c["id"] for c in path],
        "category_path_he": [c["name_he"] for c in path],
        "category_path_en": [None for _ in path],
        "categories_paths": (
            [[
                {
                    "id": c["id"],
                    "names": {HE: c["name_he"]},
                    "keywords": [],
                }
                for c in path
            ]]
            if path
            else []
        ),

        # --- content ---
        "ingredients_he": _text(gs.get("Ingredient_Sequence_and_Name")),
        "ingredients_en": None,
        "ingredients_ru": None,
        "description_he": _description_he(details),
        "description_en": _text(gs.get("Product_Description_English")),
        "description_ru": None,

        # --- nutrition ---
        "nutrition_facts": None,
        "nutrition_values": nutrition_values,

        # --- images ---
        "main_image_url": default_image["url"] if default_image else None,
        "images": images,
        "nutrition_image_url": None,
    }


def iter_products(
    path: Path,
    stats: dict[str, int] | None = None,
) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Yield parsed products; optionally count non-GTIN (local-only) codes."""
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        doc = json.load(f)

    if isinstance(doc, Mapping) and "item_code" in doc:
        products = [doc]
    elif isinstance(doc, Mapping) and isinstance(doc.get("products"), list):
        products = doc["products"]
    elif isinstance(doc, list):
        products = doc
    else:
        keys = list(doc)[:5] if isinstance(doc, Mapping) else type(doc).__name__
        raise ValueError(f"unrecognised type_2 layout (top-level: {keys})")

    for raw in products:
        if not isinstance(raw, Mapping):
            continue

        product = parse_product(dict(raw))

        if stats is not None and product["barcode"] is None:
            stats["no_valid_gtin"] = stats.get("no_valid_gtin", 0) + 1

        yield product



====================================================================================================
FILE: parsers/xml.py
====================================================================================================

"""
parsers/xml.py

Parses supermarket XML feed files into Metziah domain models.

Handles:
- Price files into Product objects
- Promotion files into Promotion, PromotionGroup, and PromotionItem objects
- Multiple retailer-specific promotion XML layouts normalized into one model
- Case-insensitive XML tag normalization
- Feed-specific decimal, integer, and datetime normalization
- Malformed item/promotion handling without discarding the entire file
"""

import logging
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation

from lxml import etree

from models.promo import Promotion, PromotionGroup, PromotionItem
from models.product import Product


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class StoreXmlParser:

    @staticmethod
    def normalize_xml_tags(root):
        """
        Normalize all XML element tag names to lowercase.

        This makes the parser accept inconsistent capitalization such as:
        - PromotionID
        - PromotionId
        - promotionid
        - Promotionid

        All become:
            promotionid
        """
        for element in root.iter():
            if isinstance(element.tag, str):
                element.tag = element.tag.lower()

    def parse_price_file(self, xml_content):
        root = etree.fromstring(xml_content)
        self.normalize_xml_tags(root)

        products = []

        chain_id = root.findtext("chainid")
        sub_chain_id = root.findtext("subchainid")
        store_id = root.findtext("storeid")

        chain_id = chain_id.strip() if chain_id else None
        sub_chain_id = (
            sub_chain_id.strip()
            if sub_chain_id
            else None
        )
        store_id = store_id.strip() if store_id else None

        for item in root.findall("./items/item"):

            item_code = item.findtext("itemcode")

            try:
                products.append(
                    Product(
                        chain_id=chain_id,
                        sub_chain_id=sub_chain_id,
                        store_id=store_id,

                        item_code=item_code,
                        name=item.findtext("itemname"),

                        price=self.parse_decimal(
                            item.findtext("itemprice"),
                            "ItemPrice",
                        ),

                        unit_price=self.parse_decimal(
                            item.findtext("unitofmeasureprice"),
                            "UnitOfMeasurePrice",
                        ),

                        quantity=self.parse_decimal(
                            item.findtext("quantity"),
                            "Quantity",
                        ),

                        unit_qty=item.findtext("unitqty"),
                        unit_measure=item.findtext("unitofmeasure"),

                        manufacturer=item.findtext("manufacturename"),
                        manufacturer_country=item.findtext(
                            "manufacturecountry"
                        ),

                        price_update_time=self.parse_datetime(
                            item.findtext("priceupdatetime")
                        ),

                        last_sale_datetime=self.parse_datetime(
                            item.findtext("lastsaledatetime")
                        ),

                        weighted=(
                            item.findtext("bisweighted") == "1"
                        ),

                        allow_discount=(
                            item.findtext("allowdiscount") == "1"
                        ),

                        item_type=self.parse_int(
                            item.findtext("itemtype")
                        ),

                        package_quantity=self.parse_int(
                            item.findtext("qtyinpackage")
                        ),

                        status=item.findtext("itemstatus") or None,
                    )
                )

            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(
                    "Skipping malformed item "
                    "(chain_id=%s store_id=%s item_code=%s): %s",
                    chain_id,
                    store_id,
                    item_code,
                    e,
                )
                continue

        return products

    def parse_promo_file(self, xml_content):
        root = etree.fromstring(xml_content)
        self.normalize_xml_tags(root)

        chain_id = root.findtext("chainid")
        sub_chain_id = root.findtext("subchainid")
        store_id = root.findtext("storeid")

        chain_id = chain_id.strip() if chain_id else None
        sub_chain_id = (
            sub_chain_id.strip()
            if sub_chain_id
            else None
        )
        store_id = store_id.strip() if store_id else None

        promotions: dict[str, Promotion] = {}
        groups_by_promo: dict[
            str,
            dict[str, PromotionGroup],
        ] = {}

        for promo_el in root.findall(
            ".//promotions/promotion"
        ):

            promotion_id = promo_el.findtext("promotionid")

            try:
                if not promotion_id:
                    logger.warning(
                        "Skipping promotion with missing promotion_id "
                        "(chain_id=%s store_id=%s description=%s)",
                        chain_id,
                        store_id,
                        promo_el.findtext(
                            "promotiondescription"
                        ),
                    )
                    continue

                if promotion_id not in promotions:

                    start_datetime = self.parse_datetime(
                        promo_el.findtext(
                            "promotionstartdatetime"
                        )
                    )

                    if start_datetime is None:
                        start_datetime = self.parse_date_and_hour(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "promotionstartdate"
                            ),
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "promotionstarthour"
                            ),
                        )

                    end_datetime = self.parse_datetime(
                        promo_el.findtext(
                            "promotionenddatetime"
                        )
                    )

                    if end_datetime is None:
                        end_datetime = self.parse_date_and_hour(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "promotionenddate"
                            ),
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "promotionendhour"
                            ),
                        )

                    update_time = self.parse_datetime(
                        promo_el.findtext(
                            "promotionupdatetime"
                        )
                    )

                    if update_time is None:
                        update_time = self.parse_datetime(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "promotionupdatedate"
                            )
                        )

                    min_no_of_items_offered = (
                        self.parse_int(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "minnoofitemoffered"
                            )
                        )
                        or self.parse_int(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "minnoofitemsoffered"
                            )
                        )
                        or self.parse_int(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "minnoofitemofered"
                            )
                        )
                    )

                    promotions[promotion_id] = Promotion(
                        chain_id=chain_id,
                        promotion_id=promotion_id,
                        store_id=store_id,

                        description=promo_el.findtext(
                            "promotiondescription"
                        ),

                        start_datetime=start_datetime,
                        end_datetime=end_datetime,

                        start_hour=(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "promotionstarthour"
                            )
                            or None
                        ),

                        end_hour=(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "promotionendhour"
                            )
                            or None
                        ),

                        promotion_days=(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "promotiondays"
                            )
                            or None
                        ),

                        update_time=update_time,

                        club_id=promo_el.findtext(
                            "clubid"
                        ),

                        is_gift_item=promo_el.findtext(
                            "isgiftitem"
                        ),

                        additional_is_coupon=(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "additionaliscoupon"
                            )
                            == "1"
                        ),

                        allow_multiple_discounts=(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "allowmultiplediscounts"
                            )
                            == "1"
                        ),

                        redemption_limit=self.parse_int(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "redemptionlimit"
                            )
                        ),

                        min_no_of_items_offered=(
                            min_no_of_items_offered
                        ),

                        additional_restrictions=(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "additionalrestrictions"
                            )
                            or None
                        ),

                        remarks=(
                            promo_el.findtext(
                                "remarks"
                            )
                            or ""
                        ).strip() or None,
                    )

                    groups_by_promo[promotion_id] = {}

                promotion = promotions[promotion_id]
                groups = groups_by_promo[promotion_id]

                # ----------------------------------------------------
                # Schema 1:
                #
                # Promotion
                #   Groups
                #     Group
                #       GroupID
                #       PromotionItems
                #         PromotionItem
                #
                # Preserve explicit group IDs.
                # ----------------------------------------------------

                group_elements = promo_el.findall(
                    "./groups/group"
                )

                if group_elements:

                    for group_el in group_elements:

                        group_id = group_el.findtext(
                            "groupid"
                        )

                        # A group without an ID cannot be represented
                        # directly by the database model. Normalize it
                        # into synthetic group 1.
                        if not group_id:
                            group_id = "1"

                        if group_id not in groups:

                            group = PromotionGroup(
                                chain_id=chain_id,
                                promotion_id=promotion_id,
                                store_id=store_id,
                                group_id=group_id,

                                min_purchase_amount=(
                                    self.parse_optional_decimal(
                                        group_el.findtext(
                                            "minpurchaseamount"
                                        )
                                    )
                                ),

                                discount_type=(
                                    group_el.findtext(
                                        "discounttype"
                                    )
                                    or None
                                ),
                            )

                            groups[group_id] = group
                            promotion.groups.append(group)

                        else:
                            group = groups[group_id]

                        for item_el in group_el.findall(
                            "./promotionitems/promotionitem"
                        ):
                            self._append_promotion_item(
                                group=group,
                                item_el=item_el,
                                chain_id=chain_id,
                                promotion_id=promotion_id,
                                store_id=store_id,
                            )

                else:
                    # ------------------------------------------------
                    # Schemas 2 and 3:
                    #
                    # Promotion
                    #   PromotionItems
                    #     PromotionItem
                    #
                    # or:
                    #
                    # Promotion
                    #   PromotionItems
                    #     Item
                    #
                    # Neither provides an explicit group ID.
                    # Normalize all items into group 1.
                    # ------------------------------------------------

                    item_elements = promo_el.findall(
                        "./promotionitems/promotionitem"
                    )

                    item_elements.extend(
                        promo_el.findall(
                            "./promotionitems/item"
                        )
                    )

                    if item_elements:

                        group_id = "1"

                        group = groups.get(group_id)

                        if group is None:

                            min_purchase_amount = (
                                self.parse_optional_decimal(
                                    promo_el.findtext(
                                        "minpurchaseamount"
                                    )
                                )

                                or self.parse_optional_decimal(
                                    promo_el.findtext(
                                        "minpurchaseamnt"
                                    )
                                )
                            )

                            group = PromotionGroup(
                                chain_id=chain_id,
                                promotion_id=promotion_id,
                                store_id=store_id,
                                group_id=group_id,
                                min_purchase_amount=(
                                    min_purchase_amount
                                ),
                                discount_type=(
                                    promo_el.findtext(
                                        "discounttype"
                                    )
                                    or None
                                ),
                            )

                            groups[group_id] = group
                            promotion.groups.append(group)

                        for item_el in item_elements:

                            self._append_promotion_item(
                                group=group,
                                item_el=item_el,
                                chain_id=chain_id,
                                promotion_id=promotion_id,
                                store_id=store_id,
                                promotion_el=promo_el,
                            )

            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(
                    "Skipping malformed promotion "
                    "(chain_id=%s store_id=%s promotion_id=%s): %s",
                    chain_id,
                    store_id,
                    promotion_id,
                    e,
                )
                continue

        return list(promotions.values())

    def _append_promotion_item(
        self,
        group,
        item_el,
        chain_id,
        promotion_id,
        store_id,
        promotion_el=None,
    ):
        """
        Parse a promotion item and append it to an existing group.

        Some feeds store promotion values directly on PromotionItem,
        while other feeds store them on the parent Promotion and only
        provide ItemCode/ItemType on the individual Item element.
        """

        try:

            def findtext(name):
                value = item_el.findtext(name)

                if value is None and promotion_el is not None:
                    value = promotion_el.findtext(name)

                return value

            is_weighted = (
                item_el.findtext("bisweighted")
                or item_el.findtext("blsweighted")
            )

            if is_weighted is None and promotion_el is not None:
                is_weighted = promotion_el.findtext(
                    "isweightedpromo"
                )

            group.items.append(
                PromotionItem(
                    chain_id=chain_id,
                    promotion_id=promotion_id,
                    store_id=store_id,
                    group_id=group.group_id,

                    item_code=findtext(
                        "itemcode"
                    ),

                    item_type=self.parse_int(
                        findtext("itemtype")
                    ),

                    reward_type=self.parse_int(
                        findtext("rewardtype")
                    ),

                    min_qty=self.parse_optional_decimal(
                        findtext("minqty")
                    ),

                    max_qty=self.parse_optional_decimal(
                        findtext("maxqty")
                    ),

                    discount_rate=self.parse_optional_decimal(
                        findtext("discountrate")
                    ),

                    discounted_price=(
                        self.parse_optional_decimal(
                            findtext("discountedprice")
                        )
                    ),

                    discounted_price_per_mida=(
                        self.parse_optional_decimal(
                            findtext(
                                "discountedpricepermida"
                            )
                        )
                    ),

                    is_weighted=(
                        is_weighted == "1"
                    ),
                )
            )

        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(
                "Skipping malformed promotion item "
                "(chain_id=%s store_id=%s "
                "promotion_id=%s group_id=%s "
                "item_code=%s): %s",
                chain_id,
                store_id,
                promotion_id,
                group.group_id,
                item_el.findtext("itemcode"),
                e,
            )

    def parse_datetime(self, value):
        if not value:
            return None

        value = value.strip()

        if not value:
            return None

        try:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return None

    def parse_date_and_hour(
        self,
        date_value,
        hour_value,
    ):
        if not date_value:
            return None

        date_value = date_value.strip()

        if not date_value:
            return None

        hour_value = (
            hour_value.strip()
            if hour_value
            else "00:00:00"
        )

        if not hour_value:
            hour_value = "00:00:00"

        value = f"{date_value} {hour_value}"

        for fmt in (
            "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f",
            "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
            "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M",
        ):
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(
                    value,
                    fmt,
                )
            except ValueError:
                continue

        return None

    def parse_decimal(
        self,
        value,
        field_name="Decimal",
    ):
        if value is None:
            return Decimal("0")

        value = value.strip()

        if not value:
            return Decimal("0")

        value = value.removeprefix("כ").strip()

        try:
            return Decimal(value)
        except InvalidOperation:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Invalid {field_name} format: {value!r}"
            )

    def parse_int(self, value):
        if value is None:
            return None

        value = value.strip()

        if not value:
            return None

        try:
            return int(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return None

    def parse_optional_decimal(self, value):
        if value is None:
            return None

        value = value.strip()

        if not value:
            return None

        value = value.removeprefix("כ").strip()

        try:
            return Decimal(value)
        except InvalidOperation:
            return None


====================================================================================================
FILE: scrapers/browser.py
====================================================================================================

"""
scrapers/browser.py

Browser-based scraper for retailers protected by Cloudflare.

Modes:
    python -m scrapers.browser
        Phase 1: discover and save categories for all retailers marked
        available=false in scraper_coverage.json.
        Phase 2: scrape them with up to 8 retailers running concurrently.
        Each retailer processes its categories one at a time.

    python -m scrapers.browser --categories
        Discover and save categories only.

    python -m scrapers.browser --concurrency 4
        Change the number of concurrent retailers (default 8).

    python -m scrapers.browser --retailer chain --category 79698
        Scrape one category for manual testing.

Product requests and pagination use the browser's own session.
Inactive or empty categories are skipped, and individual category
failures do not stop the rest of a retailer's scrape.
"""

import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import logging
import time
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin

from playwright.async_api import (
    async_playwright,
    TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError,
)

from scrapers.generic import extract_js_object, get_all_categories


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
COVERAGE_FILE = ROOT / "monitoring" / "data" / "scraper_coverage.json"
RAW_DIR = ROOT / "data" / "raw"
DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY = 8
MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES = 3  # recreate a retailer's context after this many

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(levelname)s: %(message)s",
)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def load_retailers():
    """Load retailer configuration keyed by chain ID."""
    with COVERAGE_FILE.open(encoding="utf-8") as file:
        data = json.load(file)

    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ValueError("Expected a dictionary in scraper_coverage.json")

    retailers = []
    for chain_id, retailer in data.items():
        if not isinstance(retailer, dict):
            continue

        retailer = retailer.copy()
        retailer.setdefault("chain_id", chain_id)
        retailers.append(retailer)

    return retailers


def retailer_name(retailer):
    """Return the normalized retailer name used for output directories."""
    return (
        retailer.get("name_en_normalized")
        or retailer.get("name_en")
        or retailer.get("name")
        or retailer.get("retailer_id")
    )


def extract_frontend_data(text):
    """Extract frontendData from JavaScript using generic.py's parser."""
    extracted = extract_js_object(text, "frontendData")

    try:
        return json.loads(extracted)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"frontendData is not valid JSON: {exc}") from exc


def get_categories(frontend_data):
    """Return the recursively flattened category list."""
    try:
        categories = frontend_data["tree"]["categories"]
    except (KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("frontendData does not contain tree.categories") from exc

    if not isinstance(categories, list):
        raise ValueError("frontendData tree.categories is not a list")

    return get_all_categories(categories)


async def load_frontend_data(browser, retailer):
    """Open the website, then load its configured frontend data asset."""
    website_url = retailer.get("web_site")
    data_url = retailer.get("data_url")

    if not website_url or not data_url:
        raise ValueError("Retailer must have web_site and data_url")

    context = await browser.new_context(
        viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 1000},
        locale="he-IL",
    )

    try:
        page = await context.new_page()

        logger.info("[%s] opening website: %s", retailer_name(retailer), website_url)
        try:
            await page.goto(
                website_url,
                wait_until="domcontentloaded",
                timeout=60_000,
            )
        except PlaywrightTimeoutError:
            logger.warning(
                "[%s] website navigation timed out; continuing",
                retailer_name(retailer),
            )

        await page.wait_for_timeout(1500)

        try:
            frontend_data = await page.evaluate(
                """() => {
                    if (typeof frontendData !== "undefined") {
                        return frontendData;
                    }
                    return window.frontendData || null;
                }"""
            )
        except Exception:
            frontend_data = None

        if isinstance(frontend_data, dict):
            try:
                get_categories(frontend_data)
                return frontend_data
            except ValueError:
                pass

        logger.info(
            "[%s] loading frontend data: %s",
            retailer_name(retailer),
            data_url,
        )
        try:
            response = await page.goto(
                data_url,
                wait_until="domcontentloaded",
                timeout=60_000,
            )
        except PlaywrightTimeoutError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Timed out loading frontend data: {data_url}"
            ) from exc

        if response is None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"No browser response received for {data_url}")

        if response.status >= 400:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Frontend data returned HTTP {response.status}: {data_url}"
            )

        return extract_frontend_data(await response.text())

    finally:
        await context.close()


def save_categories(retailer, categories):
    """Save categories to data/raw/<retailer>/categories.json."""
    name = retailer_name(retailer)
    if not name:
        raise ValueError("Retailer has no usable name")

    output_dir = RAW_DIR / str(name)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output_path = output_dir / "categories.json"

    payload = {
        "retailer": name,
        "retailer_id": retailer.get("retailer_id"),
        "categories_count": len(categories),
        "categories": categories,
    }

    output_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return output_path


def load_saved_categories(retailer):
    """Read categories from the retailer's existing categories.json."""
    name = retailer_name(retailer)
    path = RAW_DIR / str(name) / "categories.json"

    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)} does not exist; run category discovery first"
        )

    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as file:
        data = json.load(file)

    categories = data.get("categories", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else data
    if not isinstance(categories, list):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid categories format in {path}")

    return categories


class NoProductResponse(Exception):
    """The category page never produced a product API response (likely blocked)."""


async def new_retailer_context(browser):
    """Create one isolated, long-lived session for a retailer."""
    return await browser.new_context(
        viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 1000},
        locale="he-IL",
    )


async def scrape_category(context, retailer, category_id):
    """
    Capture all products from a category using browser-side pagination.

    Uses the retailer's shared context (cookies persist across categories)
    and opens a fresh page for this category only.
    """
    name = retailer_name(retailer)
    website_url = retailer.get("web_site")

    if not website_url:
        raise ValueError("Retailer is missing web_site")

    category_id = str(category_id)
    url = urljoin(
        website_url.rstrip("/") + "/",
        f"categories/{category_id}/products",
    )

    output_dir = RAW_DIR / str(name)
    output_file = output_dir / f"{category_id}.json"

    page = await context.new_page()
    try:
        responses = []
        page.on("response", lambda response: responses.append(response))

        logger.info("[%s] category=%s opening %s", name, category_id, url)

        try:
            await page.goto(
                url,
                wait_until="domcontentloaded",
                timeout=60_000,
            )
        except PlaywrightTimeoutError:
            logger.warning(
                "[%s] category=%s navigation timed out",
                name,
                category_id,
            )

        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle", timeout=8_000)
        except PlaywrightTimeoutError:
            pass

        logger.info(
            "[%s] category=%s final_page=%s title=%s",
            name,
            category_id,
            page.url,
            await page.title(),
        )

        # Find the actual product API response initiated by the page.
        api_response = None
        data = None

        for response in reversed(responses):
            if (
                response.status == 200
                and f"/categories/{category_id}/products" in response.url
                and "json" in response.headers.get("content-type", "").lower()
            ):
                try:
                    candidate = await response.json()
                except Exception:
                    continue

                if (
                    isinstance(candidate, dict)
                    and isinstance(candidate.get("products"), list)
                    and "total" in candidate
                ):
                    api_response = response
                    data = candidate
                    break

        if api_response is None:
            raise NoProductResponse(
                f"no product JSON response captured for category {category_id}"
            )

        products = data["products"]
        total = int(data.get("total") or 0)

        if not products or not total:
            logger.info(
                "[%s] category=%s inactive/empty; skipping",
                name,
                category_id,
            )
            return False

        api_url = api_response.url
        logger.info(
            "[%s] category=%s API total=%s initial_batch=%s",
            name,
            category_id,
            total,
            len(products),
        )

        # Fetch subsequent batches through the browser's own session.
        batch_size = max(len(products), 1)
        all_products = list(products)
        next_from = len(products)

        while next_from < total:
            result = await page.evaluate(
                """async ({ apiUrl, offset, size }) => {
                    const url = new URL(apiUrl);
                    url.searchParams.set("from", String(offset));
                    url.searchParams.set("size", String(size));

                    const response = await fetch(url.toString(), {
                        credentials: "include"
                    });

                    if (!response.ok) {
                        throw new Error(
                            `Product API returned HTTP ${response.status} at from=${offset}`
                        );
                    }

                    return await response.json();
                }""",
                {
                    "apiUrl": api_url,
                    "offset": next_from,
                    "size": batch_size,
                },
            )

            batch = result.get("products", [])
            if not batch:
                logger.warning(
                    "[%s] category=%s pagination stopped at %s/%s: empty batch",
                    name,
                    category_id,
                    len(all_products),
                    total,
                )
                break

            all_products.extend(batch)
            next_from += len(batch)

            logger.info(
                "[%s] category=%s collected %s/%s products",
                name,
                category_id,
                len(all_products),
                total,
            )

        data["products"] = all_products
        data["total"] = total
        data["_metziah"] = {
            "chain_id": retailer["chain_id"],
            "retailer_id": retailer.get("retailer_id"),
            "category_id": category_id,
            "source_url": api_url,
        }

        output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output_file.write_text(
            json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        complete = len(all_products) == total
        logger.info(
            "[%s] category=%s %s %s/%s products -> %s",
            name,
            category_id,
            "saved" if complete else "partially saved",
            len(all_products),
            total,
            output_file.relative_to(ROOT),
        )
        return complete

    finally:
        await page.close()


async def discover_retailer(browser, retailer):
    """Phase 1: discover and save one retailer's categories."""
    name = retailer_name(retailer) or "unknown"

    frontend_data = await load_frontend_data(browser, retailer)
    categories = get_categories(frontend_data)

    if not categories:
        raise ValueError("No categories found in frontendData")

    output_path = save_categories(retailer, categories)
    logger.info(
        "[%s] saved %s categories to %s",
        name,
        len(categories),
        output_path.relative_to(ROOT),
    )
    return categories


async def scrape_retailer_categories(browser, retailer, categories):
    """
    Phase 2: scrape one retailer's categories, one at a time, inside a
    single persistent browser context (one session per retailer).

    If several categories in a row fail, the context is replaced with a
    fresh one in case the session was flagged or went stale.
    """
    name = retailer_name(retailer) or "unknown"
    total_categories = len(categories)
    completed = 0
    skipped_or_failed = 0
    consecutive_failures = 0
    started = time.monotonic()

    context = await new_retailer_context(browser)

    try:
        for index, category in enumerate(categories, start=1):
            if not isinstance(category, dict) or category.get("id") is None:
                logger.warning(
                    "[%s] category %s/%s has no ID; skipping",
                    name,
                    index,
                    total_categories,
                )
                skipped_or_failed += 1
                continue

            category_id = str(category["id"])
            category_label = (
                category.get("name")
                or category.get("name_en")
                or category.get("label")
                or category_id
            )

            logger.info(
                "[%s] category %s/%s: %s (%s)",
                name,
                index,
                total_categories,
                category_label,
                category_id,
            )

            failed = False
            try:
                success = await scrape_category(context, retailer, category_id)
                if success:
                    completed += 1
                else:
                    skipped_or_failed += 1  # empty or partial, not a session problem
            except NoProductResponse as exc:
                failed = True
                skipped_or_failed += 1
                logger.warning("[%s] category=%s %s", name, category_id, exc)
            except Exception:
                failed = True
                skipped_or_failed += 1
                logger.exception(
                    "[%s] category=%s failed; continuing to next category",
                    name,
                    category_id,
                )

            if failed:
                consecutive_failures += 1
            else:
                consecutive_failures = 0

            if consecutive_failures >= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES:
                logger.warning(
                    "[%s] %s consecutive failures; starting a fresh browser session",
                    name,
                    consecutive_failures,
                )
                await context.close()
                context = await new_retailer_context(browser)
                consecutive_failures = 0
    finally:
        await context.close()

    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
    logger.info(
        "[%s] finished in %.1f min: %s/%s categories complete, %s skipped or failed",
        name,
        elapsed / 60,
        completed,
        total_categories,
        skipped_or_failed,
    )
    return completed, skipped_or_failed, elapsed


async def scrape_single_category(browser, retailer, category_id):
    """Manual single-category testing mode."""
    name = retailer_name(retailer) or "unknown"
    categories = load_saved_categories(retailer)
    matching = [
        category
        for category in categories
        if isinstance(category, dict)
        and str(category.get("id")) == str(category_id)
    ]

    if not matching:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Category {category_id} not found in "
            f"data/raw/{name}/categories.json"
        )

    context = await new_retailer_context(browser)
    try:
        return await scrape_category(context, retailer, category_id)
    finally:
        await context.close()


async def worker(worker_id, browser, queue, results):
    """
    Pull retailers from the queue until it is empty.

    When a worker finishes a retailer, it immediately takes the next one,
    so the number of active retailers stays at the concurrency limit until
    the queue runs dry.
    """
    while True:
        try:
            retailer, categories = queue.get_nowait()
        except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
            logger.info("Worker %s: queue empty, exiting", worker_id)
            return

        name = retailer_name(retailer) or "unknown"
        logger.info(
            "Worker %s: starting %s (%s categories)",
            worker_id,
            name,
            len(categories),
        )

        try:
            completed, skipped, elapsed = await scrape_retailer_categories(
                browser, retailer, categories
            )
            results[name] = {
                "status": "done",
                "completed": completed,
                "skipped_or_failed": skipped,
                "elapsed_min": round(elapsed / 60, 1),
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("[%s] retailer task failed", name)
            results[name] = {"status": "failed", "error": str(exc)}
        finally:
            queue.task_done()


async def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Discover categories and scrape retailer products with Playwright."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--retailer",
        help="Retailer name or ID, e.g. walmart.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--category",
        help="Scrape only this category ID from the existing categories.json.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--categories",
        action="store_true",
        help="Discover and save categories only; do not scrape products.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--concurrency",
        type=int,
        default=DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY,
        help=f"Max retailers scraped at once (default {DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY}).",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.category and args.categories:
        parser.error("--category cannot be combined with --categories")
    if args.concurrency < 1:
        parser.error("--concurrency must be at least 1")

    retailers = load_retailers()

    if args.retailer:
        target = args.retailer.strip().casefold()
        retailers = [
            retailer
            for retailer in retailers
            if target in {
                str(value).casefold()
                for value in (
                    retailer_name(retailer),
                    retailer.get("name_en"),
                    retailer.get("name"),
                    retailer.get("retailer_id"),
                    retailer.get("chain_id"),
                )
                if value is not None
            }
        ]
    else:
        # Only browser-based retailers are selected by default.
        retailers = [
            retailer
            for retailer in retailers
            if retailer.get("available") is False
        ]

    if not retailers:
        logger.error("No matching retailers found")
        return

    if args.category and len(retailers) != 1:
        logger.error("Specify --retailer when using --category")
        return

    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=False)

        try:
            # Manual single-category mode.
            if args.category:
                try:
                    await scrape_single_category(
                        browser, retailers[0], args.category
                    )
                except Exception:
                    logger.exception(
                        "[%s] single-category run failed",
                        retailer_name(retailers[0]),
                    )
                return

            # ---- Phase 1: discover categories for every retailer ----
            logger.info("Phase 1: discovering categories for %s retailer(s)", len(retailers))
            discovered = []
            discovery_failed = []

            for index, retailer in enumerate(retailers, start=1):
                name = retailer_name(retailer) or "unknown"
                logger.info("Discovery %s/%s: %s", index, len(retailers), name)

                try:
                    categories = await discover_retailer(browser, retailer)
                    discovered.append((retailer, categories))
                except Exception:
                    discovery_failed.append(name)
                    logger.exception("[%s] category discovery failed", name)

            logger.info(
                "Discovery finished: %s succeeded, %s failed",
                len(discovered),
                len(discovery_failed),
            )

            if args.categories:
                if discovery_failed:
                    logger.warning("Discovery failed for: %s", ", ".join(discovery_failed))
                return

            if not discovered:
                logger.error("No retailers with discovered categories; nothing to scrape")
                return

            # ---- Phase 2: scrape with a bounded pool of retailer workers ----
            worker_count = min(args.concurrency, len(discovered))
            logger.info(
                "Phase 2: scraping %s retailer(s) with %s concurrent worker(s)",
                len(discovered),
                worker_count,
            )

            queue = asyncio.Queue()
            for item in discovered:
                queue.put_nowait(item)

            results = {}
            await asyncio.gather(
                *(
                    worker(worker_id, browser, queue, results)
                    for worker_id in range(1, worker_count + 1)
                )
            )

            # ---- Summary ----
            done = [n for n, r in results.items() if r["status"] == "done"]
            failed = [n for n, r in results.items() if r["status"] == "failed"]

            logger.info(
                "Finished: %s/%s retailer(s) completed, %s failed during scrape, "
                "%s failed discovery",
                len(done),
                len(discovered),
                len(failed),
                len(discovery_failed),
            )
            for n in sorted(done, key=lambda k: results[k]["elapsed_min"], reverse=True):
                r = results[n]
                logger.info(
                    "  %-20s %6.1f min  %s ok, %s skipped/failed",
                    n,
                    r["elapsed_min"],
                    r["completed"],
                    r["skipped_or_failed"],
                )
            if failed:
                logger.warning("Scrape failed for: %s", ", ".join(failed))
            if discovery_failed:
                logger.warning("Discovery failed for: %s", ", ".join(discovery_failed))
        finally:
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())


====================================================================================================
FILE: scrapers/generic.py
====================================================================================================

"""
scrapers/generic.py

Generic scraper for retailer category products.

Scrapes every retailer marked as available=true in
data/reference/chains_extra.json.

Available retailers run concurrently. Categories and branches within
each retailer are processed sequentially to avoid excessive request
concurrency.

Results are saved under:
    data/raw/<retailer name>/<category_id>.json

Logging is isolated to:
    logs/scrape_categories.log
"""

import json
import logging
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from pathlib import Path

import httpx

from logging_config import setup_isolated_logging


PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

CONFIG_FILE = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "monitoring"
    / "data"
    / "scraper_coverage.json"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "data" / "raw"

MAX_RETAILERS = 10
PAGE_SIZE = 100
REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 10.0

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": (
        "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
        "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
        "Chrome/154.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    ),
    "Accept-Language": (
        "he-IL,he;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7"
    ),
}


logger = setup_isolated_logging(
    "scrape_categories",
    log_to_console=True,
)


def extract_js_object(text, key):
    marker = f"{key}:"
    start = text.find(marker)

    if start == -1:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not find {key}")

    start = text.find("{", start)

    if start == -1:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not find object for {key}")

    depth = 0
    in_string = False
    escape = False

    for i in range(start, len(text)):
        char = text[i]

        if in_string:
            if escape:
                escape = False
            elif char == "\\":
                escape = True
            elif char == '"':
                in_string = False
            continue

        if char == '"':
            in_string = True
        elif char == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif char == "}":
            depth -= 1

            if depth == 0:
                return text[start : i + 1]

    raise ValueError(f"Could not extract {key}")


def get_all_categories(categories):
    result = []

    for category in categories:
        result.append(category)
        result.extend(
            get_all_categories(
                category.get("subCategories", [])
            )
        )

    return result


def load_retailers():
    with CONFIG_FILE.open(encoding="utf-8") as file:
        config = json.load(file)

    return [
        {
            "chain_id": chain_id,
            **retailer,
        }
        for chain_id, retailer in config.items()
        if retailer.get("available") is True
    ]


def get_frontend_data(client, retailer):
    response = client.get(retailer["data_url"])
    response.raise_for_status()

    return json.loads(
        extract_js_object(
            response.text,
            "frontendData",
        )
    )


def scrape_category(
    client,
    retailer,
    branch_id,
    category_id,
):
    url = retailer["scraping_url"].format(
        branch_id=branch_id,
        category_id=category_id,
    )

    try:
        response = client.get(
            url,
            params={
                "from": 0,
                "size": PAGE_SIZE,
            },
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        data = response.json()

    except (httpx.HTTPError, ValueError) as exc:
        logger.warning(
            "[%s] branch=%s category=%s ERROR: %s",
            retailer["name_en_normalized"],
            branch_id,
            category_id,
            exc,
        )
        return None

    total = data.get("total", 0)
    products = data.get("products", [])

    logger.info(
        "[%s] branch=%s category=%s products=%s/%s",
        retailer["name_en_normalized"],
        branch_id,
        category_id,
        len(products),
        total,
    )

    if not products:
        return None

    while len(products) < total:
        offset = len(products)

        try:
            response = client.get(
                url,
                params={
                    "from": offset,
                    "size": PAGE_SIZE,
                },
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
            page_data = response.json()

        except (httpx.HTTPError, ValueError) as exc:
            logger.warning(
                "[%s] branch=%s category=%s "
                "pagination ERROR: %s",
                retailer["name_en_normalized"],
                branch_id,
                category_id,
                exc,
            )
            return None

        page_products = page_data.get("products", [])

        if not page_products:
            logger.warning(
                "[%s] branch=%s category=%s "
                "pagination stopped unexpectedly",
                retailer["name_en_normalized"],
                branch_id,
                category_id,
            )
            return None

        products.extend(page_products)

        logger.info(
            "[%s] branch=%s category=%s products=%s/%s",
            retailer["name_en_normalized"],
            branch_id,
            category_id,
            len(products),
            total,
        )

    if len(products) < total:
        logger.warning(
            "[%s] branch=%s category=%s "
            "INCOMPLETE -> skipping",
            retailer["name_en_normalized"],
            branch_id,
            category_id,
        )
        return None

    data["products"] = products

    data["_metziah"] = {
        "chain_id": retailer["chain_id"],
        "retailer_id": retailer["retailer_id"],
        "branch_id": branch_id,
        "category_id": category_id,
    }

    return data


def scrape_retailer(retailer):
    name = retailer["name_en_normalized"]
    retailer_id = retailer["retailer_id"]

    output_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / name
    output_dir.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    logger.info(
        "[%s] START retailer_id=%s",
        name,
        retailer_id,
    )

    try:
        with httpx.Client(
            headers=HEADERS,
            timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
            follow_redirects=True,
        ) as client:
            frontend_data = get_frontend_data(
                client,
                retailer,
            )

            categories = get_all_categories(
                frontend_data["tree"]["categories"]
            )

            branches = frontend_data["retailer"]["branches"]

            branch_ids = [
                str(branch["id"])
                for branch in branches
            ]

            logger.info(
                "[%s] categories=%s branches=%s",
                name,
                len(categories),
                len(branch_ids),
            )

            for index, category in enumerate(
                categories,
                1,
            ):
                category_id = category["id"]

                output_file = (
                    output_dir
                    / f"{category_id}.json"
                )

                if output_file.exists():
                    logger.info(
                        "[%s] [%s/%s] category=%s "
                        "already saved",
                        name,
                        index,
                        len(categories),
                        category_id,
                    )
                    continue

                logger.info(
                    "[%s] [%s/%s] category=%s",
                    name,
                    index,
                    len(categories),
                    category_id,
                )

                found = False

                for branch_id in branch_ids:
                    data = scrape_category(
                        client=client,
                        retailer=retailer,
                        branch_id=branch_id,
                        category_id=category_id,
                    )

                    if data is None:
                        continue

                    output_file.write_text(
                        json.dumps(
                            data,
                            ensure_ascii=False,
                            indent=2,
                        ),
                        encoding="utf-8",
                    )

                    logger.info(
                        "[%s] category=%s FOUND "
                        "branch=%s -> %s",
                        name,
                        category_id,
                        branch_id,
                        output_file,
                    )

                    found = True
                    break

                if not found:
                    logger.info(
                        "[%s] category=%s "
                        "no products in any branch",
                        name,
                        category_id,
                    )

    except Exception:
        logger.exception(
            "[%s] FAILED",
            name,
        )
        return False

    logger.info(
        "[%s] FINISHED",
        name,
    )

    return True


def main():
    retailers = load_retailers()

    if not retailers:
        logger.warning(
            "No retailers with available=true found"
        )
        return

    logger.info(
        "Found %s available retailers: %s",
        len(retailers),
        ", ".join(
            retailer["name_en_normalized"]
            for retailer in retailers
        ),
    )

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(
        max_workers=min(
            MAX_RETAILERS,
            len(retailers),
        )
    ) as executor:
        futures = {
            executor.submit(
                scrape_retailer,
                retailer,
            ): retailer
            for retailer in retailers
        }

        for future in as_completed(futures):
            retailer = futures[future]
            name = retailer["name_en_normalized"]

            try:
                success = future.result()

                if success:
                    logger.info(
                        "[%s] completed successfully",
                        name,
                    )
                else:
                    logger.error(
                        "[%s] completed with errors",
                        name,
                    )

            except Exception:
                logger.exception(
                    "[%s] worker crashed",
                    name,
                )

    logger.info("All available retailers finished")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
