"""Shared helpers for scrapers/product_pages/type_*.py modules."""

import re


def clean(text):
    """Collapse all whitespace runs into single spaces."""
    return " ".join(text.split())


def split_list(text):
    """Split comma-, newline-, and HTML-break-separated text into a clean list."""
    parts = (
        clean(part)
        for part in re.split(r",|\n|<br\s*/?>", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    )
    return [part for part in parts if part]


def unique(items):
    return list(dict.fromkeys(item for item in items if item))


def add_field(fields, label, value):
    """Labels can repeat (e.g. two kashrut lines), so values are lists."""
    if label and value:
        fields.setdefault(label, []).append(value)


====================================================================================================
FILE: scrapers/product_pages/scraper.py
====================================================================================================

"""
scrapers/product_pages/scraper.py

Scrape product pages (image + full product content) from supermarket
websites for item codes we already have in the database.

Setup:
    Add one example product URL per supermarket to
    scrapers/product_urls.txt (one per line, '#' lines are comments).
    The URL must contain exactly one real barcode that exists on that site.

How it works:
    - The barcode in each URL is swapped for every item code.
    - The site name comes from the domain and must match chains.name_en_normalized.
    - Each site's page is opened once to detect its page type.
    - Add new page structures as scrapers/product_pages/type_*.py modules:
        * page types define MARKER (a selector) and parse(html);
        * API types define matches(payload, item_code) and
          parse(payload, item_code, base_url). They are detected from the
          network traffic of the example page (the only time a browser is
          needed for them), then the captured request is replayed per item
          code with plain HTTP. No browser is used while scraping.

Modes:
    python -m scrapers.product_pages.scraper --item 7290110115227
        Fetch one item from every site and print the JSON. Nothing saved.

    python -m scrapers.product_pages.scraper --item 7290110115227 --save
        Fetch one item from every site, print the JSON, and save found items.
        No DB required.

    python -m scrapers.product_pages.scraper --limit 20
        Fetch the first 20 unsaved item codes per site.

    python -m scrapers.product_pages.scraper
        Fetch all unsaved item codes, 300 items per chunk per site.

Output: data/raw_product_pages/<retail>/<item_code>.json
Re-running skips items that already have a file.
Items the site does not have are appended to _missing.txt.
Failures save nothing, so the next run retries them automatically.
"""

import argparse
import asyncio
import importlib
import json
import logging
import pkgutil
import re
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from difflib import get_close_matches
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Optional
from urllib.parse import urlparse, urlsplit, urlunsplit

import requests
from playwright.async_api import (
    async_playwright,
    TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError,
)


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
URLS_FILE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "product_urls.txt"
TYPES_PACKAGE = "scrapers.product_pages"
OUT_DIR = ROOT / "data" / "raw_product_pages"

DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY = 5
PRODUCT_WAIT_MS = 12_000
CHUNK_SIZE = 10
MAX_CONSECUTIVE_DRIVER_FAILURES = 3

BARCODE_IN_URL = re.compile(r"\d{8,14}")

API_RESOURCE_TYPES = {"xhr", "fetch"}
API_TIMEOUT_S = 30
API_DELAY_S = 2.5          # initial seconds between request starts, per site
API_MIN_DELAY_S = 0.5      # adaptive throttle will not go below this
API_MAX_DELAY_S = 10.0     # adaptive throttle will not go above this
API_SUCCESS_WINDOW = 500    # successful responses before cautiously speeding up
API_DELAY_STEP_S = 0.1    # decrease per successful window
API_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
API_BACKOFF_S = 5          # first wait after a rate limit; doubles each retry
API_MAX_BACKOFF_S = 300
API_RETRY_STATUSES = {429, 502, 503, 504}

# Headers the HTTP layer manages itself; replaying them breaks the request.
SKIPPED_HEADERS = {
    "cookie",
    "content-length",
    "host",
    "connection",
    "accept-encoding",
}

# These are matched case-insensitively against exception messages.
# Keep this list specific to avoid treating ordinary page errors as
# proof that the entire Playwright driver has died.
DRIVER_DEAD = (
    "connection closed while reading from the driver",
    "pipe closed by peer",
)

SQL_ITEM_CODES = """
    SELECT p.item_code
    FROM products p
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM prices pr
        WHERE pr.item_code = p.item_code
          AND pr.chain_id IN (
              SELECT chain_id
              FROM chains
              WHERE name_en_normalized = %s
          )
    )
    ORDER BY p.item_code
"""

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s: %(message)s",
    datefmt="%H:%M:%S",
)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def is_driver_dead(exc):
    """Return True when an exception indicates a disconnected Playwright driver."""
    message = str(exc).casefold()
    return any(marker in message for marker in DRIVER_DEAD)


# ============================================================
# Page types
# ============================================================

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PageType:
    name: str
    marker: Optional[str]
    matches: Optional[Callable]
    prepare: Optional[Callable]
    parse: Callable


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ApiRequest:
    """A captured request, with the item code replaced by {item_code}."""
    method: str
    url: str
    body: Optional[str]
    headers: dict

    def render(self, item_code):
        code = str(item_code)

        def fill(text):
            return text.replace("{item_code}", code)

        return {
            "url": fill(self.url),
            "method": self.method,
            "data": fill(self.body) if self.body is not None else None,
            "headers": {k: fill(v) for k, v in self.headers.items()},
        }


def discover_types():
    """Import every scrapers/product_pages/type_*.py module."""
    package = importlib.import_module(TYPES_PACKAGE)
    types = []

    for info in sorted(pkgutil.iter_modules(package.__path__), key=lambda i: i.name):
        if not info.name.startswith("type_"):
            continue

        module = importlib.import_module(f"{TYPES_PACKAGE}.{info.name}")
        marker = getattr(module, "MARKER", None)
        matches = getattr(module, "matches", None)
        parse = getattr(module, "parse", None)

        if not callable(parse) or not (marker or callable(matches)):
            raise ValueError(
                f"{info.name} must define parse() and either MARKER "
                f"or matches()"
            )

        types.append(
            PageType(
                info.name,
                marker,
                matches if callable(matches) else None,
                getattr(module, "prepare", None),
                parse,
            )
        )

    if not types:
        raise ValueError(f"No page types found in {TYPES_PACKAGE}")

    return types


# ============================================================
# Sites
# ============================================================

class Throttle:
    """Adaptive per-site request pacing with a shared cooldown for all workers."""

    def __init__(self, interval):
        self.interval = max(API_MIN_DELAY_S, min(interval, API_MAX_DELAY_S))
        self._next = 0.0
        self._cooldown_until = 0.0
        self._generation = 0
        self._successes = 0
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def wait(self):
        # Reserve a request slot, then verify that no cooldown was introduced
        # while this worker was sleeping for its turn.
        while True:
            async with self._lock:
                now = time.monotonic()
                if now < self._cooldown_until:
                    delay = self._cooldown_until - now
                    generation = None
                else:
                    slot = max(now, self._next)
                    self._next = slot + self.interval
                    delay = slot - now
                    generation = self._generation

            if delay > 0:
                await asyncio.sleep(delay)

            if generation is None:
                continue

            async with self._lock:
                now = time.monotonic()
                if generation != self._generation or now < self._cooldown_until:
                    continue
                return

    async def success(self):
        """Gradually increase request rate after a sustained run of successes."""
        async with self._lock:
            self._successes += 1
            if self._successes < API_SUCCESS_WINDOW:
                return

            self._successes = 0
            old_interval = self.interval
            self.interval = max(API_MIN_DELAY_S, self.interval - API_DELAY_STEP_S)
            if self.interval < old_interval:
                logger.info(
                    "Adaptive throttle: delay %.2fs -> %.2fs after %s successful responses",
                    old_interval,
                    self.interval,
                    API_SUCCESS_WINDOW,
                )

    async def cooldown(self, seconds):
        """Pause every worker and reduce request rate after a retryable response."""
        async with self._lock:
            now = time.monotonic()
            old_interval = self.interval
            self.interval = min(API_MAX_DELAY_S, max(self.interval * 2, self.interval + 0.5))
            self._successes = 0
            until = now + seconds
            if until > self._cooldown_until:
                self._cooldown_until = until
                self._generation += 1
            self._next = max(self._next, self._cooldown_until)
            if self.interval > old_interval:
                logger.warning(
                    "Adaptive throttle: delay %.2fs -> %.2fs after rate limiting",
                    old_interval,
                    self.interval,
                )




@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Site:
    name: str
    url_template: str
    page_type: PageType
    api: Optional[ApiRequest] = None
    throttle: Throttle = field(default_factory=lambda: Throttle(API_DELAY_S))


def site_name(url):
    """Match a retailer hostname to its closest normalized database chain name."""
    host = urlparse(url).netloc.lower().removeprefix("www.")
    hostname = host.split(".")[0].replace("-", " ")

    from db import get_connection

    with get_connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SELECT name_en_normalized FROM chains")
        chain_names = [row[0] for row in cur.fetchall() if row[0]]

    matches = get_close_matches(hostname, chain_names, n=1, cutoff=0.65)
    return matches[0] if matches else hostname


def read_site_entries():
    """Return (name, example_url, url_template, example_code) entries."""
    entries = []

    for line in URLS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        url = line.strip()
        if not url or url.startswith("#"):
            continue

        codes = set(BARCODE_IN_URL.findall(url))
        if len(codes) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"Expected exactly one barcode in URL: {url}")

        code = codes.pop()
        template = url.replace(code, "{item_code}")
        entries.append((site_name(url), url, template, code))

    return entries


def request_body(request):
    """Request body as text, or None if there is none or it is binary."""
    try:
        return request.post_data
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return None


def build_api_request(request, item_code):
    """Turn a captured request into a template by swapping out the item code."""
    code = str(item_code)

    def swap(text):
        return text.replace(code, "{item_code}")

    body = request_body(request)

    return ApiRequest(
        method=request.method,
        url=swap(request.url),
        body=swap(body) if body is not None else None,
        headers={
            key: swap(value)
            for key, value in request.headers.items()
            if key.lower() not in SKIPPED_HEADERS and not key.startswith(":")
        },
    )


async def match_api(response, item_code, api_types):
    """Return (page_type, ApiRequest) if this response is a product payload."""
    request = response.request

    if request.resource_type not in API_RESOURCE_TYPES:
        return None

    # The request must carry the code, or it cannot be replayed per item.
    code = str(item_code)
    if code not in request.url and code not in (request_body(request) or ""):
        return None

    try:
        payload = await response.json()
    except Exception:
        return None

    for page_type in api_types:
        if page_type.matches(payload, code):
            return page_type, build_api_request(request, code)

    return None


async def detect_type(context, name, example_url, example_code, types):
    """
    Open the example page once and find which type fits it.

    Returns (page_type, api_request). api_request is None for page types,
    and the replayable request template for API types.
    """
    api_types = [t for t in types if t.matches]
    page_types = [t for t in types if t.marker]
    combined = ", ".join(t.marker for t in page_types)

    captured = []
    page = await context.new_page()
    page.on("response", lambda response: captured.append(response))

    try:
        await page.goto(
            example_url,
            wait_until="domcontentloaded",
            timeout=60_000,
        )

        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        deadline = loop.time() + (PRODUCT_WAIT_MS * 2) / 1000
        seen = 0

        while True:
            while seen < len(captured):
                response = captured[seen]
                seen += 1

                found = await match_api(response, example_code, api_types)
                if found:
                    page_type, api = found
                    logger.info(
                        "[%s] detected page type: %s (api)",
                        name,
                        page_type.name,
                    )
                    return page_type, api

            if combined:
                for page_type in page_types:
                    if await page.locator(page_type.marker).count():
                        logger.info(
                            "[%s] detected page type: %s",
                            name,
                            page_type.name,
                        )
                        return page_type, None

            if loop.time() >= deadline:
                break

            await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    finally:
        await page.close()

    raise ValueError(
        f"[{name}] no known page type matched {example_url}. "
        f"Check the URL has a real product, or add a type file "
        f"in {TYPES_PACKAGE.replace('.', '/')}/"
    )


# ============================================================
# Database
# ============================================================

def load_item_codes(site_name_):
    # Imported here so --item works without a DB connection.
    from db import get_connection

    with get_connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(SQL_ITEM_CODES, (site_name_,))
        return [row[0] for row in cur.fetchall()]


# ============================================================
# Scraping
# ============================================================

async def block_heavy(route):
    if route.request.resource_type in {"image", "media", "font"}:
        await route.abort()
    else:
        await route.continue_()


async def new_context(browser):
    context = await browser.new_context(
        viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 1000},
        locale="he-IL",
    )
    await context.route("**/*", block_heavy)
    return context


async def fetch_html(page, site, url):
    """Open a product page; return HTML, or None if there is no product."""
    response = await page.goto(
        url,
        wait_until="domcontentloaded",
        timeout=60_000,
    )

    if response is not None and response.status == 404:
        return None

    try:
        await page.wait_for_selector(
            site.page_type.marker,
            timeout=PRODUCT_WAIT_MS,
        )
    except PlaywrightTimeoutError:
        return None

    if site.page_type.prepare:
        await site.page_type.prepare(page)

    return await page.content()


def request_api(site, item_code):
    """Replay the captured request with plain HTTP; returns the response."""
    spec = site.api.render(item_code)

    return requests.request(
        spec["method"],
        spec["url"],
        headers=spec["headers"],
        data=spec["data"].encode("utf-8") if spec["data"] is not None else None,
        timeout=API_TIMEOUT_S,
    )


def retry_after_seconds(response):
    """Seconds from a Retry-After header, or None."""
    value = response.headers.get("Retry-After", "")
    return int(value) if value.isdigit() else None


async def fetch_api(site, item_code):
    """JSON payload, or None if the site has no such item. Backs off on rate limits."""
    for attempt in range(1, API_MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
        await site.throttle.wait()
        response = await asyncio.to_thread(request_api, site, item_code)

        if response.status_code == 404:
            await site.throttle.success()
            return None

        if response.status_code in API_RETRY_STATUSES:
            wait = retry_after_seconds(response) or min(
                API_BACKOFF_S * 2 ** (attempt - 1),
                API_MAX_BACKOFF_S,
            )
            await site.throttle.cooldown(wait)
            logger.warning(
                "[%s] HTTP %s on %s, pausing %ss (attempt %s/%s)",
                site.name,
                response.status_code,
                item_code,
                wait,
                attempt,
                API_MAX_ATTEMPTS,
            )
            continue

        response.raise_for_status()
        await site.throttle.success()
        return response.json()

    raise RuntimeError(f"still rate limited after {API_MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts")


async def scrape_item(context, site, item_code):
    """Return the result dict, or None if the site has no such product."""
    url = site.url_template.replace("{item_code}", str(item_code))

    if site.api:
        payload = await fetch_api(site, item_code)
        if payload is None:
            return None

        parsed = site.page_type.parse(
            payload,
            item_code,
            image_base_url(url),
        )
    else:
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            html = await fetch_html(page, site, url)
        finally:
            await page.close()

        if html is None:
            return None

        parsed = site.page_type.parse(html)

    if parsed is None:
        return None

    if parsed.get("page_code") and str(parsed["page_code"]) != str(item_code):
        logger.warning(
            "[%s] %s page shows a different code: %s",
            site.name,
            item_code,
            parsed["page_code"],
        )

    return {
        "item_code": item_code,
        "source": site.name,
        "url": url,
        "scraped_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        **parsed,
    }


def save_result(out_dir, item_code, result):
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = out_dir / f"{item_code}.json"
    tmp = path.with_suffix(".json.tmp")

    tmp.write_text(
        json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    tmp.replace(path)  # A half-written file never counts as done.


async def worker(worker_id, context, site, queue, stats, out_dir, total):
    while True:
        try:
            item_code = queue.get_nowait()
        except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
            return

        try:
            result = await scrape_item(context, site, item_code)

            if result is None:
                stats["missing"] += 1
                with (out_dir / "_missing.txt").open(
                    "a",
                    encoding="utf-8",
                ) as file:
                    file.write(str(item_code) + "\n")
            else:
                save_result(out_dir, item_code, result)
                stats["saved"] += 1

        except Exception as exc:
            if is_driver_dead(exc):
                logger.error(
                    "[%s] worker %s detected a disconnected Playwright driver "
                    "while processing item %s",
                    site.name,
                    worker_id,
                    item_code,
                )
                raise

            stats["failed"] += 1
            logger.exception("[%s] %s failed", site.name, item_code)

        done = stats["saved"] + stats["missing"] + stats["failed"]
        if done and done % 50 == 0:
            logger.info("[%s] %s/%s done %s", site.name, done, total, stats)


async def run_site(browser, site, item_codes, concurrency):
    out_dir = OUT_DIR / site.page_type.name / site.name
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    queue = asyncio.Queue()
    for code in item_codes:
        queue.put_nowait(code)

    stats = {"saved": 0, "missing": 0, "failed": 0}
    context = await new_context(browser) if browser else None

    tasks = [
        asyncio.create_task(
            worker(
                worker_id,
                context,
                site,
                queue,
                stats,
                out_dir,
                len(item_codes),
            )
        )
        for worker_id in range(1, min(concurrency, len(item_codes)) + 1)
    ]

    try:
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    except BaseException:
        # gather() does not automatically cancel its sibling tasks when one
        # raises. Cancel and await them before closing their shared context.
        for task in tasks:
            if not task.done():
                task.cancel()

        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        raise
    finally:
        if context:
            try:
                await context.close()
            except Exception:
                logger.debug(
                    "[%s] context.close failed; the driver may already be disconnected",
                    site.name,
                    exc_info=True,
                )

    logger.info("[%s] finished: %s", site.name, stats)


async def run_site_chunked(site, item_codes, concurrency, headless):
    if site.api:
        await run_site(None, site, item_codes, concurrency)
        return

    failed_chunks = 0

    for i in range(0, len(item_codes), CHUNK_SIZE):
        chunk = item_codes[i:i + CHUNK_SIZE]

        try:
            async with async_playwright() as playwright:
                browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=headless)

                try:
                    await run_site(browser, site, chunk, concurrency)
                finally:
                    try:
                        await browser.close()
                    except Exception:
                        logger.debug(
                            "[%s] browser.close failed; browser may already be disconnected",
                            site.name,
                            exc_info=True,
                        )

            failed_chunks = 0

        except Exception as exc:
            if not is_driver_dead(exc):
                raise

            failed_chunks += 1
            logger.error(
                "[%s] chunk starting at %s failed: Playwright driver disconnected "
                "(consecutive failures: %s/%s)",
                site.name,
                i,
                failed_chunks,
                MAX_CONSECUTIVE_DRIVER_FAILURES,
            )

            if failed_chunks >= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_DRIVER_FAILURES:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"[{site.name}] Playwright driver disconnected for "
                    f"{failed_chunks} consecutive chunks; stopping."
                ) from exc


def image_base_url(page_url):
    """Build the image CDN base URL from the product page URL."""
    parts = urlsplit(page_url)
    hostname = parts.hostname or ""

    if hostname.startswith("www."):
        hostname = "img." + hostname[4:]

    netloc = hostname
    if parts.port:
        netloc = f"{hostname}:{parts.port}"

    return urlunsplit((parts.scheme, netloc, "/", "", ""))



# ============================================================
# Main
# ============================================================

async def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Scrape supermarket product pages."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--item",
        help="Fetch one item code from every site.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--save",
        action="store_true",
        help="With --item: also save the JSON to the output folder.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--site",
        help="Only this site, e.g. 'chain name' or 'chain-name'.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--limit",
        type=int,
        help="Max item codes per site (test runs).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--concurrency",
        type=int,
        default=DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--skip-missing",
        action="store_true",
        help="Skip codes listed in _missing.txt from earlier runs.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--delay",
        type=float,
        default=API_DELAY_S,
        help="API sites: initial seconds between requests; adapts automatically (default: 2).",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--headless", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.save and not args.item:
        parser.error("--save requires --item")

    types = discover_types()
    entries = read_site_entries()

    if args.site:
        wanted = args.site.strip().casefold().replace("-", " ")
        entries = [entry for entry in entries if entry[0] == wanted]

    if not entries:
        logger.error("No matching sites")
        return

    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=args.headless)

        try:
            # Detect each site's page type once.
            sites = []
            context = await new_context(browser)

            try:
                for name, example_url, template, example_code in entries:
                    page_type, api = await detect_type(
                        context,
                        name,
                        example_url,
                        example_code,
                        types,
                    )
                    sites.append(
                        Site(name, template, page_type, api, Throttle(args.delay))
                    )
            finally:
                try:
                    await context.close()
                except Exception:
                    logger.debug(
                        "Initial detection context cleanup failed",
                        exc_info=True,
                    )

            if args.item:
                for site in sites:
                    context = None if site.api else await new_context(browser)

                    try:
                        result = await scrape_item(
                            context,
                            site,
                            args.item,
                        )
                    finally:
                        if context:
                            try:
                                await context.close()
                            except Exception:
                                logger.debug(
                                    "[%s] context cleanup failed",
                                    site.name,
                                    exc_info=True,
                                )

                    print(
                        json.dumps(
                            result or {
                                "item_code": args.item,
                                "source": site.name,
                                "found": False,
                            },
                            ensure_ascii=False,
                            indent=2,
                        )
                    )

                    if args.save and result:
                        save_result(
                            OUT_DIR / site.name,
                            args.item,
                            result,
                        )
                        logger.info(
                            "[%s] saved -> %s",
                            site.name,
                            (
                                OUT_DIR
                                / site.name
                                / f"{args.item}.json"
                            ).relative_to(ROOT),
                        )

                return

            for site in sites:
                codes = load_item_codes(site.name)

                if not codes:
                    logger.error(
                        "[%s] no item codes found in the DB",
                        site.name,
                    )
                    continue

                out_dir = OUT_DIR / site.page_type.name / site.name
                skip = {path.stem for path in out_dir.glob("*.json")}

                missing_file = out_dir / "_missing.txt"
                if args.skip_missing and missing_file.exists():
                    skip |= set(
                        missing_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split()
                    )

                remaining = [
                    code for code in codes
                    if str(code) not in skip
                ]

                if args.limit:
                    remaining = remaining[:args.limit]

                logger.info(
                    "[%s] %s codes in DB, %s to fetch",
                    site.name,
                    len(codes),
                    len(remaining),
                )

                if remaining:
                    await run_site_chunked(
                        site,
                        remaining,
                        args.concurrency,
                        args.headless,
                    )
        finally:
            try:
                await browser.close()
            except Exception:
                logger.debug(
                    "Main browser cleanup failed",
                    exc_info=True,
                )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""
Type 1: server-rendered product page.

Product content is a <ul class="productContainer"> whose <li> children
are sections, each with a .title and an .info block.
"""

from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

from scrapers.product_pages.common import add_field, clean, split_list, unique


MARKER = ".productContainer"



def _parse_nutrients(info):
    nutrients = {}

    for item in info.select(".nutritionItem"):
        number = item.select_one(".number")
        unit = item.select_one(".name")
        name = item.select_one(".text")
        if not number or not unit or not name:
            continue

        value = number.get("title")
        nutrient_name = clean(name.get_text(" "))
        if not value or not nutrient_name:
            continue

        try:
            numeric = float(value)
            value = int(numeric) if numeric.is_integer() else numeric
        except ValueError:
            pass

        nutrients[nutrient_name] = {
            "value": value,
            "unit": clean(unit.get_text(" ")),
        }

    return nutrients


def _parse_info(info):
    """Parse one section's .info block by what it contains."""
    if info.select_one("ul.dataList"):
        fields = {}
        for box in info.select("ul.dataList .box"):
            name = box.select_one(".name")
            text = box.select_one(".text")
            if name and text:
                add_field(
                    fields,
                    clean(name.get_text(" ")).rstrip(":").strip(),
                    clean(text.get_text(" ")),
                )
        return fields

    if info.select_one(".markingItem"):
        return unique(
            clean(el.get_text(" ")) for el in info.select(".markingItem .text")
        )

    el = info.select_one(".featuresList, .alergiesProperties")
    if el:
        return split_list(el.get_text("\n"))

    el = info.select_one(".componentsText")
    if el:
        return clean(el.get_text(" "))

    return clean(info.get_text(" "))


def _parse_categories(soup):
    """Parse the product breadcrumb into an ordered list of category names."""
    breadcrumb = soup.select_one(
        'section.breadcrumbSection ol[itemtype="https://schema.org/BreadcrumbList"]'
    )
    if not breadcrumb:
        return []

    categories = []

    for li in breadcrumb.find_all("li", recursive=False):
        name_el = li.select_one(
            ':scope > [itemprop="item"] > [itemprop="name"]'
        )
        if not name_el:
            continue

        name = clean(name_el.get_text(" "))
        if name:
            categories.append({"1": name})

    return categories


def parse(html):
    """Return a dict with page_code, name, images, categories + type-specific fields."""
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

    container = soup.select_one(MARKER)
    if not container:
        return None

    code_el = container.select_one(".productCode .text")
    page_code = clean(code_el.get_text()) if code_el else None

    image_els = soup.select('img[itemprop="image"]')
    images = unique(img.get("src") for img in image_els)
    name = next((img.get("alt") for img in image_els if img.get("alt")), None)

    categories = _parse_categories(soup)

    sections = []
    for li in container.find_all("li", recursive=False):
        title_el = li.select_one(".title .mainInfo")
        info = li.select_one(".info")
        if not title_el or not info:
            continue

        if info.select_one(".nutritionList"):
            sub = li.select_one(".title .subInfo")
            content = {
                "for": clean(sub.get_text(" ")) if sub else None,
                "nutrients": _parse_nutrients(info),
            }
            if not content["nutrients"]:
                continue
        else:
            content = _parse_info(info)

        if content:
            sections.append(
                {
                    "title": clean(title_el.get_text(" ")),
                    "content": content,
                }
            )

    product_details = {}
    details_el = soup.select_one("div.productDetails")
    if details_el:
        shipping = unique(
            clean(li.get_text(" ")) for li in details_el.select("ul.productShip li")
        )
        variants = unique(
            clean(li.get_text(" ")) for li in details_el.select("ul.productVariants li")
        )
        if shipping:
            product_details["shipping"] = shipping
        if variants:
            product_details["variants"] = variants

    result = {
        "page_code": page_code,
        "name": name,
        "images": images,
        "categories": categories,
        "sections": sections,
    }

    if product_details:
        result["product_details"] = product_details

    return result

FILE: scrapers/product_pages/type_2.py

"""
Type 2: product data served as JSON by an API call.

There is no DOM marker. The scraper detects this type by watching the
network traffic of the example product page: a JSON response that contains
the example item code, from a request that also contains that code, means
the site exposes its product data through an API. The scraper then replays
that request with the code swapped, and hands the JSON to parse().

Nothing here is tied to a site. The product is located by searching the
JSON for the item code, and fields are picked with generic key/format
heuristics. Everything else is kept untouched under "details".
"""

import re
from collections import deque
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit, urlunsplit

from scrapers.product_pages.common import clean, unique


# Common keys a product name is stored under, in priority order.
NAME_KEYS = ("name", "title", "product_name", "item_name", "productName", "itemName")

IMAGE_URL = re.compile(
    r"\.(?:jpe?g|png|webp|gif|avif|svg)(?:[?#].*)?$",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def _children(node):
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        return node.values()
    if isinstance(node, list):
        return node
    return ()


def find_product(payload, item_code):
    """Return the outermost dict that holds the item code as a value, or None."""
    code = str(item_code)
    queue = deque([payload])

    while queue:
        node = queue.popleft()

        if isinstance(node, dict):
            for value in node.values():
                if not isinstance(value, (dict, list)) and str(value) == code:
                    return node

        queue.extend(_children(node))

    return None


def _strings(node):
    """Yield every string anywhere inside a JSON value."""
    stack = [node]

    while stack:
        current = stack.pop()

        if isinstance(current, str):
            yield current
        else:
            stack.extend(_children(current))


def _image_path(value):
    """Extract the path from an image URL or relative image path."""
    path = urlsplit(value).path
    return path if IMAGE_URL.search(path) else None


def _image_base_url(page_url):
    """Build the image CDN base URL from the product page URL."""
    parts = urlsplit(page_url)
    hostname = parts.hostname or ""

    if hostname.startswith("www."):
        hostname = "img." + hostname[4:]

    netloc = hostname

    if parts.port:
        netloc = f"{hostname}:{parts.port}"

    return urlunsplit((parts.scheme, netloc, "/", "", ""))


def matches(payload, item_code):
    """Detection hook: is this JSON response a product payload for the code?"""
    return find_product(payload, item_code) is not None


def parse(payload, item_code, base_url):
    """Return a dict with page_code, name, images, and the full product record."""
    product = find_product(payload, item_code)

    if product is None:
        return None

    name = None

    for key in NAME_KEYS:
        value = product.get(key)

        if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
            name = clean(value)
            break

    # Extract only product images, excluding unrelated images such as banners.
    image_data = product.get("images", {})

    image_base_url = _image_base_url(base_url)

    images = unique(
        [
            urljoin(image_base_url, path)
            for text in _strings(image_data)
            if (path := _image_path(text))
        ]
    )

    return {
        "page_code": str(item_code),
        "name": name,
        "images": images,
        "details": product,
    }

# tests/analytics/test_common.py
from datetime import datetime

from analytics.log_parsers import common

TEST_CHAINS = {"9999999999999": {"name_en_normalized": "test chain 9999"}}


def test_parse_timestamp():
    assert common.parse_timestamp("2026-09-26 02:06:02,380") == datetime(2026, 9, 26, 2, 6, 2, 380000)


def test_iter_log_entries_folds_traceback(tmp_path):
    text = (
        "2026-09-26 02:12:46,396 [ERROR] utils.prices.update_prices: Failed to load /path/foo.gz\n"
        "Traceback (most recent call last):\n"
        '  File "x.py", line 1, in <module>\n'
        "    raise ValueError\n"
        "ValueError: boom\n"
        "2026-09-26 02:12:47,000 [INFO] root: next entry\n"
    )
    path = tmp_path / "scheduler.log"
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    entries = list(common.iter_log_entries(path))

    assert len(entries) == 2
    assert entries[0].level == "ERROR"
    assert entries[0].message == "Failed to load /path/foo.gz"
    assert entries[0].extra_lines == [
        "Traceback (most recent call last):",
        '  File "x.py", line 1, in <module>',
        "    raise ValueError",
        "ValueError: boom",
    ]
    assert "ValueError: boom" in entries[0].full_message
    assert entries[1].message == "next entry"


def test_iter_log_entries_ignores_blank_lines_between(tmp_path):
    text = (
        "2026-09-26 02:06:02,380 [INFO] root: first\n"
        "\n"
        "2026-09-26 02:06:03,380 [INFO] root: second\n"
    )
    path = tmp_path / "scheduler.log"
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    entries = list(common.iter_log_entries(path))
    assert [e.message for e in entries] == ["first", "second"]
    assert entries[0].extra_lines == []


def test_find_rotated_logs_returns_current_log(tmp_path):
    for name in (
        "scheduler.log",
        "scheduler.log.3",
        "scheduler.log.2026-09-26",
        "scheduler.test.log",
        "price_changes.log",
        "scheduler.logfoo",
    ):
        (tmp_path / name).write_text("x")

    found = {p.name for p in common.find_rotated_logs(tmp_path, "scheduler")}
    assert found == {"scheduler.log"}


def test_find_rotated_logs_returns_requested_date(tmp_path):
    for name in (
        "scheduler.log",
        "scheduler.log.3",
        "scheduler.log.2026-09-26",
        "scheduler.log.2026-09-27",
        "scheduler.test.log",

        "scheduler.logfoo",
    ):

    assert common.format_timedelta(3725) == "1h 2m 5s"

        common.LogEntry(datetime(2026, 9, 26, 3, 0, 0), "INFO", "root", "b"),

    assert common.chain_name("unknown_chain_id") == "unknown_chain_id"


def test_safe_db_call_success_and_failure():
    ok_result, err = common.safe_db_call(lambda: 42)
    assert ok_result == 42 and err is None

    def _boom():
        raise RuntimeError("db down")

    result, err = common.safe_db_call(_boom, default="fallback")
    assert result == "fallback"
    assert "db down" in err


def test_write_report_round_trips(tmp_path):
    data = {"a": 1, "nested": {"b": 2}}
    txt_lines = ["line one", "line two"]

    assert json_path == tmp_path / "2026-09-26" / "report_scheduler.json"
    assert txt_path == tmp_path / "2026-09-26" / "report_scheduler.txt"

    import json
    assert json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == data
    assert txt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "line one\nline two\n"

# tests/analytics/test_errors.py
from analytics.log_parsers import errors

SAMPLE_LOG = """\
2026-09-26 02:12:44,539 [ERROR] downloaders.common: FAILED downloading Price9999999999999-018-773-20260926-010000.gz
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "common.py", line 161, in save_file_async
    content = await fetch_content()
httpx.HTTPStatusError: Client error '404 The specified blob does not exist.' for url 'https://x.blob.core.windows.net/price/foo.gz?sv=2014-02-14&sig=AAAA'
2026-09-26 02:12:44,600 [ERROR] downloaders.common: FAILED downloading Price9999999999999-019-773-20260926-010000.gz
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "common.py", line 161, in save_file_async
    content = await fetch_content()
httpx.HTTPStatusError: Client error '404 The specified blob does not exist.' for url 'https://x.blob.core.windows.net/price/bar.gz?sv=2014-02-14&sig=BBBB'
2026-09-26 02:12:46,396 [ERROR] utils.prices.update_prices: Failed to load /path/foo.gz
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "utils/prices/update_prices.py", line 601, in load_files
    file_had_prices = load_one_file(
psycopg.errors.ForeignKeyViolation: insert or update on table "prices_9999999999999" violates foreign key constraint
2026-09-26 02:20:00,000 [WARNING] root: not an error, should be ignored
"""


def test_errors_parse(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "scheduler.log"
    path.write_text(SAMPLE_LOG, encoding="utf-8")
    data, txt_lines = errors.parse([path])

    assert data["total_errors"] == 3
    assert data["other_error_count"] == 1

    assert len(data["download_failures"]) == 1
    bucket = next(iter(data["download_failures"].values()))
    assert bucket["count"] == 2
    assert set(bucket["filenames"]) == {
        "Price9999999999999-018-773-20260926-010000.gz",
        "Price9999999999999-019-773-20260926-010000.gz",
    }

    fk_error = next(e for e in data["raw_errors"] if "ForeignKeyViolation" in e["message"])
    assert "load_files" in fk_error["message"]

    assert any("Full error log" in line for line in txt_lines)


def test_errors_no_error_lines_returns_zero(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "scheduler.log"
    path.write_text("2026-09-26 02:00:00,000 [INFO] root: all fine\n", encoding="utf-8")
    data, _ = errors.parse([path])
    assert data["total_errors"] == 0
    assert data["download_failures"] == {}


def test_errors_reads_multiple_source_files(tmp_path):
    p1 = tmp_path / "scheduler.log"
    p1.write_text("2026-09-26 02:00:00,000 [ERROR] root: err one\n", encoding="utf-8")
    p2 = tmp_path / "price_changes.log"
    p2.write_text("2026-09-26 02:00:01,000 [ERROR] price_changes: err two\n", encoding="utf-8")
    data, _ = errors.parse([p1, p2])
    assert data["total_errors"] == 2
    sources = {e["source_file"] for e in data["raw_errors"]}
    assert sources == {"scheduler.log", "price_changes.log"}

# tests/analytics/test_price_changes.py
from analytics.log_parsers import common, price_changes

CHAIN = "9999999999999"
OTHER_CHAIN = "8888888888888"
TEST_CHAINS = {CHAIN: {"name_en_normalized": "test chain 9999"}, OTHER_CHAIN: {"name_en_normalized": "test chain 8888"}}


def _patch_chains(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(price_changes.common, "_chain_cache", None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(price_changes.common, "load_chains", lambda *a, **kw: TEST_CHAINS)


def _log(*lines):
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def _many_stores(create_store, chain_id, n):
    store_ids = [str(i) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
    for sid in store_ids:
        create_store(chain_id, sid)
    return store_ids


def _seed_product(conn, item_code):
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO products (item_code, name) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT (item_code) DO NOTHING",
            (item_code, "test product"),
        )
    conn.commit()


def test_price_changes_per_chain_counts(tmp_path, monkeypatch, create_store, cleanup_test_chains):
    _patch_chains(monkeypatch)
    _many_stores(create_store, CHAIN, 1)
    text = _log(
        f"2026-09-26 02:21:14,639 [INFO] price_changes: PRICE ADDED chain_id={CHAIN} store_id=1 item_code=111 price=11.90",
        f"2026-09-26 02:21:15,000 [INFO] price_changes: PRICE CHANGED chain_id={CHAIN} store_id=1 item_code=222 old_price=6.00 new_price=6.50 old_unit_price=6.00 new_unit_price=6.50",
        f"2026-09-26 02:21:16,000 [INFO] price_changes: ITEM REMOVED chain_id={CHAIN} store_id=1 item_code=333 (was price=5.00)",
    )
    path = tmp_path / "price_changes.log"
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    data, txt_lines = price_changes.parse([path])

    assert data["counts"] == {"added": 1, "changed": 1, "removed": 1}
    assert data["per_chain"][CHAIN] == {"chain_name": "test chain 9999", "added": 1, "changed": 1, "removed": 1}
    assert any("Price changes report" in l for l in txt_lines)


def test_reintroduced_same_run_detected(tmp_path, monkeypatch, create_store, cleanup_test_chains):
    _patch_chains(monkeypatch)
    _many_stores(create_store, CHAIN, 1)
    text = _log(
        f"2026-09-26 02:20:00,000 [INFO] price_changes: ITEM REMOVED chain_id={CHAIN} store_id=1 item_code=111 (was price=11.90)",
        f"2026-09-26 02:21:14,639 [INFO] price_changes: PRICE ADDED chain_id={CHAIN} store_id=1 item_code=111 price=11.90",
    )
    path = tmp_path / "price_changes.log"
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    data, _ = price_changes.parse([path])

    assert len(data["reintroduced_same_run"]) == 1
    assert data["reintroduced_same_run"][0]["item_code"] == "111"


def test_reintroduced_not_flagged_if_added_before_removed(tmp_path, monkeypatch, create_store, cleanup_test_chains):

def test_duplicate_events_same_store(tmp_path, monkeypatch, create_store, cleanup_test_chains):
    _patch_chains(monkeypatch)

    text = _log(

        f"2026-09-26 02:10:01,000 [INFO] price_changes: PRICE CHANGED chain_id={CHAIN} store_id=1 item_code=111 old_price=11.90 new_price=12.00 old_unit_price=11.90 new_unit_price=12.00",

def test_substantial_price_change_threshold(tmp_path, monkeypatch, create_store, cleanup_test_chains):
    _patch_chains(monkeypatch)
    _many_stores(create_store, CHAIN, 1)
    text = _log(
        f"2026-09-26 02:10:00,000 [INFO] price_changes: PRICE CHANGED chain_id={CHAIN} store_id=1 item_code=111 old_price=12.00 new_price=13.00 old_unit_price=12.00 new_unit_price=13.00",

# tests/analytics/test_promo_changes.py
from analytics.log_parsers import promo_changes

CHAIN = "9999999999999"
OTHER_CHAIN = "8888888888888"
TEST_CHAINS = {CHAIN: {"name_en_normalized": "test chain 9999"}, OTHER_CHAIN: {"name_en_normalized": "test chain 8888"}}


def _patch_chains(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(promo_changes.common, "_chain_cache", None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(promo_changes.common, "load_chains", lambda *a, **kw: TEST_CHAINS)


def _log(*lines):
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def _many_stores(create_store, chain_id, n):
    store_ids = [str(i) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
    for sid in store_ids:
        create_store(chain_id, sid)
    return store_ids


def _seed_price(conn, chain_id, store_id, item_code, price):
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO prices (chain_id, store_id, item_code, price)
            VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s)
            ON CONFLICT (chain_id, store_id, item_code) DO UPDATE SET price = EXCLUDED.price
            """,
            (chain_id, store_id, item_code, price),
        )
    conn.commit()


def _seed_promotion(conn, chain_id, promotion_id, store_id):
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO promotions (chain_id, promotion_id, store_id, description)
            VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s)
            ON CONFLICT (chain_id, promotion_id, store_id) DO NOTHING
            """,
            (chain_id, promotion_id, store_id, "test promo"),
        )
    conn.commit()


def _seed_product(conn, item_code):
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO products (item_code, name) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT (item_code) DO NOTHING",
            (item_code, "test product"),
        )
    conn.commit()

        f"2026-09-26 02:38:32,570 [INFO] promo_changes: PROMO ITEM CHANGED chain_id={CHAIN} store_id=1 promotion_id=P1 group_id=1 item_code=222 name=other item old=(Decimal('10.00'), None) new=(Decimal('20.00'), None)",
        f"2026-09-26 02:39:23,541 [INFO] promo_changes: PROMO ITEM REMOVED chain_id={CHAIN} store_id=1 promotion_id=P1 group_id=1 item_code=333 name=removed item",
    )
    path = tmp_path / "promo_changes.log"
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

    assert data["counts"]["promotions_added"] == 1
    assert data["counts"]["items_added"] == 1
    assert data["counts"]["items_changed"] == 1
    assert data["counts"]["items_removed"] == 1
    assert data["per_chain"][CHAIN]["chain_name"] == "test chain 9999"
    assert any("Promo changes report" in l for l in txt_lines)

    for i in range(50):
        code = f"{1000 + i}"
        _seed_price(conn, CHAIN, "1", code, 10.00 + i)
        lines.append(
            f"2026-09-26 02:59:{i % 60:02d},000 [INFO] promo_changes: PROMO ITEM ADDED "
            f"chain_id={CHAIN} store_id=1 promotion_id=P1 group_id=1 item_code={code} "
            f"name=item{i} discounted_price={5.00 + i}"
        )
    path = tmp_path / "promo_changes.log"
    path.write_text(_log(*lines), encoding="utf-8")
    data, _ = promo_changes.parse([path])

    assert len(data["discounts"]) == 50
    by_code = {d["item_code"]: d for d in data["discounts"]}
    assert by_code["1000"]["normal_price"] == 10.00
    assert by_code["1049"]["normal_price"] == 59.00

from analytics.log_parsers import scheduler

"""


def test_scheduler_parse_full_sample(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _patch_chains(monkeypatch)
    path = tmp_path / "scheduler.log"
    path.write_text(SAMPLE_LOG, encoding="utf-8")
    data, txt_lines = scheduler.parse([path])

    assert data["run_date"] == "2026-09-26"

    ft_phase = next(p for p in data["phase_timings"] if p["phase"] == "file_tracking_update")
    assert ft_phase["new_files"] == "2126"
    assert ft_phase["elapsed_seconds"] == 158.594

    pf_phase = next(p for p in data["phase_timings"] if p["phase"] == "pricesfull_download")
    assert pf_phase["new_files"] == "810"

    assert data["source_file_counts"] == {"PublishedPrices": 1445, "Carrefour": 7}
    assert data["file_tracking_inserted"] == {"inserted": 2126, "discovered": 2126}

    assert data["pricefull_missing_count"] == 2
    assert "אושר עד" in data["pricefull_missing"]

    assert data["no_items_parsed_by_chain"]["9999999999999"]["count"] == 1
    assert data["no_items_parsed_by_chain"]["9999999999999"]["chain_name"] == "test chain 9999"
    assert data["no_prices_found_by_chain"]["9999999999999"]["count"] == 1
    assert data["no_valid_promotions_by_chain"]["9999999999999"]["count"] == 1

    assert data["unmatched_line_count"] == 1
    assert "some brand new line format" in data["unmatched_samples"][0]

    discovery = data["product_discovery_events"][0]
    assert discovery["new_products"] == 3
    assert discovery["store_product_records"] == 9775

    price_agg = data["price_file_loads_by_chain"]["9999999999999"]
    assert price_agg["files"] == 1
    assert price_agg["items"] == 156

    promo_agg = data["promo_file_loads_by_chain"]["9999999999999"]
    assert promo_agg["promotions"] == 2875
    assert promo_agg["removed_promotions"] == 30

    assert data["file_sizes_finished"] == {"updated": 2004, "missing": 231}
    assert any("Scheduler report" in line for line in txt_lines)


def test_scheduler_multiple_files_merged_and_sorted(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _patch_chains(monkeypatch)
    p1 = tmp_path / "scheduler.log.1"
    p1.write_text("2026-09-26 02:06:02,380 [INFO] root: Updating file tracking\n", encoding="utf-8")
    p2 = tmp_path / "scheduler.log.2"
    p2.write_text("2026-09-26 02:08:40,974 [INFO] root: File tracking updated: 5 new file(s)\n", encoding="utf-8")

    data, _ = scheduler.parse([p1, p2])
    assert len(data["phase_timings"]) == 1
    assert data["phase_timings"][0]["new_files"] == "5"


def test_scheduler_ignores_file_not_found_line(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _patch_chains(monkeypatch)
    text = (
        "2026-09-26 02:59:51,317 [WARNING] utils.file_tracking.data_enrichment.populate_file_sizes: "
        "File not found: id=1 path=/x.gz\n"
    )
    path = tmp_path / "scheduler.log"
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    data, _ = scheduler.parse([path])
    assert data["unmatched_line_count"] == 0
    assert data["file_sizes_finished"] is None

def _event(
    chain_id=CHAIN_ID,
    store_id=NEARBY_STORE_ID,
    promotion_id=TEST_PROMOTION_ID,
    group_id=TEST_GROUP_ID,
    item_code=TEST_ITEM_CODE,
    chain_name="Test Chain",
):
    return {
        "chain_id": chain_id,
        "store_id": store_id,
        "promotion_id": promotion_id,
        "group_id": group_id,
        "item_code": item_code,
        "chain_name": chain_name,
        "name": f"Item {item_code}",
        "normal_price": Decimal("15"),
        "discounted_price": Decimal("11"),
        "discount_pct": Decimal("26.67"),
    }


def _insert_store(conn, store_id, lat, lon, name="Test Store"):
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO chains (
                chain_id,
                name_he_normalized,
                name_en_normalized
            )
            VALUES (%s, %s, %s)
            ON CONFLICT (chain_id) DO NOTHING
            """,
            (CHAIN_ID, "רשת בדיקה", "Test Chain"),
        )

        cur.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO stores (
                chain_id,
                store_id,
                store_name,
                latitude,
                longitude
            )
            VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
            ON CONFLICT (chain_id, store_id) DO UPDATE SET
                latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude,
                longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude
            """,
            (CHAIN_ID, store_id, name, lat, lon),
        )

def test_store_within_distance_is_found(conn):

        conn,

        lat=NEAR_LAT,
        lon=NEAR_LON,

                chain_id,

def test_digest_email_single_promotion():
    subject, body = build_digest_email(
        [_event()]
    )

    assert "(1)" in subject
    assert NEARBY_STORE_ID in body
    assert "1 new promotion" in body

    assert TEST_ITEM_CODE not in body
    assert TEST_PROMOTION_ID not in body


def test_digest_email_multiple_promotions_same_store_are_summed():
    events = [
        _event(item_code=f"ITEM{i}")
        for i in range(5)
    ]

    subject, body = build_digest_email(events)

    assert "(5)" in subject
    assert NEARBY_STORE_ID in body
    assert "5 new promotions" in body

    for i in range(5):
        assert f"ITEM{i}" not in body


def test_digest_email_groups_by_store():
    events = (
        [
            _event(
                item_code=f"A{i}",
                store_id="STORE_A",
                chain_name="Chain A",
            )
            for i in range(2)
        ]
        + [
            _event(
                item_code=f"B{i}",
                store_id="STORE_B",
                chain_name="Chain B",
            )
            for i in range(3)
        ]
    )

    subject, body = build_digest_email(events)

    assert "(5)" in subject
    assert "Chain A store STORE_A: 2 new promotions" in body
    assert "Chain B store STORE_B: 3 new promotions" in body


def test_digest_email_has_no_volume_cap():
    events = [
        _event(item_code=f"ITEM{i}")
        for i in range(25)
    ]

    subject, body = build_digest_email(events)

    assert "(25)" in subject
    assert "25 new promotions" in body
    assert "more new promotion" not in body

    conn,
    monkeypatch,
    use_conn_for_run,
    notified_file,
    promo_logs,
    reports_dir,
):

    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(

            },

        ),
    )

    assert expected_key in notified_file.read_text()

    report = (
        reports_dir

        / "report_promos_details.json"
    )

    assert report.exists()


def test_run_parses_all_rotated_logs(
    conn,
    monkeypatch,
    use_conn_for_run,
    notified_file,
    promo_logs,
    reports_dir,
):

        conn,

        lon=NEAR_LON,
    )

    events = [
        _event(

            item_code="ITEM0",
        ),
        _event(
            promotion_id="PROMO1",

        _event(
            promotion_id="PROMO2",
            item_code="ITEM2",

        return (

                "item_added_events": events,
            },
            None,
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        promo_notifications.promo_changes,

    )

        promo_notifications,

        lambda subject, body: sent.append((subject, body)) or True,
    )

    promo_notifications.run()

    assert parsed_paths == promo_logs
    assert len(parsed_paths) == 3

    assert len(sent) == 1
    assert "(3)" in sent[0][0]
    assert "3 new promotions" in sent[0][1]

"""Shared fixtures for the shopper API tests (tests/api).

IMPORTANT: do NOT add an __init__.py to tests/api - the folder would become a
top-level package called `api` and shadow the real `api` package.

Two kinds of tests live here:

* unit / route tests   - no database; collaborators are monkeypatched.
* integration tests    - use `seed` + `api_db`: real Postgres, everything is
                         written inside the `conn` fixture's transaction and
                         rolled back at teardown (nothing is ever committed).
"""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HTTP client
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

@pytest.fixture
def client(monkeypatch):
    """TestClient without lifespan (so data/reference/*.json isn't needed).

    raise_server_exceptions=False -> an unhandled error shows up as a 500
    response that tests can assert on, instead of blowing up the test.
    """
    # Jinja2Templates(directory="api/templates") is relative to the CWD.
    monkeypatch.chdir(PROJECT_ROOT)
    from api.main import app

    return TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Database plumbing
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _NoCommit:
    """Wrap the rolled-back-at-teardown `conn` so production code can run
    unmodified: commit/close are no-ops and `with conn:` doesn't close it."""

    def __init__(self, real):
        self._real = real

    def commit(self):
        pass

    def close(self):
        pass

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc):
        return False

    def __getattr__(self, name):
        return getattr(self._real, name)


@pytest.fixture
def api_db(conn, monkeypatch):
    """Route every `get_connection()` used by the API to the test transaction.

    NOTE: api.queries / api.routes_web do `from db import get_connection`, so
    patching `db.get_connection` would NOT affect them - we patch the names
    inside those modules.
    """
    import api.queries as queries
    import api.routes_web as routes_web

    proxy = _NoCommit(conn)
    monkeypatch.setattr(queries, "get_connection", lambda: proxy)
    monkeypatch.setattr(routes_web, "get_connection", lambda: proxy)
    return proxy


CHAIN_A = "7770000000001"
CHAIN_B = "7770000000002"
TEST_CHAINS = (CHAIN_A, CHAIN_B)

# Product barcodes
MILK = "7770000000101"        # enriched, in products, has prices + promos + nutrition
CHEESE = "7770000000102"      # enriched, in products, no prices
NO_PRODUCT = "7770000000103"  # enriched but NOT in products  -> not "packaged"
STORE_CODE = "7770000000104"  # enriched, in products AND in store_products -> excluded

CAT_PACKAGED = "קטגוריית-ארוזים-טסט"
CAT_FRESH = "קטגוריית-טריים-טסט"
SUB_TOMATO = "עגבניהטסט"
SUB_CHICKEN = "חזהטסט עוףטסט"

TOMATO_CHERRY = "עגבניהטסט שרי"
TOMATO_ORGANIC = "עגבניהטסט אורגנית"


@pytest.fixture
def seed(conn, api_db):
    """Insert a small, self-contained dataset inside the test transaction."""
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    day = timedelta(days=1)

    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        # Refuse to run on top of leftovers (we never want to touch real data).
        cur.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM chains WHERE chain_id = ANY(%s)", (list(TEST_CHAINS),))
        if cur.fetchone()[0]:
            pytest.fail(f"Chains {TEST_CHAINS} already exist in the DB; remove them first.")

        # Partitions are created INSIDE the transaction (DDL is transactional
        # in Postgres) so they vanish on rollback.
        for chain_id in TEST_CHAINS:
            cur.execute(f"CREATE TABLE prices_{chain_id} PARTITION OF prices FOR VALUES IN ('{chain_id}')")
            cur.execute(
                f"CREATE TABLE promotion_items_{chain_id} PARTITION OF promotion_items FOR VALUES IN ('{chain_id}')"
            )

        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO chains (chain_id, name_he_normalized, name_en_normalized, brands) VALUES "
            "(%s, 'רשת בדיקה א', 'test chain a', ARRAY['מותג א']), "
            "(%s, 'רשת בדיקה ב', 'test chain b', '{}')",
            (CHAIN_A, CHAIN_B),
        )

        stores = [
            (CHAIN_A, "S1", "סניף א1", "תל אביב", Decimal("32.0853"), Decimal("34.7818")),
            (CHAIN_A, "S2", None, "חיפה", None, None),  # store_name is NULL on purpose
            (CHAIN_B, "S1", "סניף ב1", "ירושלים", None, None),
            (CHAIN_B, "S2", "סניף ב2", "באר שבע", None, None),
        ]
        for chain_id, store_id, name, city, lat, lon in stores:
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO stores (chain_id, store_id, store_name, city, latitude, longitude) "
                "VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)",
                (chain_id, store_id, name, city, lat, lon),
            )

        # ---- packaged products -------------------------------------------
        for code in (MILK, CHEESE, STORE_CODE):
            cur.execute("INSERT INTO products (item_code, name) VALUES (%s, %s)", (code, f"p-{code}"))

        enrichment = [
            (MILK, "חלבטסט תנובה", "Test Milk", "תנובה", "Tnuva", CAT_PACKAGED, "חלב"),
            (CHEESE, "גבינהטסט", "Test Cheese", None, None, CAT_PACKAGED, None),
            (NO_PRODUCT, "ללא מוצר", None, None, None, CAT_PACKAGED, None),
            (STORE_CODE, "קוד חנות", None, None, None, CAT_PACKAGED, None),
        ]
        for code, he, en, bhe, ben, cat, sub in enrichment:
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO product_enrichment "
                "(item_code, source, name_he, name_en, brand_he, brand_en, category_he, subcategory_he, "
                " category_path_he, category_path_en, description_he, nutrition_raw) "
                "VALUES (%s,'test',%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s, ARRAY['חלב', NULL, 'מוצרי חלב'], ARRAY['Dairy', NULL], "
                "'תיאור', '{\"אנרגיה\": \"60\"}'::jsonb)",
                (code, he, en, bhe, ben, cat, sub),
            )

        nutrition = [
            # (raw_label, nutrient, amount, unit, basis)
            ("זzz-unmapped", None, None, None, "100ml"),
            ("שומן", "fat", Decimal("3.0"), "g", "100ml"),
            ("חלבון", "protein", Decimal("3.3"), "g", "100g"),
        ]
        for raw_label, nutrient, amount, unit, basis in nutrition:
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO product_nutrition (item_code, source, raw_label, nutrient, amount, unit, basis, basis_raw) "
                "VALUES (%s,'test',%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)",
                (MILK, raw_label, nutrient, amount, unit, basis, basis),
            )

        prices = [
            (CHAIN_A, "S1", MILK, Decimal("5.90"), Decimal("5.90")),
            (CHAIN_A, "S2", MILK, Decimal("0.00"), None),     # zero price = "unavailable"
            (CHAIN_B, "S1", MILK, Decimal("6.50"), None),
            (CHAIN_B, "S2", MILK, None, None),                # NULL price
        ]
        for chain_id, store_id, code, price, unit_price in prices:
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO prices (chain_id, store_id, item_code, price, unit_price) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)",
                (chain_id, store_id, code, price, unit_price),
            )

        # ---- promotions on MILK ------------------------------------------
        promos = [
            # id, chain, store, start, end, discounted, min_qty
            ("PA1", CHAIN_A, "S1", now - day, now + 5 * day, Decimal("4.90"), Decimal("2")),  # active
            ("PA2", CHAIN_A, "S1", now - 5 * day, now - day, Decimal("1.00"), None),          # expired
            ("PA3", CHAIN_A, "S1", now + 3 * day, now + 9 * day, Decimal("1.50"), None),      # future
            ("PA4", CHAIN_A, "S1", None, None, Decimal("5.10"), None),                        # open-ended
            ("PB1", CHAIN_B, "S1", now - day, now + day, Decimal("6.00"), None),              # active, other chain
        ]
        for pid, chain_id, store_id, start, end, discounted, min_qty in promos:
            _insert_promo(cur, pid, chain_id, store_id, start, end, MILK, discounted, min_qty, f"מבצע {pid}")

        # ---- fresh (store_products) --------------------------------------
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO store_product_categories (name, sort_order) VALUES (%s, 9999) RETURNING id",
            (CAT_FRESH,),
        )
        category_id = cur.fetchone()[0]
        subs = {}
        for order, name in enumerate((SUB_TOMATO, SUB_CHICKEN), start=1):
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO store_product_subcategories (category_id, name, sort_order) VALUES (%s,%s,%s) RETURNING id",
                (category_id, name, order),
            )
            subs[name] = cur.fetchone()[0]

        store_products = [
            (CHAIN_A, "S1", "F1", TOMATO_CHERRY),
            (CHAIN_B, "S1", "F2", TOMATO_CHERRY),
            (CHAIN_A, "S2", "F3", TOMATO_ORGANIC),
            (CHAIN_A, "S1", "F4", "עוףטסט טרי חזהטסט"),  # words reversed + extra word
            (CHAIN_A, "S1", STORE_CODE, "פריט חנות"),
        ]
        for chain_id, store_id, code, name in store_products:
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO store_products (chain_id, store_id, item_code, name) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s)",
                (chain_id, store_id, code, name),
            )

        fresh_prices = [
            (CHAIN_A, "S1", "F1", Decimal("3.50")),
            (CHAIN_B, "S1", "F2", Decimal("0.00")),
            (CHAIN_A, "S2", "F3", None),
        ]
        for chain_id, store_id, code, price in fresh_prices:
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO prices (chain_id, store_id, item_code, price) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s)",
                (chain_id, store_id, code, price),
            )

        _insert_promo(cur, "PF1", CHAIN_A, "S1", now - day, now + 4 * day, "F1", Decimal("2.90"), None, "מבצע עגבניות")
        _insert_promo(cur, "PF2", CHAIN_A, "S1", now - 5 * day, now - day, "F1", Decimal("1.00"), None, "מבצע שפג")

        # The "fresh" queries read the materialized view
        # `store_product_category_matches`. REFRESHing it recomputes EVERY
        # store_product x subcategory pair in the whole DB (very slow on real
        # data, and it takes a heavy lock). Instead we create a TEMP table with
        # the same name - temp tables shadow public ones for unqualified names
        # and vanish on rollback - filled using the view's own defining query,
        # restricted to our test chains. Same matching logic, tiny cost.
        cur.execute("SELECT pg_get_viewdef('public.store_product_category_matches'::regclass)")
        viewdef = cur.fetchone()[0].strip().rstrip(";")
        chains_sql = ", ".join(f"'{c}'" for c in TEST_CHAINS)  # constants, safe to inline
        cur.execute(
            "CREATE TEMP TABLE store_product_category_matches AS "
            f"SELECT * FROM ({viewdef}) AS v WHERE v.chain_id IN ({chains_sql})"
        )

    return SimpleNamespace(
        chain_a=CHAIN_A,
        chain_b=CHAIN_B,
        milk=MILK,
        cheese=CHEESE,
        no_product=NO_PRODUCT,
        store_code=STORE_CODE,
        cat_packaged=CAT_PACKAGED,
        cat_fresh=CAT_FRESH,
        tomato_cherry=TOMATO_CHERRY,
        tomato_organic=TOMATO_ORGANIC,
        category_id=category_id,
        sub_tomato=subs[SUB_TOMATO],
        sub_chicken=subs[SUB_CHICKEN],
    )


def _insert_promo(cur, pid, chain_id, store_id, start, end, item_code, discounted, min_qty, description):
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO promotions (chain_id, promotion_id, store_id, description, start_datetime, end_datetime) "
        "VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)",
        (chain_id, pid, store_id, description, start, end),
    )
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO promotion_groups (chain_id, promotion_id, store_id, group_id) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,'G1')",
        (chain_id, pid, store_id),
    )
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO promotion_items (chain_id, promotion_id, store_id, group_id, item_code, discounted_price, min_qty) "
        "VALUES (%s,%s,%s,'G1',%s,%s,%s)",
        (chain_id, pid, store_id, item_code, discounted, min_qty),
    )

"""Integration tests for api/queries.py against a real Postgres.

Data comes from the `seed` fixture (tests/api/conftest.py) and lives only in
the test transaction. Assertions never depend on the rest of the DB's content:
we look at our own uniquely-named categories / barcodes.
"""

import pytest

from api import queries

CAT = "קטגוריית-ארוזים-טסט"  # same value as conftest.CAT_PACKAGED


def codes(rows):
    return [row["item_code"] for row in rows]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# get_product / get_enrichment
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestGetProduct:
    def test_returns_enriched_columns(self, seed):
        product = queries.get_product(seed.milk)

        assert product["item_code"] == seed.milk
        assert product["name_he"] == "חלבטסט תנובה"
        assert product["brand_he"] == "תנובה"
        assert product["category_he"] == seed.cat_packaged

    def test_unknown_barcode_is_none(self, seed):
        assert queries.get_product("0000000000000") is None

class TestGetPromotions:

class TestSearch:
    def test_blank_query_short_circuits(self, seed):
        assert queries.search("   ") == {"items": [], "total": 0, "limit": 20, "offset": 0}

    def test_finds_by_hebrew_name(self, seed):
        result = queries.search("חלבטסט")

        assert result["total"] == 1
        assert codes(result["items"]) == [seed.milk]

    def test_finds_by_english_name_case_insensitively(self, seed):
        assert codes(queries.search("test MILK")["items"]) == [seed.milk]

    def test_finds_by_partial_barcode(self, seed):
        assert seed.milk in codes(queries.search("77700000001")["items"])

    def test_exact_barcode_is_ranked_first(self, seed):
        result = queries.search(seed.milk)

        assert codes(result["items"])[0] == seed.milk

    def test_query_is_stripped(self, seed):
        assert codes(queries.search("  חלבטסט  ")["items"]) == [seed.milk]

    def test_no_match(self, seed):
        assert queries.search("zzzz-no-such-product")["total"] == 0

    def test_pagination(self, seed):
        page1 = queries.search("7770000000", limit=2, offset=0)
        page2 = queries.search("7770000000", limit=2, offset=2)

        assert page1["total"] == page2["total"] == 4
        assert len(page1["items"]) == 2 and len(page2["items"]) == 2
        assert not set(codes(page1["items"])) & set(codes(page2["items"]))

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("limit", [0, -1, 101])
    def test_limit_must_be_between_1_and_100(self, seed, limit):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            queries.search("חלב", limit=limit)

    def test_offset_must_not_be_negative(self, seed):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            queries.search("חלב", offset=-1)


def test_like_wildcards_are_treated_literally(seed):
    assert queries.search("_")["total"] > 0
    assert queries.search("%")["total"] > 0

class TestFreshProductsBySubcategory:
    def _by_name(self, seed, subcategory_id):
        result = queries.get_store_products_by_subcategory(subcategory_id)
        return result, {item["product_name"]: item for item in result["items"]}

    def test_groups_by_product_name(self, seed):
        result, items = self._by_name(seed, seed.sub_tomato)

        assert result["total"] == 2
        assert set(items) == {seed.tomato_cherry, seed.tomato_organic}

    def test_store_count_counts_distinct_stores(self, seed):
        _, items = self._by_name(seed, seed.sub_tomato)

        assert items[seed.tomato_cherry]["store_count"] == 2
        assert items[seed.tomato_organic]["store_count"] == 1

    def test_lowest_price_ignores_zero_and_missing_prices(self, seed):
        _, items = self._by_name(seed, seed.sub_tomato)

        assert str(items[seed.tomato_cherry]["lowest_price"]) == "3.50"  # B/S1 is 0.00
        assert items[seed.tomato_organic]["lowest_price"] is None  # only a NULL price

    def test_cheapest_promotion_only_considers_active_promotions(self, seed):
        _, items = self._by_name(seed, seed.sub_tomato)

        assert str(items[seed.tomato_cherry]["cheapest_promotion"]) == "2.90"  # expired 1.00 ignored
        assert items[seed.tomato_organic]["cheapest_promotion"] is None

    def test_all_words_must_match_in_any_order(self, seed):
        _, items = self._by_name(seed, seed.sub_chicken)

        assert list(items) == ["עוףטסט טרי חזהטסט"]

    def test_pagination_total_is_independent_of_page_size(self, seed):
        result = queries.get_store_products_by_subcategory(seed.sub_tomato, limit=1, offset=1)

        assert result["total"] == 2
        assert len(result["items"]) == 1

    def test_unknown_subcategory(self, seed):
        result = queries.get_store_products_by_subcategory(2_000_000_000)

        assert result == {"items": [], "total": 0, "limit": 20, "offset": 0}

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("limit", [0, 101])
    def test_limit_validated(self, seed, limit):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            queries.get_store_products_by_subcategory(1, limit=limit)

    def test_offset_validated(self, seed):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            queries.get_store_products_by_subcategory(1, offset=-1)

class TestFreshProductDetail:
    def test_one_row_per_store_with_category_info(self, seed):

        assert row["promotions"] == []

        assert queries.get_fresh_product_detail(seed.tomato_cherry, seed.sub_chicken) == []


    def test_stores_with_a_real_price_are_listed_before_zero_priced_ones(self, seed):
        rows = queries.get_fresh_product_detail(seed.tomato_cherry, seed.sub_tomato)

        assert rows[0]["price"] is not None and rows[0]["price"] > 0
