import json

import pytest

from monitoring import scraper_coverage


def make_frontend_data():
    return {
        "rid": 1234,
        "retailer": {
            "branches": [
                {"id": 1},
            ],
        },
        "tree": {
            "categories": [
                {"id": 10},
            ],
        },
    }


def make_data_js(frontend_data):
    return (
        "window.sp = {\n"
        f"    frontendData: {json.dumps(frontend_data)}\n"
        "};"
    )


class FakeResponse:
    def __init__(self, status_code, text=""):
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.text = text

    def raise_for_status(self):
        if self.status_code >= 400:
            raise RuntimeError("HTTP error")


class FakeClient:
    def __init__(self, responses):
        self.responses = responses

    def get(self, url, **kwargs):
        return self.responses[url]


def test_extract_js_object():
    text = """
    window.sp = {
        frontendData: {"rid": 1234, "name": "test"},
        other: true
    };
    """

    result = scraper_coverage.extract_js_object(
        text,
        "frontendData",
    )

    assert json.loads(result) == {
        "rid": 1234,
        "name": "test",
    }


def test_extract_js_object_missing_key():
    text = "window.sp = {other: true};"

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Could not find frontendData",
    ):
        scraper_coverage.extract_js_object(
            text,
            "frontendData",
        )


def test_extract_js_object_nested_object():
    text = """
    window.sp = {
        frontendData: {
            "rid": 1234,
            "retailer": {
                "name": "Test",
                "branches": [
                    {"id": 1}
                ]
            }
        },
        other: true
    };
    """

    result = scraper_coverage.extract_js_object(
        text,
        "frontendData",
    )

    assert json.loads(result) == {
        "rid": 1234,
        "retailer": {
            "name": "Test",
            "branches": [
                {"id": 1},
            ],
        },
    }


def test_extract_js_object_with_escaped_quotes():
    text = r'''
    window.sp = {
        frontendData: {
            "rid": 1234,
            "name": "Test \"Store\""
        }
    };
    '''

    result = scraper_coverage.extract_js_object(
        text,
        "frontendData",
    )

    assert json.loads(result) == {
        "rid": 1234,
        "name": 'Test "Store"',
    }


def test_extract_js_object_missing_object():
    text = "window.sp = {frontendData: true};"

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Could not find object for frontendData",
    ):
        scraper_coverage.extract_js_object(
            text,
            "frontendData",
        )


def test_extract_js_object_unclosed_object():
    text = """
    window.sp = {
        frontendData: {"rid": 1234
    """

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Could not extract frontendData",
    ):
        scraper_coverage.extract_js_object(
            text,
            "frontendData",
        )


def test_get_all_categories():
    categories = [
        {
            "id": 1,
            "subCategories": [
                {
                    "id": 2,
                    "subCategories": [
                        {"id": 3},
                    ],
                },
            ],
        },
        {
            "id": 4,
        },
    ]

    result = scraper_coverage.get_all_categories(
        categories,
    )

    assert result == [
        {
            "id": 1,
            "subCategories": [
                {
                    "id": 2,
                    "subCategories": [
                        {"id": 3},
                    ],
                },
            ],
        },
        {
            "id": 2,
            "subCategories": [
                {"id": 3},
            ],
        },
        {"id": 3},
        {"id": 4},
    ]


def test_get_all_categories_empty():
    assert scraper_coverage.get_all_categories([]) == []


def test_get_data_url_from_html():
    html = """
    <html>
        <script src="https://example.com/assets/data.js?c=123"></script>
    </html>
    """

    assert (
        scraper_coverage.get_data_url_from_html(html)
        == "https://example.com/assets/data.js?c=123"
    )


def test_get_data_url_from_html_single_quotes():
    html = """
    <html>
        <script src='https://example.com/assets/data.js'></script>
    </html>
    """

    assert (

    )

    html = """

    </html>
    """

    assert (

    )

        )
        is None
    )


def test_discover_website_success():
    frontend_data = make_frontend_data()
    data_js = make_data_js(frontend_data)

    client = FakeClient(
        {
            "https://example.com/": FakeResponse(
                200,
                (
                    '<script src="'
                    "https://example.com/data.js"
                    '"></script>'
                ),
            ),
            "https://example.com/data.js": FakeResponse(
                200,
                data_js,
            ),
        }
    )

    result = scraper_coverage.discover_website(
        client,
        "https://example.com",
    )

    assert result == {
        "data_url": "https://example.com/data.js",
        "scraping_url": (
            "https://example.com/v2/retailers/1234/"
            "branches/{branch_id}/categories/{category_id}/products"
        ),
        "retailer_id": 1234,
        "available": True,
    }


def test_discover_website_adds_trailing_slash():
    frontend_data = make_frontend_data()
    data_js = make_data_js(frontend_data)

    client = FakeClient(
        {
            "https://example.com/": FakeResponse(
                200,
                '<script src="https://example.com/data.js"></script>',
            ),
            "https://example.com/data.js": FakeResponse(
                200,
                data_js,
            ),
        }
    )

    result = scraper_coverage.discover_website(
        client,
        "https://example.com/",
    )

    assert result["data_url"] == (
        "https://example.com/data.js"
    )

    assert result["scraping_url"] == (
        "https://example.com/v2/retailers/1234/"
        "branches/{branch_id}/categories/{category_id}/products"
    )


def test_discover_website_invalid_frontend_data():

        {

            "https://example.com",
        )


def test_discover_website_403_uses_playwright(monkeypatch):
    frontend_data = make_frontend_data()
    data_js = make_data_js(frontend_data)

    client = FakeClient(
        {
            "https://example.com/": FakeResponse(403),
            "https://example.com/data.js": FakeResponse(
                200,
                data_js,
            ),
        }
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        scraper_coverage,
        "get_data_url_with_playwright",
        lambda url: "https://example.com/data.js",
    )

    result = scraper_coverage.discover_website(
        client,
        "https://example.com",
    )

    assert result == {
        "data_url": "https://example.com/data.js",
        "scraping_url": (
            "https://example.com/v2/retailers/1234/"
            "branches/{branch_id}/categories/{category_id}/products"
        ),
        "retailer_id": 1234,
        "available": False,
    }


def test_discover_website_no_data_js(monkeypatch):
    client = FakeClient(
        {
            "https://example.com/": FakeResponse(
                200,
                "<html>No data.js here</html>",
            ),
        }
    )

    def raise_playwright_error(url):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Playwright could not find data.js."
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        scraper_coverage,
        "get_data_url_with_playwright",
        raise_playwright_error,
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        RuntimeError,
        match="Playwright could not find data.js",
    ):
        scraper_coverage.discover_website(
            client,
            "https://example.com",
        )

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "url,expected",
    [
        (
            "https://publishedprices.co.il/",
            "publishedprices.co.il",
        ),
        (
            "https://www.publishedprices.co.il/",
            "www.publishedprices.co.il",
        ),
        (
            "https://foo.laibcatalog.co.il/test",
            "foo.laibcatalog.co.il",
        ),
        (
            "https://BINAprojects.com/",
            "binaprojects.com",
        ),
        (
            "https://example.com/path",
            "example.com",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_get_domain(url, expected):
    assert get_domain(url) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "url,expected",
    [
        (
            "https://publishedprices.co.il/",
            "publishedprices",
        ),
        (
            "https://foo.publishedprices.co.il/",
            "publishedprices",
        ),
        (
            "https://laibcatalog.co.il/",
            "laibcatalog",
        ),
        (
            "https://branch.laibcatalog.co.il/",
            "laibcatalog",
        ),
        (
            "https://binaprojects.com/",
            "binaprojects",
        ),
        (
            "https://www.binaprojects.com/",
            "binaprojects",
        ),
        (
            "https://example.com/",
            "unclassified",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_get_source_type(url, expected):
    assert get_source_type(url) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "url",
    [
        "https://shop.hazi-hinam.co.il/Prices",
        "http://prices.super-pharm.co.il/",
        "http://prices.shufersal.co.il/",
        "https://www.citymarket-shops.co.il/",
        "https://app.netiv-hesed.com/",
    ],
)
def test_hardcoded_html_sources(url):
    assert (
        get_source_type(url)
        == "html_filelink"
    )


def test_unknown_subdomain_is_not_classified_as_source():
    assert (
        get_source_type(
            "https://publishedprices.co.il.example.com/"
        )
        == "unclassified"
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Laibcatalog chain ID

def test_get_laibcatalog_chain_id():
    response = Mock()
    response.status_code = 200
    response.text = """
        <html>
            <script>
                const DEFAULT_EDI = "7290661400001";
            </script>
        </html>
    """
    response.raise_for_status.return_value = None

    requests_get = Mock(
        return_value=response
    )

    original_get = requests.get

    try:
        requests.get = requests_get

        result = get_laibcatalog_chain_id(
            "https://example.com"
        )

    finally:
        requests.get = original_get

    assert result == "7290661400001"

    requests_get.assert_called_once()


def test_get_laibcatalog_chain_id_single_quotes():
    response = Mock()
    response.status_code = 200
    response.text = """
        DEFAULT_EDI = '7290661400001'
    """
    response.raise_for_status.return_value = None

    original_get = requests.get

    try:
        requests.get = Mock(
            return_value=response
        )

        result = get_laibcatalog_chain_id(
            "https://example.com"
        )

    finally:
        requests.get = original_get

    assert result == "7290661400001"


def test_get_laibcatalog_chain_id_missing():
    response = Mock()
    response.text = """
        <html>
            No chain ID here.
        </html>
    """
    response.raise_for_status.return_value = None

    original_get = requests.get

    try:
        requests.get = Mock(
            return_value=response
        )

        with pytest.raises(
            RuntimeError,
            match="Could not find Laibcatalog chain ID",
        ):
            get_laibcatalog_chain_id(
                "https://example.com"
            )

    finally:
        requests.get = original_get


def test_get_laibcatalog_chain_id_http_error():
    response = Mock()

    response.raise_for_status.side_effect = (
        requests.HTTPError("HTTP 500")
    )

    original_get = requests.get

    try:
        requests.get = Mock(
            return_value=response
        )

        with pytest.raises(
            requests.HTTPError
        ):
            get_laibcatalog_chain_id(
                "https://example.com"
            )

    finally:
        requests.get = original_get


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Credentials
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "info,expected",
    [
        (
            "שם משתמש:doralon סיסמא:12345",
            [
                {
                    "username": "doralon",
                    "password": "12345",
                }
            ],
        ),
        (
            "שם משתמש: TivTaam סיסמא: abc",
            [
                {
                    "username": "TivTaam",
                    "password": "abc",
                }
            ],
        ),
        (
            "שם משתמש - SalachD סיסמא - xyz",
            [
                {
                    "username": "SalachD",
                    "password": "xyz",
                }
            ],
        ),
        (
            "Username: foo Password: bar",
            [
                {
                    "username": "foo",
                    "password": "bar",
                }
            ],
        ),
        (
            "User- yuda_ho Password- xyz",
            [
                {
                    "username": "yuda_ho",
                    "password": "xyz",
                }
            ],
        ),
    ],
)
def test_extract_credentials(
    info,
    expected,
):
    assert extract_credentials(info) == expected


def test_extract_credentials_password_not_required():
    result = extract_credentials(
        "שם משתמש: test סיסמא: אין צורך"
    )

    assert result == [
        {
            "username": "test",
            "password": "",
        }
    ]


def test_extract_credentials_multiple_users():
    result = extract_credentials(
        """
        שם משתמש: user1 סיסמא: pass1
        שם משתמש: user2 סיסמא: pass2
        """
    )

    assert result == [
        {
            "username": "user1",
            "password": "pass1",
        },
        {
            "username": "user2",
            "password": "pass2",
        },
    ]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "info",
    [
        None,
        "",
        "   ",
    ],
)
def test_extract_credentials_empty(info):
    assert extract_credentials(info) == []


def test_merge_credentials_removes_duplicates():
    existing = [
        {
            "username": "user1",
            "password": "pass1",
        },
        {
            "username": "user2",
            "password": "pass2",
        },
    ]

    new = [
        {
            "username": "user1",
            "password": "pass1",
        },
        {
            "username": "user3",
            "password": "pass3",
        },
    ]

    result = merge_credentials(
        existing,
        new,
    )

    assert result == [
        {
            "username": "user1",
            "password": "pass1",
        },
        {
            "username": "user2",
            "password": "pass2",
        },
        {
            "username": "user3",
            "password": "pass3",
        },
    ]


def test_merge_credentials_ignores_empty_username():
    result = merge_credentials(
        [
            {
                "username": "",
                "password": "secret",
            }
        ],
        [
            {
                "username": "valid",
                "password": "secret",
            }
        ],
    )

    assert result == [
        {
            "username": "valid",
            "password": "secret",
        }
    ]

def test_source_identity_publishedprices_is_canonical():
    assert source_identity(
        "publishedprices",
        "https://foo.publishedprices.co.il/",
    ) == (
        "publishedprices",
        "publishedprices.co.il",
    )


def test_source_identity_publishedprices_subdomains_match():
    first = source_identity(
        "publishedprices",
        "https://a.publishedprices.co.il/",
    )

    second = source_identity(
        "publishedprices",
        "https://b.publishedprices.co.il/",
    )

    assert first == second


def test_source_identity_laibcatalog_uses_hostname():
    assert source_identity(
        "laibcatalog",
        "https://foo.laibcatalog.co.il/",
    ) == (
        "laibcatalog",
        "foo.laibcatalog.co.il",
    )


def test_source_identity_bina_uses_hostname():
    assert source_identity(
        "binaprojects",
        "https://foo.binaprojects.com/",
    ) == (
        "binaprojects",
        "foo.binaprojects.com",
    )


def test_source_identity_unclassified_uses_url():
    url = "https://example.com/source"

    assert source_identity(
        "unclassified",
        url,
    ) == (
        "unclassified",
        url,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Signatures
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_credential_signature_is_order_independent():
    first = [
        {
            "username": "user1",
            "password": "pass1",
        },
        {
            "username": "user2",
            "password": "pass2",
        },
    ]

    second = [
        {
            "username": "user2",
            "password": "pass2",
        },
        {
            "username": "user1",
            "password": "pass1",
        },
    ]

    assert credential_signature(
        first
    ) == credential_signature(
        second
    )


def test_credential_signature_detects_password_change():
    first = [
        {
            "username": "user1",
            "password": "old",
        }
    ]

    second = [
        {
            "username": "user1",
            "password": "new",
        }
    ]

    assert credential_signature(
        first
    ) != credential_signature(
        second
    )


def test_source_signature():
    source = {
        "type": "publishedprices",
        "url": "https://example.com",
        "credentials": [
            {
                "username": "user",
                "password": "pass",
            }
        ],
    }

    assert source_signature(source) == (
        "publishedprices",
        "https://example.com",
        (
            ("user", "pass"),
        ),
    )

def test_check_chains_registry_new_chain():
    supermarkets = [
        {"name": "Chain A"},
        {"name": "Chain B"},
    ]

    chain_names = {
        "Chain A",
    }

    result = check_chains_registry(
        supermarkets,
        chain_names,
    )

    assert result == [
        "MISSING FROM chains.json: Chain B"
    ]


def test_check_chains_registry_stale_chain():
    supermarkets = [
        {"name": "Chain A"},
    ]

    chain_names = {
        "Chain A",
        "Old Chain",
    }

    result = check_chains_registry(
        supermarkets,
        chain_names,
    )

    assert result == [
        "STALE IN chains.json (no longer in gov scrape): Old Chain"
    ]


def test_check_chains_registry_both_directions():
    supermarkets = [
        {"name": "Current Chain"},
        {"name": "New Chain"},
    ]

    chain_names = {
        "Current Chain",
        "Old Chain",
    }

    result = check_chains_registry(
        supermarkets,
        chain_names,
    )

    assert result == [
        "MISSING FROM chains.json: New Chain",
        "STALE IN chains.json (no longer in gov scrape): Old Chain",
    ]


def test_check_chains_registry_no_changes():
    supermarkets = [
        {"name": "Chain A"},
        {"name": "Chain B"},
    ]

    chain_names = {
        "Chain A",
        "Chain B",
    }

    assert check_chains_registry(
        supermarkets,
        chain_names,
    ) == []

def test_check_chain_credentials_matching():
    supermarkets = [
        {
            "name": "Chain A",
            "sources": [
                {
                    "type": "publishedprices",
                    "url": "https://example.com",
                    "credentials": [
                        {
                            "username": "user1",
                            "password": "pass1",
                        }
                    ],
                }
            ],
        }
    ]

    chains = {
        "7290000000001": {
            "Chain_name_gov_page": "Chain A",
            "credentials": {
                "username": "user1",
                "password": "pass1",
            },
        }
    }

    assert check_chain_credentials(
        supermarkets,
        chains,
    ) == []


def test_check_chain_credentials_missing_user():
    supermarkets = [
        {
            "name": "Chain A",
            "sources": [
                {
                    "type": "publishedprices",
                    "url": "https://example.com",
                    "credentials": [
                        {
                            "username": "missing_user",
                            "password": "pass1",
                        }
                    ],
                }
            ],
        }
    ]

    chains = {
        "7290000000001": {
            "Chain_name_gov_page": "Chain A",
            "credentials": {
                "username": "different_user",
                "password": "pass1",
            },
        }
    }

    result = check_chain_credentials(
        supermarkets,
        chains,
    )

    assert result == [
        "CREDENTIAL MISSING FROM chains.json: "
        "Chain A | user: missing_user"
    ]

        "Chain A": {

            "sources": [
                {
                    "type": "publishedprices",
                    "url": "https://old.publishedprices.co.il/",
                }
            ],
        }
    }

    new = [
        {
            "name": "Chain A",
            "sources": [
                {
                    "type": "publishedprices",
                    "url": "https://new.publishedprices.co.il/",
                }
            ],
        }
    ]

    assert compare_sources(
        old,
        new,
    ) == []

def test_real_chains_json_loads():
    """
    Make sure the actual manually maintained chains.json
    remains valid JSON and can be loaded by monitoring.
    """

    from monitoring.sources import CHAINS_FILE

    chains = load_chains(CHAINS_FILE)

    assert chains
    assert isinstance(chains, dict)


def test_real_chains_json_has_valid_chain_ids():
    """
    Chain IDs are the dictionary keys and should be numeric.
    """

    from monitoring.sources import CHAINS_FILE

    chains = load_chains(CHAINS_FILE)

    assert chains

    for chain_id in chains:
        assert isinstance(chain_id, str)
        assert chain_id.isdigit()


def test_real_chains_json_has_required_fields():
    """
    Validate the fields needed by the monitoring / pipeline
    without hardcoding individual supermarkets.
    """

    from monitoring.sources import CHAINS_FILE

    chains = load_chains(CHAINS_FILE)

    required_fields = {
        "Chain_name_store_file",
        "Chain_name_gov_page",
        "name_he_normalized",
        "name_en_normalized",
    }

    for chain_id, chain in chains.items():

        missing = required_fields - set(chain)

        assert not missing, (
            f"Chain {chain_id} is missing fields: "
            f"{sorted(missing)}"
        )


def test_real_chains_json_government_names_are_nonempty():
    from monitoring.sources import CHAINS_FILE

    chains = load_chains(CHAINS_FILE)

    for chain_id, chain in chains.items():
        gov_name = chain.get(
            "Chain_name_gov_page"
        )

        assert isinstance(gov_name, str), (
            f"Chain {chain_id} has invalid "
            "Chain_name_gov_page"
        )

        assert gov_name.strip(), (
            f"Chain {chain_id} has empty "
            "Chain_name_gov_page"
        )


def test_real_chains_json_credentials_have_valid_shape():
    """
    If a chain has credentials, they must contain
    username and password fields.

    This intentionally does not assert specific passwords.
    """

    from monitoring.sources import CHAINS_FILE

    chains = load_chains(CHAINS_FILE)

    for chain_id, chain in chains.items():

        credentials = chain.get("credentials")

        if credentials is None:
            continue

        assert isinstance(credentials, dict), (
            f"Chain {chain_id} credentials must be a dict"
        )

        assert isinstance(
            credentials.get("username"),
            str,
        ), (
            f"Chain {chain_id} has invalid credential username"
        )

        assert credentials["username"].strip(), (
            f"Chain {chain_id} has empty credential username"
        )

        assert isinstance(
            credentials.get("password"),
            str,
        ), (
            f"Chain {chain_id} has invalid credential password"
        )


def test_real_chains_json_government_names_are_nonempty():
    from monitoring.sources import CHAINS_FILE

    chains = load_chains(CHAINS_FILE)

    for chain_id, chain in chains.items():
        assert chain["Chain_name_gov_page"].strip(), (
            f"Chain {chain_id} has an empty Chain_name_gov_page"
        )

import csv
import json

import pytest

from monitoring import stores_missing as sm


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# store_id_candidates
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_store_id_candidates():
    assert sm.store_id_candidates("0007999") == [
        "0007999",
        "007999",
        "07999",
        "7999",
    ]


def test_store_id_candidates_without_leading_zeros():
    assert sm.store_id_candidates("1234") == ["1234"]


def test_store_id_candidates_all_zeros():
    assert sm.store_id_candidates("000") == ["000", "00", "0"]


def test_store_id_candidates_strips_whitespace():
    assert sm.store_id_candidates(" 00799 ") == ["00799", "0799", "799"]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# get_store_pairs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_get_store_pairs_from_list():
    data = [
        {"chain_id": "123", "store_id": "001"},
        {"chain_id": "123", "store_id": "002"},
        {"chain_id": "456", "store_id": "003"},
    ]

    assert sm.get_store_pairs(data) == {
        ("123", sm.normalize_store_id("001")),
        ("123", sm.normalize_store_id("002")),
        ("456", sm.normalize_store_id("003")),
    }


def test_get_store_pairs_from_stores_dict():
    data = {
        "stores": [
            {"chain_id": "123", "store_id": "001"},
        ]
    }

    assert sm.get_store_pairs(data) == {
        ("123", sm.normalize_store_id("001"))
    }


def test_get_store_pairs_from_values_dict():
    data = {
        "a": {"chain_id": "123", "store_id": "001"},
        "b": {"chain_id": "456", "store_id": "002"},
    }

    assert sm.get_store_pairs(data) == {
        ("123", sm.normalize_store_id("001")),
        ("456", sm.normalize_store_id("002")),
    }


@pytest.mark.parametrize("data", [None, "invalid", 123, []])
def test_get_store_pairs_invalid_or_empty_data(data):
    assert sm.get_store_pairs(data) == set()


def test_get_store_pairs_ignores_invalid_records():
    data = [
        None,
        "invalid",
        {},
        {"chain_id": "123"},
        {"store_id": "001"},
        {"chain_id": "", "store_id": "001"},
        {"chain_id": "123", "store_id": None},
        {"chain_id": "123", "store_id": "  "},
    ]

    assert sm.get_store_pairs(data) == set()

def test_load_chains_merges_files(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    first = tmp_path / "chains.json"
    second = tmp_path / "chains_extra.json"

    first.write_text(
        json.dumps({"123": {"name": "First"}, "456": {"name": "Old"}}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    second.write_text(
        json.dumps({"456": {"name": "Updated"}, "789": {"name": "Extra"}}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "CHAINS_FILES", [first, second])

    assert sm.load_chains() == {
        "123": {"name": "First"},
        "456": {"name": "Updated"},
        "789": {"name": "Extra"},
    }


def test_load_chains_skips_missing_files(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    existing = tmp_path / "chains.json"
    existing.write_text(
        json.dumps({"123": {"name": "First"}}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        sm,
        "CHAINS_FILES",
        [tmp_path / "missing.json", existing],
    )

    assert sm.load_chains() == {"123": {"name": "First"}}

def test_load_feed_data_groups_records_and_extracts_store_ids(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
):
    tracking_file = tmp_path / "file_tracking.csv"

    rows = [
        {
            "filename": "Price123-001-202601010000.gz",
            "source": "Shufersal",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "store_id": "",
        },
        {
            "filename": "Price123-002-202601010000.gz",
            "source": "Shufersal",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "store_id": "002",
        },
        {
            "filename": "Price456-003-202601010000.gz",
            "source": "Rami Levy",
            "chain_id": "456",
            "store_id": "003",
        },
        {
            "filename": "Stores123.json",
            "source": "Shufersal",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "store_id": "999",
        },
        {
            "filename": "Price123-004-202601010000.gz",
            "source": "Shufersal",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "store_id": "",
        },
        {
            "filename": "invalid.gz",
            "source": "Shufersal",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "store_id": "",
        },
        {
            "filename": "Price123-005-202601010000.gz",
            "source": "",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "store_id": "005",
        },
    ]

    with tracking_file.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=rows[0].keys())
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)

    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "TRACKING_FILE", tracking_file)

    assert sm.load_feed_data() == {
        ("shufersal", "123"): {"001", "002", "004"},
        ("rami levy", "456"): {"003"},
    }


def test_load_feed_data_supports_utf8_bom(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    tracking_file = tmp_path / "file_tracking.csv"

    with tracking_file.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(
            f,
            fieldnames=["filename", "source", "chain_id", "store_id"],
        )
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerow({
            "filename": "Price123-001-202601010000.gz",
            "source": "Shufersal",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "store_id": "001",
        })

    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "TRACKING_FILE", tracking_file)

    assert sm.load_feed_data() == {
        ("shufersal", "123"): {"001"}
    }

def test_find_chain_anomalies():
    feed_data = {
        ("shufersal", "123"),
        ("rami levy", "456"),
        ("unknown_source", "789"),
        ("shufersal", "999"),
    }

    chains = {
        "123": {"name_en_normalized": "shufersal"},
        "456": {"name_en_normalized": "victory"},
        "789": {"name_en_normalized": "unknown"},
    }

    assert sm.find_chain_anomalies(feed_data, chains) == [
        {
            "source": "rami levy",
            "chain_id": "456",
            "registered_owner": "victory",
        }
    ]


def test_find_chain_anomalies_ignores_missing_or_unknown_chains():
    feed_data = {
        ("source", "123"),
        ("source", "456"),
        ("source", "789"),
    }

    chains = {
        "123": {},
        "456": {"name_en_normalized": "unknown"},
    }

    assert sm.find_chain_anomalies(feed_data, chains) == []

    stores_file.write_text(

            {"chain_id": "123", "store_id": "002"},

        ]),

    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "STORES_DIR", stores_dir)

    assert sm.find_missing_stores(

    ) == ["004"]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_main_generates_missing_stores_report(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
    capsys,
):
    tracking_file = tmp_path / "file_tracking.csv"
    stores_dir = tmp_path / "stores"
    stores_dir.mkdir()
    output_file = tmp_path / "output" / "missing.json"

    rows = [
        {
            "filename": "Price123-001-202601010000.gz",
            "source": "Shufersal",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "store_id": "001",
        },
        {
            "filename": "Price123-002-202601010000.gz",
            "source": "Shufersal",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "store_id": "002",
        },
    ]

    with tracking_file.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=rows[0].keys())
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)

    (stores_dir / "shufersal.json").write_text(
        json.dumps([
            {"chain_id": "123", "store_id": "001"},
        ]),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "TRACKING_FILE", tracking_file)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "STORES_DIR", stores_dir)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "CHAINS_FILES", [])
    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "OUTPUT_FILE", output_file)

    sm.main()

    assert json.loads(output_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == {
        "shufersal:123": {
            "source": "shufersal",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "store_ids": ["002"],
        }
    }

    output = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert "Written:" in output
    assert "shufersal:123: 1 stores" in output


def test_main_missing_tracking_file(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    tracking_file = tmp_path / "missing.csv"

    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "TRACKING_FILE", tracking_file)

    sm.main()

    output = capsys.readouterr().out

    assert "WARNING" in output
    assert "Generate it first" in output
    assert not (tmp_path / "output").exists()


def test_main_reports_chain_anomalies_and_unknown_chains(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
    capsys,
):
    tracking_file = tmp_path / "file_tracking.csv"
    stores_dir = tmp_path / "stores"
    stores_dir.mkdir()

    output_file = tmp_path / "output" / "missing.json"

    rows = [
        {
            "filename": "Price123-001-202601010000.gz",
            "source": "Shufersal",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "store_id": "001",
        },
        {
            "filename": "Price456-002-202601010000.gz",
            "source": "Other",
            "chain_id": "456",
            "store_id": "002",
        },
    ]

    with tracking_file.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=rows[0].keys())
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)

    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "TRACKING_FILE", tracking_file)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "STORES_DIR", stores_dir)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "CHAINS_FILES", [])
    monkeypatch.setattr(sm, "OUTPUT_FILE", output_file)

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        sm,
        "load_chains",
        lambda: {
            "123": {"name_en_normalized": "Different Owner"},
        },
    )

    sm.main()

    output = capsys.readouterr().out

    assert "CHAIN SOURCE ANOMALIES:" in output
    assert "shufersal publishes chain 123" in output
    assert "registered owner: different owner" in output
    assert "No chain found" in output

    report = json.loads(output_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    assert "shufersal:123" in report
    assert "other:456" in report

def test_parse_product_maps_identity_and_names(raw_product):
    product = parse_product(raw_product)

    assert product["barcode"] == "7291234567890"
    assert product["local_barcode"] == "7291234567890"
    assert product["product_id"] == 456789
    assert product["id"] == 987654
    assert product["retailer_id"] == 1492
    assert product["supplier_id"] == 12345

    assert product["local_name"] == "מיץ תפוחים טבעי 1 ליטר"
    assert product["name_he"] == "מיץ תפוחים טבעי"
    assert product["name_en"] == "Natural Apple Juice"
    assert product["name_ru"] == "Натуральный яблочный сок"


def test_parse_product_maps_brand_and_categories(raw_product):
    product = parse_product(raw_product)

    assert product["brand_id"] == 321
    assert product["brand_name_he"] == "תפוח הזהב"
    assert product["brand_name_en"] == "Golden Apple"
    assert product["brand_name_ru"] == "Золотое яблоко"

    assert product["department_id"] == 100
    assert product["department_external_id"] == 10
    assert product["department_name"] == "משקאות"

    assert product["family_id"] == 200
    assert product["family_name_he"] == "מיצים"
    assert product["family_name_en"] == "Juices"

    assert product["category_ids"] == [11, 12]
    assert product["category_path_ids"] == [11, 12]
    assert product["category_path_he"] == ["משקאות", "מיצים טבעיים"]
    assert product["category_path_en"] == ["Beverages", "Natural Juices"]


def test_parse_product_maps_images_and_enrichment(raw_product):
    product = parse_product(raw_product)

    assert product["main_image_url"] == "https://example.com/apple-juice.jpg"
    assert len(product["images"]) == 2
    assert product["images"][0]["id"] == 555
    assert product["images"][0]["is_default"] is True
    assert product["nutrition_image_url"] == (
        "https://example.com/apple-juice-nutrition.jpg"
    )

    assert product["ingredients_he"] == "תפוחים 100%"
    assert product["ingredients_en"] == "100% apples"
    assert product["description_he"] == "מיץ תפוחים טבעי ללא תוספת סוכר"
    assert product["description_en"] == (
        "Natural apple juice with no added sugar"
    )

    assert product["nutrition_facts"] == {"energy": 46}
    assert product["nutrition_values"] == {"sugar": 10.3}


def test_parse_product_handles_missing_optional_fields():
    product = parse_product({"barcode": "7290000000000"})

    assert product["barcode"] == "7290000000000"
    assert product["name_he"] is None
    assert product["brand_id"] is None
    assert product["category_ids"] == []
    assert product["category_path_ids"] == []
    assert product["main_image_url"] is None
    assert product["images"] == []


def test_iter_products_reads_products_object(tmp_path, raw_product):
    path = tmp_path / "products.json"
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps({"total": 1, "products": [raw_product]}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    products = list(iter_products(path))

    assert len(products) == 1
    assert products[0]["barcode"] == "7291234567890"


def test_iter_products_reads_top_level_list(tmp_path, raw_product):
    path = tmp_path / "products.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps([raw_product]), encoding="utf-8")

    products = list(iter_products(path))

    assert len(products) == 1
    assert products[0]["product_id"] == 456789


def test_iter_products_skips_non_dictionary_entries(tmp_path, raw_product):
    path = tmp_path / "products.json"
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps({"products": [raw_product, None, "invalid", 123]}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    products = list(iter_products(path))

    assert len(products) == 1
    assert products[0]["barcode"] == "7291234567890"


def test_iter_products_rejects_invalid_structure(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "products.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps({"items": []}), encoding="utf-8")

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="no 'products' list"):
        list(iter_products(path))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_parse_product_returns_expected_fields(raw_product):
    product = parse_product(raw_product, "shufersal", "product.json")

    assert product["company"] == "shufersal"
    assert product["source"] == "shufersal"
    assert product["source_file"] == "product.json"

    assert product["barcode"] == GTIN
    assert product["local_barcode"] is None

    assert product["local_name"] == "חלב 3%"
    assert product["name_he"] == "חלב 3%"
    assert product["name_en"] is None

    assert product["brand_name_he"] == "תנובה"
    assert product["ingredients_he"] == "חלב, ויטמינים"

    assert product["category_path_he"] == ["מוצרי חלב", "חלב"]
    assert product["categories_paths"] == [
        [{"1": "מוצרי חלב"}, {"1": "חלב"}]
    ]


def test_parse_product_uses_item_code_before_other_candidates(raw_product):
    product = parse_product(raw_product, "shufersal", "product.json")

    assert product["barcode"] == GTIN


def test_parse_product_falls_back_to_page_code(raw_product):
    raw_product["item_code"] = "invalid"

    product = parse_product(raw_product, "shufersal", "product.json")

    assert product["barcode"] == GTIN
    assert product["local_barcode"] is None


def test_parse_product_falls_back_to_sku(raw_product):
    raw_product["item_code"] = "invalid"
    raw_product["page_code"] = None

    product = parse_product(raw_product, "shufersal", "product.json")

    assert product["barcode"] == GTIN
    assert product["local_barcode"] is None


def test_parse_product_preserves_invalid_barcode_as_local_barcode(raw_product):
    raw_product["item_code"] = "invalid"
    raw_product["page_code"] = None
    raw_product["sections"][0]["content"]['מק"ט'] = ["also-invalid"]

    product = parse_product(raw_product, "shufersal", "product.json")

    assert product["barcode"] is None
    assert product["local_barcode"] == "invalid"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Nutrition
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_parse_product_extracts_nutrition_values(raw_product):
    product = parse_product(raw_product, "shufersal", "product.json")

    nutrition = product["nutrition_values"]

    assert nutrition["sizes"] == [
        {
            "id": 1,
            "names": {"1": "ל-100 גרם"},
        }
    ]

    values = {item["names"]["1"]: item for item in nutrition["values"]}

    assert values["אנרגיה"]["sizeValues"] == [
        {
            "sizeId": 1,
            "unitOfMeasure": {"names": {"1": "קלוריות"}},
            "value": 250,
            "valueLessThan": False,
        }
    ]

    assert values["שומן"]["sizeValues"] == [
        {
            "sizeId": 1,
            "unitOfMeasure": {"names": {"1": "גרם"}},
            "value": 3,
            "valueLessThan": True,
        }
    ]


def test_parse_product_without_nutrition_returns_none(raw_product):
    raw_product["sections"] = [
        section
        for section in raw_product["sections"]
        if section["title"] != "ערכים תזונתיים"
    ]

    product = parse_product(raw_product, "shufersal", "product.json")

    assert product["nutrition_values"] is None

def test_collect_images_deduplicates_and_skips_placeholders():
    raw = {
        "images": [
            "https://example.com/products_regular/regular.jpg",
            "https://example.com/products_zoom/zoom.jpg",
            "https://example.com/products_zoom/zoom.jpg",
            "https://example.com/products_regular/Z_P_default.png",
            "https://example.com/S_P_default.png?width=200",
        ]
    }

    images = _collect_images(raw)

    assert [image["url"] for image in images] == [
        "https://example.com/products_regular/regular.jpg",
        "https://example.com/products_zoom/zoom.jpg",
    ]

    assert images[0]["is_default"] is False
    assert images[1]["is_default"] is True
    assert images[0]["classification"] == "regular"
    assert images[1]["classification"] == "zoom"


def test_collect_images_uses_first_image_when_no_zoom_exists():
    images = _collect_images({
        "images": [
            "https://example.com/products_regular/first.jpg",
            "https://example.com/products_regular/second.jpg",
        ]
    })

    assert images[0]["is_default"] is True
    assert images[1]["is_default"] is False


def test_collect_images_without_images_returns_empty_list():
    assert _collect_images({}) == []


def test_classification_extracts_type_from_url():
    assert _classification(
        "https://example.com/products_zoom/image.jpg"
    ) == "zoom"

    assert _classification(
        "https://example.com/products_regular/image.jpg"
    ) == "regular"


def test_classification_returns_none_for_unmatched_url():
    assert _classification("https://example.com/image.jpg") is None

def test_iter_products_reads_single_product_file(tmp_path, raw_product):
    path = tmp_path / "shufersal" / "product.json"
    path.parent.mkdir()
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(raw_product, ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    products = list(iter_products(path))

    assert len(products) == 1
    assert products[0]["barcode"] == GTIN
    assert products[0]["company"] == "shufersal"
    assert products[0]["source_file"] == "product.json"


def test_iter_products_reads_products_list(tmp_path, raw_product):
    path = tmp_path / "rami_levi" / "products.json"
    path.parent.mkdir()
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {"products": [raw_product, None, "invalid"]},
            ensure_ascii=False,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    products = list(iter_products(path))

    assert len(products) == 1
    assert products[0]["company"] == "rami_levi"


def test_iter_products_reads_top_level_list(tmp_path, raw_product):
    path = tmp_path / "shufersal" / "products.json"
    path.parent.mkdir()
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps([raw_product], ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    products = list(iter_products(path))

    assert len(products) == 1


def test_iter_products_counts_products_without_valid_gtin(
    tmp_path,
    raw_product,
):
    raw_product["item_code"] = "invalid"
    raw_product["page_code"] = None
    raw_product["sections"][0]["content"]['מק"ט'] = ["also-invalid"]

    path = tmp_path / "shufersal" / "products.json"
    path.parent.mkdir()
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps([raw_product], ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    stats = {}
    products = list(iter_products(path, stats=stats))

    assert len(products) == 1
    assert products[0]["barcode"] is None
    assert stats == {"no_valid_gtin": 1}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "document",
    [
        {},
        {"items": []},
        "invalid",
        123,
    ],
)
def test_iter_products_rejects_unrecognised_layout(tmp_path, document):
    path = tmp_path / "products.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(document), encoding="utf-8")

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unrecognised type_1 layout"):
        list(iter_products(path))

@pytest.mark.parametrize(

def test_resolve_barcode_falls_back_to_item_code(raw_product):
    raw_product["details"]["barcode"] = None

    assert _resolve_barcode(raw_product) == (GTIN, None)

    raw_product["item_code"] = None

    assert _resolve_barcode(raw_product) == (GTIN, None)

def test_parse_product(raw_product):

    assert product["barcode"] == GTIN
    assert product["local_barcode"] is None

    assert product["product_id"] == 402149
    assert product["id"] == 402149

    assert product["local_name"] == "מוצר לדוגמה 700 גרם"
    assert product["name_he"] == "מוצר לדוגמה 700 גרם"

    assert product["brand_name_he"] == "מותג לדוגמה"
    assert product["description_en"] == "Example product"

    assert product["ingredients_he"] == "סוכר, סירופ גלוקוז"

    assert product["department_id"] == 56
    assert product["department_name"] == "חטיפים ומתוקים"

    assert product["family_id"] == 301
    assert product["family_name_he"] == "סוכריות ומסטיקים"

    assert product["category_ids"] == [56, 301, 395]
    assert product["category_path_ids"] == [56, 301, 395]
    assert product["category_path_he"] == [
        "חטיפים ומתוקים",
        "סוכריות ומסטיקים",
        "סוכריות ג'לי",
    ]

    assert product["search_keywords"] == ["סוכריות", "ממתקים"]
    assert product["family_search_keywords"] == []

    assert product["nutrition_facts"] is None
    assert product["nutrition_values"] is not None

    assert product["main_image_url"] == (
        "https://cdn.example.test/product/large.jpg"
    )

    assert len(product["images"]) == 4
    assert product["images"][0]["is_default"] is True


def test_parse_product_with_invalid_barcode(raw_product):

def test_iter_products_single_product(tmp_path, raw_product):
    path = tmp_path / "product.json"
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(raw_product, ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    products = list(iter_products(path))

    assert len(products) == 1
    assert products[0]["barcode"] == GTIN


def test_iter_products_products_layout(tmp_path, raw_product):
    path = tmp_path / "products.json"
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps({"products": [raw_product, raw_product]}, ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    products = list(iter_products(path))

    assert len(products) == 2


def test_iter_products_list_layout(tmp_path, raw_product):
    path = tmp_path / "products.json"
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps([raw_product, raw_product], ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    products = list(iter_products(path))

    assert len(products) == 2


def test_iter_products_skips_non_mapping_entries(tmp_path, raw_product):
    path = tmp_path / "products.json"
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps([None, "invalid", raw_product], ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    products = list(iter_products(path))

    assert len(products) == 1
    assert products[0]["barcode"] == GTIN


def test_iter_products_updates_stats(tmp_path, raw_product):
    raw_product["details"]["barcode"] = 32147231
    raw_product["item_code"] = "32147231"

    path = tmp_path / "products.json"
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps([raw_product, raw_product], ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    stats = {}
    products = list(iter_products(path, stats=stats))

    assert len(products) == 2
    assert stats["no_valid_gtin"] == 2


def test_iter_products_does_not_count_valid_gtins(tmp_path, raw_product):
    path = tmp_path / "products.json"
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps([raw_product], ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    stats = {}
    list(iter_products(path, stats=stats))

    assert stats == {}


def test_iter_products_unrecognized_layout(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "invalid.json"
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps({"unexpected": []}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unrecognised type_2 layout"):
        list(iter_products(path))

import logging
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest
from lxml import etree

from parsers.xml import StoreXmlParser


@pytest.fixture
def parser():
    return StoreXmlParser()


# ============================================================
# Builders
# ============================================================


def make_xml(
    content="",
    section="Items",
    sub_chain_id="001",
    store_id="018",
    chain_id="7290661400001",
):
    return f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Root>
    <ChainID>{chain_id}</ChainID>
    <SubChainID>{sub_chain_id}</SubChainID>
    <StoreID>{store_id}</StoreID>
    <BikoretNo>0</BikoretNo>
    <{section}>
        {content}
    </{section}>
</Root>
""".encode("utf-8")


def real_item_xml(
    item_code="50000574438",
    name="חטיף לחתול מעדני הים",
    price="12.9",
    unit="גרם 100",
    weighted="0",
    allow_discount="0",
):
    """A realistic, fully populated <Item> copied from a real feed."""
    return f"""
<Item>
    <PriceUpdateTime>2025-07-10T11:06:51.000</PriceUpdateTime>
    <ItemCode>{item_code}</ItemCode>
    <LastSaleDateTime>2026-07-29T09:57:15.000</LastSaleDateTime>
    <ItemType>0</ItemType>
    <ItemName>{name}</ItemName>
    <ManufactureName>נסטלה פורינה פטקר ארצות הברית</ManufactureName>
    <ManufactureCountry>US</ManufactureCountry>
    <ManufactureItemDescription>
        חטיף לחתול Party Mix מעדני הים קראנץ'
    </ManufactureItemDescription>
    <UnitQty>גרם</UnitQty>
    <Quantity>60</Quantity>
    <UnitOfMeasure>{unit}</UnitOfMeasure>
    <bIsWeighted>{weighted}</bIsWeighted>
    <QtyInPackage>1</QtyInPackage>
    <ItemPrice>{price}</ItemPrice>
    <UnitOfMeasurePrice>21.5</UnitOfMeasurePrice>
    <AllowDiscount>{allow_discount}</AllowDiscount>
    <ItemStatus />
</Item>
"""


def item_xml(**tags):
    """
    Minimal <Item>. Every keyword is a tag name; pass None to omit the tag.

        item_xml(ItemPrice="abc")      -> invalid price
        item_xml(ItemPrice=None)       -> no <ItemPrice> element at all
    """
    fields = {
        "ItemCode": "123",
        "ItemName": "Test item",
        "ItemPrice": "5.00",
    }
    fields.update(tags)

    inner = "".join(
        f"<{tag}>{value}</{tag}>"
        for tag, value in fields.items()
        if value is not None
    )

    return f"<Item>{inner}</Item>"


def real_promo_xml():
    """A realistic promotion using the explicit Groups/Group layout."""
    return """
<Promotion>
    <PromotionUpdateTime>2026-08-11T12:04:21.000</PromotionUpdateTime>
    <AllowMultipleDiscounts>0</AllowMultipleDiscounts>
    <PromotionID>1462415</PromotionID>
    <PromotionDescription>*היינקן סליק בירה 330מ"ל פחית ב4.20ש מוגבל 4 יח'</PromotionDescription>
    <PromotionStartDateTime>2026-08-16T00:00:00.000</PromotionStartDateTime>
    <PromotionEndDateTime>2026-08-21T00:00:00.000</PromotionEndDateTime>
    <PromotionStartHour/>
    <PromotionEndHour/>
    <PromotionDays/>
    <RedemptionLimit>4</RedemptionLimit>
    <MinNoOfItemOffered>10</MinNoOfItemOffered>
    <ClubID>0</ClubID>
    <IsGiftItem>4</IsGiftItem>
    <AdditionalIsCoupon>0</AdditionalIsCoupon>
    <AdditionalRestrictions/>
    <Remarks> </Remarks>

    <Groups>
        <Group>
            <GroupID>1</GroupID>
            <MinPurchaseAmount>0</MinPurchaseAmount>
            <DiscountType/>
            <PromotionItems>
                <PromotionItem>
                    <ItemCode>7290008464598</ItemCode>
                    <ItemType>1</ItemType>
                    <RewardType>3</RewardType>
                    <MinQty>1</MinQty>
                    <MaxQty/>
                    <DiscountRate>52.44</DiscountRate>
                    <DiscountedPrice>4.2</DiscountedPrice>
                    <DiscountedPricePerMida>1.18</DiscountedPricePerMida>
                    <bIsWeighted>0</bIsWeighted>
                </PromotionItem>
            </PromotionItems>
        </Group>
    </Groups>
</Promotion>
"""


def promo_xml(inner="", promotion_id="100"):
    """Minimal <Promotion>. promotion_id=None omits the ID tag entirely."""
    id_xml = (
        ""
        if promotion_id is None
        else f"<PromotionID>{promotion_id}</PromotionID>"
    )

    return f"<Promotion>{id_xml}{inner}</Promotion>"


def flat_item(code, extra=""):
    """An <Item> for the layout that has no <Groups>."""
    return f"<Item><ItemCode>{code}</ItemCode>{extra}</Item>"


def parse_promos(parser, *promotions, **xml_kwargs):
    return parser.parse_promo_file(
        make_xml(
            "".join(promotions),
            section="Promotions",
            **xml_kwargs,
        )
    )


def parse_one_promo(parser, promotion):
    promotions = parse_promos(parser, promotion)

    assert len(promotions) == 1

    return promotions[0]

def test_parse_real_price_item(parser):
    xml = make_xml(real_item_xml())

    products = parser.parse_price_file(xml)

    assert len(products) == 1

    product = products[0]

    assert product.chain_id == "7290661400001"
    assert product.sub_chain_id == "001"
    assert product.store_id == "018"
    assert product.item_code == "50000574438"
    assert product.name == "חטיף לחתול מעדני הים"
    assert product.price == Decimal("12.9")
    assert product.unit_price == Decimal("21.5")
    assert product.quantity == Decimal("60")
    assert product.unit_qty == "גרם"
    assert product.unit_measure == "גרם 100"
    assert product.manufacturer == "נסטלה פורינה פטקר ארצות הברית"
    assert product.manufacturer_country == "US"
    assert product.weighted is False
    assert product.allow_discount is False
    assert product.price_update_time == datetime(2025, 7, 10, 11, 6, 51)
    assert product.last_sale_datetime == datetime(2026, 7, 29, 9, 57, 15)
    assert product.item_type == 0
    assert product.package_quantity == 1
    assert product.status is None


def test_parse_multiple_items_keeps_file_order(parser):
    xml = make_xml(
        real_item_xml(item_code="111")
        + real_item_xml(item_code="222")
    )

    products = parser.parse_price_file(xml)

    assert [p.item_code for p in products] == ["111", "222"]


def test_parse_empty_items_section_returns_empty_list(parser):
    assert parser.parse_price_file(make_xml()) == []


def test_price_parser_ignores_promotion_files(parser):
    xml = make_xml(
        real_promo_xml(),
        section="Promotions",
    )

    assert parser.parse_price_file(xml) == []


def test_comments_and_processing_instructions_are_ignored(parser):
    xml = make_xml(
        "<!-- a comment -->"
        + item_xml(ItemCode="111")
        + "<?some-instruction data?>"
        + item_xml(ItemCode="222")
    )

    products = parser.parse_price_file(xml)

    assert [p.item_code for p in products] == ["111", "222"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "xml_content",
    [
        b"<Root><Items><Item>",
        b"",
        b"not xml at all",
    ],
    ids=["malformed-xml", "empty-xml", "invalid-text"],
)
def test_invalid_xml_raises(parser, xml_content):
    with pytest.raises(etree.XMLSyntaxError):
        parser.parse_price_file(xml_content)

    with pytest.raises(etree.XMLSyntaxError):
        parser.parse_promo_file(xml_content)

def test_missing_root_metadata_is_none(parser):
    xml = (
        b"<Root><Items><Item>"
        b"<ItemCode>123</ItemCode><ItemPrice>5</ItemPrice>"
        b"</Item></Items></Root>"
    )

    product = parser.parse_price_file(xml)[0]

    assert product.chain_id is None
    assert product.sub_chain_id is None
    assert product.store_id is None


def test_root_metadata_is_stripped(parser):
    xml = make_xml(
        real_item_xml(),
        chain_id=" 7290661400001 ",
        sub_chain_id=" 001 ",
        store_id=" 018 ",
    )

    product = parser.parse_price_file(xml)[0]

    assert product.chain_id == "7290661400001"
    assert product.sub_chain_id == "001"
    assert product.store_id == "018"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "tags",
    [
        ("ChainID", "SubChainID", "StoreID"),
        ("ChainId", "SubChainId", "StoreId"),
        ("chainid", "subchainid", "storeid"),
        ("CHAINID", "SUBCHAINID", "STOREID"),
    ],
)
def test_root_metadata_tags_are_case_insensitive(parser, tags):
    chain_tag, sub_chain_tag, store_tag = tags

    xml = f"""
<Root>
    <{chain_tag}>123</{chain_tag}>
    <{sub_chain_tag}>456</{sub_chain_tag}>
    <{store_tag}>789</{store_tag}>
    <Items>
        {item_xml()}
    </Items>
</Root>
""".encode()

    product = parser.parse_price_file(xml)[0]

    assert product.chain_id == "123"
    assert product.sub_chain_id == "456"
    assert product.store_id == "789"


def test_promo_file_root_metadata_is_normalized(parser):
    xml = b"""
<Root>
    <CHAINID> 123 </CHAINID>
    <StoreId> 789 </StoreId>
    <Promotions>
        <Promotion><PromotionID>1</PromotionID></Promotion>
    </Promotions>
</Root>
"""

    promotion = parser.parse_promo_file(xml)[0]

    assert promotion.chain_id == "123"
    assert promotion.store_id == "789"

def test_normalize_xml_tags_lowercases_tags_only():
    root = etree.fromstring(
        b'<Root Attr="Keep"><!-- note --><Child>Text</Child>'
        b"<?pi data?></Root>"
    )

    StoreXmlParser.normalize_xml_tags(root)

    assert root.tag == "root"
    assert root[1].tag == "child"
    assert root.get("Attr") == "Keep"
    assert root[1].text == "Text"

def test_parse_real_promotion_group(real_promotion):
    assert len(real_promotion.groups) == 1

    group = real_promotion.groups[0]

    assert group.chain_id == "7290661400001"
    assert group.promotion_id == "1462415"
    assert group.store_id == "097"

    assert group.discount_type is None

    assert promotion.remarks == "see store"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "tag, attribute",
    [
        ("AdditionalIsCoupon", "additional_is_coupon"),
        ("AllowMultipleDiscounts", "allow_multiple_discounts"),
    ],
)
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "value, expected",
    [("1", True), ("0", False), (None, False)],
)
def test_promotion_boolean_flags(parser, tag, attribute, value, expected):
    inner = "" if value is None else f"<{tag}>{value}</{tag}>"

    promotion = parse_one_promo(parser, promo_xml(inner))

    assert getattr(promotion, attribute) is expected

def test_start_and_end_datetime_are_preferred_over_date_and_hour(parser):
    promotion = parse_one_promo(
        parser,
        promo_xml(
            """
            <PromotionStartDateTime>2026-08-16T00:00:00</PromotionStartDateTime>
            <PromotionEndDateTime>2026-08-21T00:00:00</PromotionEndDateTime>
            <PromotionStartDate>2020-01-01</PromotionStartDate>
            <PromotionEndDate>2020-12-31</PromotionEndDate>
            """
        ),
    )

    assert promotion.start_datetime == datetime(2026, 8, 16)
    assert promotion.end_datetime == datetime(2026, 8, 21)


def test_date_and_hour_fallback(parser):
    promotion = parse_one_promo(
        parser,
        promo_xml(
            """
            <PromotionStartDate>2026-01-01</PromotionStartDate>
            <PromotionStartHour>00:00:00</PromotionStartHour>
            <PromotionEndDate>2026-12-31</PromotionEndDate>
            <PromotionEndHour>23:59:00</PromotionEndHour>
            """
        ),
    )

    assert promotion.start_datetime == datetime(2026, 1, 1)
    assert promotion.end_datetime == datetime(2026, 12, 31, 23, 59)


def test_date_without_hour_falls_back_to_midnight(parser):
    promotion = parse_one_promo(
        parser,
        promo_xml(
            """
            <PromotionStartDate>2026-01-01</PromotionStartDate>
            <PromotionEndDate>2026-01-31</PromotionEndDate>
            """
        ),
    )

    assert promotion.start_datetime == datetime(2026, 1, 1)
    assert promotion.end_datetime == datetime(2026, 1, 31)


def test_invalid_start_datetime_falls_back_to_date_and_hour(parser):
    promotion = parse_one_promo(
        parser,
        promo_xml(
            """
            <PromotionStartDateTime>garbage</PromotionStartDateTime>
            <PromotionStartDate>2026-03-01</PromotionStartDate>
            <PromotionStartHour>09:00:00</PromotionStartHour>
            """
        ),
    )

    assert promotion.start_datetime == datetime(2026, 3, 1, 9, 0)


def test_missing_dates_are_none(parser):
    promotion = parse_one_promo(parser, promo_xml())

    assert promotion.start_datetime is None
    assert promotion.end_datetime is None
    assert promotion.update_time is None


def test_update_time_falls_back_to_update_date(parser):
    promotion = parse_one_promo(
        parser,
        promo_xml(
            "<PromotionUpdateDate>2025-12-31 14:24:00</PromotionUpdateDate>"
        ),
    )

    assert promotion.update_time == datetime(2025, 12, 31, 14, 24)


def test_update_time_is_preferred_over_update_date(parser):
    promotion = parse_one_promo(
        parser,
        promo_xml(
            """
            <PromotionUpdateTime>2026-01-02T03:04:05</PromotionUpdateTime>
            <PromotionUpdateDate>2020-01-01 00:00:00</PromotionUpdateDate>

    assert promotion.update_time == datetime(2026, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)

def test_parse_multiple_groups_and_items(parser):
    promotion = parse_one_promo(
        parser,
        promo_xml(
            """
<Groups>
    <Group>
        <GroupID>1</GroupID>
        <MinPurchaseAmount>10</MinPurchaseAmount>
        <DiscountType>1</DiscountType>
        <PromotionItems>
            <PromotionItem>
                <ItemCode>111</ItemCode>
                <bIsWeighted>0</bIsWeighted>
            </PromotionItem>
            <PromotionItem>
                <ItemCode>222</ItemCode>
                <bIsWeighted>1</bIsWeighted>
            </PromotionItem>
        </PromotionItems>
    </Group>
    <Group>
        <GroupID>2</GroupID>
        <MinPurchaseAmount>20</MinPurchaseAmount>
        <DiscountType>2</DiscountType>
        <PromotionItems>
            <PromotionItem>
                <ItemCode>333</ItemCode>
            </PromotionItem>
        </PromotionItems>
    </Group>
</Groups>
"""
        ),
    )

    group1, group2 = promotion.groups

    assert group1.group_id == "1"
    assert group1.min_purchase_amount == Decimal("10")
    assert group1.discount_type == "1"
    assert [i.item_code for i in group1.items] == ["111", "222"]
    assert [i.is_weighted for i in group1.items] == [False, True]

    assert group2.group_id == "2"
    assert group2.min_purchase_amount == Decimal("20")
    assert group2.discount_type == "2"
    assert [i.item_code for i in group2.items] == ["333"]

def test_duplicate_promotion_id_merges_groups_and_keeps_first_values(
    parser,
):
    def promo(group_id, item_code, description):
        return promo_xml(
            f"""
<PromotionDescription>{description}</PromotionDescription>
<Groups>
    <Group>
        <GroupID>{group_id}</GroupID>
        <PromotionItems>
            <PromotionItem><ItemCode>{item_code}</ItemCode></PromotionItem>
        </PromotionItems>
    </Group>
</Groups>
"""
        )

    promotions = parse_promos(
        parser,
        promo("1", "111", "First"),
        promo("2", "222", "Second"),
    )

    assert len(promotions) == 1

    promotion = promotions[0]

    assert promotion.description == "First"
    assert [g.group_id for g in promotion.groups] == ["1", "2"]
    assert [g.items[0].item_code for g in promotion.groups] == [
        "111",
        "222",
    ]

def test_promotion_item_with_invalid_number_is_kept_with_none(parser):
    """
    parse_int() swallows bad values, so the item is NOT dropped: only the
    unparseable field becomes None. (Items are only skipped when an
    unexpected exception escapes -- see the error-isolation tests below.)
    """
    promotion = parse_one_promo(
        parser,
        promo_xml(
            """
<Groups>
    <Group>
        <GroupID>1</GroupID>
        <PromotionItems>
            <PromotionItem>
                <ItemCode>111</ItemCode>
                <RewardType>not-a-number</RewardType>
            </PromotionItem>
            <PromotionItem>
                <ItemCode>222</ItemCode>
                <RewardType>3</RewardType>
            </PromotionItem>
        </PromotionItems>
    </Group>
</Groups>
"""
        ),
    )

    items = promotion.groups[0].items

    assert [i.item_code for i in items] == ["111", "222"]
    assert [i.reward_type for i in items] == [None, 3]


def test_group_and_item_tags_are_case_insensitive(parser):
    promotion = parse_one_promo(

        """

    <promotionid>100</promotionid>
    <GROUPS>
        <gRoUp>
            <gRoUpId>1</gRoUpId>
            <PROMOTIONITEMS>
                <pRoMoTiOnItEm>
                    <iTeMcOdE>123</iTeMcOdE>
                    <iTeMtYpE>1</iTeMtYpE>
                    <rEwArDtYpE>3</rEwArDtYpE>
                </pRoMoTiOnItEm>
            </PROMOTIONITEMS>
        </gRoUp>
    </GROUPS>
</Promotion>
""",

    assert item.reward_type == 3

def test_mixed_promotion_item_and_item_elements_are_all_collected(parser):
    promotion = parse_one_promo(
        parser,
        promo_xml(
            "<PromotionItems>"
            + flat_item("item-1")
            + "<PromotionItem><ItemCode>promo-item-1</ItemCode></PromotionItem>"
            + flat_item("item-2")
            + "</PromotionItems>"
        ),
    )

    # <PromotionItem> elements are collected first, then <Item> elements.
    assert [i.item_code for i in promotion.groups[0].items] == [
        "promo-item-1",

        "item-2",
    ]

# ============================================================
# Error isolation
# ============================================================


def test_unexpected_error_in_one_promotion_does_not_drop_the_others(
    parser,
    monkeypatch,
    caplog,
):
    real_parse_datetime = parser.parse_datetime

    def flaky_parse_datetime(value):
        if value == "explode":
            raise RuntimeError("boom")

        return real_parse_datetime(value)

    monkeypatch.setattr(parser, "parse_datetime", flaky_parse_datetime)

    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="parsers.xml"):
        promotions = parse_promos(
            parser,
            promo_xml(
                "<PromotionStartDateTime>explode</PromotionStartDateTime>",
                promotion_id="1",
            ),
            promo_xml(promotion_id="2"),
        )

    assert [p.promotion_id for p in promotions] == ["2"]
    assert "Skipping malformed promotion" in caplog.text
    assert "promotion_id=1" in caplog.text


def test_unexpected_error_in_one_item_does_not_drop_the_others(
    parser,
    monkeypatch,
    caplog,
):
    real_parse_int = parser.parse_int

    def flaky_parse_int(value):
        if value == "boom":
            raise RuntimeError("boom")

        return real_parse_int(value)

    monkeypatch.setattr(parser, "parse_int", flaky_parse_int)

    promotion_xml = promo_xml(
        "<PromotionItems>"
        + flat_item("111", "<ItemType>boom</ItemType>")
        + flat_item("222", "<ItemType>1</ItemType>")
        + "</PromotionItems>"
    )

    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="parsers.xml"):
        promotion = parse_one_promo(parser, promotion_xml)

    assert [i.item_code for i in promotion.groups[0].items] == ["222"]
    assert "Skipping malformed promotion item" in caplog.text
    assert "item_code=111" in caplog.text

from scrapers.product_pages.common import add_field, clean, split_list, unique


# ============================================================
# clean
# ============================================================

def test_clean_collapses_whitespace():
    assert clean("  milk   chocolate \n\t  100g  ") == "milk chocolate 100g"


def test_clean_handles_empty_string():
    assert clean("") == ""


def test_clean_handles_whitespace_only():
    assert clean("  \n\t ") == ""


def test_clean_preserves_text():
    assert clean("Milk 2%") == "Milk 2%"


# ============================================================
# split_list
# ============================================================

def test_split_list_splits_commas():
    assert split_list("milk, bread, eggs") == ["milk", "bread", "eggs"]


def test_split_list_splits_newlines():
    assert split_list("milk\nbread\neggs") == ["milk", "bread", "eggs"]


def test_split_list_cleans_whitespace():
    assert split_list("  milk  , \n bread  , eggs  ") == [
        "milk",
        "bread",
        "eggs",
    ]


def test_split_list_removes_empty_items():
    assert split_list("milk,,\nbread, ,eggs") == [
        "milk",
        "bread",
        "eggs",
    ]


def test_split_list_handles_empty_string():
    assert split_list("") == []


def test_split_list_handles_single_item():
    assert split_list("milk") == ["milk"]

def test_split_list_splits_html_breaks():
    assert split_list("milk<br>bread<br/>eggs") == [
        "milk",
        "bread",
        "eggs",
    ]


# ============================================================
# unique
# ============================================================

def test_unique_removes_duplicates():
    assert unique(["milk", "bread", "milk", "eggs"]) == [
        "milk",
        "bread",
        "eggs",
    ]


def test_unique_preserves_order():
    assert unique(["b", "a", "c", "a", "b"]) == ["b", "a", "c"]


def test_unique_removes_falsy_values():
    assert unique(["milk", None, "", "bread", None, ""]) == [
        "milk",
        "bread",
    ]


def test_unique_handles_empty_list():
    assert unique([]) == []


def test_unique_handles_all_falsy_values():
    assert unique([None, "", None, ""]) == []


# ============================================================
# add_field
# ============================================================

def test_add_field_creates_new_label():
    fields = {}

    add_field(fields, "Brand", "Example")

    assert fields == {"Brand": ["Example"]}


def test_add_field_appends_repeated_labels():
    fields = {}

    add_field(fields, "Kashrut", "First certification")
    add_field(fields, "Kashrut", "Second certification")

    assert fields == {
        "Kashrut": [
            "First certification",
            "Second certification",
        ]
    }


def test_add_field_preserves_other_labels():
    fields = {"Brand": ["Example"]}

    add_field(fields, "Weight", "500 g")
    add_field(fields, "Brand", "Another brand")

    assert fields == {
        "Brand": ["Example", "Another brand"],
        "Weight": ["500 g"],
    }


def test_add_field_ignores_empty_label():
    fields = {}

    add_field(fields, "", "Example")

    assert fields == {}


def test_add_field_ignores_empty_value():
    fields = {}

    add_field(fields, "Brand", "")

    assert fields == {}


def test_add_field_ignores_none_label_or_value():
    fields = {}

    add_field(fields, None, "Example")
    add_field(fields, "Brand", None)

    assert fields == {}

import asyncio
import json

from scrapers.product_pages import scraper


# ============================================================
# Test helpers
# ============================================================

def make_page_type(
    name="type_test",
    marker=".product",
    matches=None,
    prepare=None,
    parse=None,
):
    return scraper.PageType(
        name=name,
        marker=marker,
        matches=matches,
        prepare=prepare,
        parse=parse or (lambda html: {"name": "Example product"}),
    )


def make_site(page_type=None, name="example market", api=None):
    return scraper.Site(
        name=name,
        url_template="https://example.test/products/{item_code}",
        page_type=page_type or make_page_type(),
        api=api,
    )

def test_read_site_entries_ignores_comments_and_blank_lines():
    contents = """
# Example site

https://example.test/products/1234567890123
  # another comment
https://shop.sample.test/item/9876543210987
"""

    with (
        patch.object(scraper, "URLS_FILE") as urls_file,
        patch.object(
            scraper,
            "site_name",
            side_effect=["example market", "sample shop"],
        ),
    ):
        urls_file.read_text.return_value = contents
        entries = scraper.read_site_entries()

    assert entries == [
        (
            "example market",
            "https://example.test/products/1234567890123",
            "https://example.test/products/{item_code}",
            "1234567890123",
        ),
        (
            "sample shop",
            "https://shop.sample.test/item/9876543210987",
            "https://shop.sample.test/item/{item_code}",
            "9876543210987",
        ),
    ]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "url",
    [
        "https://example.test/products/no-barcode",
        "https://example.test/products/12345678/87654321",
    ],
)
def test_read_site_entries_rejects_invalid_barcode_count(url):
    with (
        patch.object(scraper, "URLS_FILE") as urls_file,
        patch.object(scraper, "site_name") as mocked_site_name,
    ):
        urls_file.read_text.return_value = url

        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Expected exactly one barcode"):
            scraper.read_site_entries()

    mocked_site_name.assert_not_called()


def test_site_name_uses_closest_chain_name():
    connection = MagicMock()
    cursor = MagicMock()
    cursor.fetchall.return_value = [
        ("example market",),
        ("sample shop",),
    ]

    connection.__enter__.return_value = connection
    connection.cursor.return_value.__enter__.return_value = cursor

    with patch("db.get_connection", return_value=connection):
        name = scraper.site_name(
            "https://www.example-market.test/item/12345678"
        )

    assert name == "example market"


def test_site_name_falls_back_to_hostname():
    connection = MagicMock()
    cursor = MagicMock()
    cursor.fetchall.return_value = [("unrelated shop",)]

    connection.__enter__.return_value = connection
    connection.cursor.return_value.__enter__.return_value = cursor

    with (
        patch("db.get_connection", return_value=connection),
        patch.object(scraper, "get_close_matches", return_value=[]),
    ):
        name = scraper.site_name(
            "https://new-store.test/item/12345678"
        )

    assert name == "new store"
