def test_discover_types_loads_type_modules():
    module = SimpleNamespace(__path__=["unused"])
    module_info = SimpleNamespace(name="type_example")

    fake_type_module = SimpleNamespace(
        MARKER=".example",
        matches=None,
        parse=lambda html: {"name": "Example"},
        prepare=None,
    )

    with (
        patch.object(scraper.importlib, "import_module") as import_module,
        patch.object(
            scraper.pkgutil,
            "iter_modules",
            return_value=[module_info],
        ),
    ):
        import_module.side_effect = [
            module,
            fake_type_module,
        ]

        types = scraper.discover_types()

    assert len(types) == 1
    assert types[0].name == "type_example"
    assert types[0].marker == ".example"
    assert types[0].matches is None
    assert types[0].prepare is None
    assert types[0].parse("<html></html>") == {"name": "Example"}


def test_discover_types_accepts_api_type():
    module = SimpleNamespace(__path__=["unused"])
    module_info = SimpleNamespace(name="type_api")

    matches = lambda payload, code: True

    fake_type_module = SimpleNamespace(
        MARKER=None,
        matches=matches,
        parse=lambda payload, code, url: {},
        prepare=None,
    )

    with (
        patch.object(scraper.importlib, "import_module") as import_module,
        patch.object(
            scraper.pkgutil,
            "iter_modules",
            return_value=[module_info],
        ),
    ):
        import_module.side_effect = [
            module,
            fake_type_module,
        ]

        types = scraper.discover_types()

    assert len(types) == 1
    assert types[0].name == "type_api"
    assert types[0].marker is None
    assert types[0].matches is matches


def test_discover_types_rejects_module_without_marker_or_matches():
    module = SimpleNamespace(__path__=["unused"])
    module_info = SimpleNamespace(name="type_broken")
    broken_module = SimpleNamespace(parse=lambda html: {})

    with (
        patch.object(scraper.importlib, "import_module") as import_module,
        patch.object(
            scraper.pkgutil,
            "iter_modules",
            return_value=[module_info],
        ),
    ):
        import_module.side_effect = [
            module,
            broken_module,
        ]

        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="must define parse"):
            scraper.discover_types()


def test_discover_types_rejects_empty_package():
    module = SimpleNamespace(__path__=["unused"])

    with (
        patch.object(
            scraper.importlib,
            "import_module",
            return_value=module,
        ),
        patch.object(scraper.pkgutil, "iter_modules", return_value=[]),
    ):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="No page types found"):
            scraper.discover_types()

async def test_new_context_sets_locale_viewport_and_route():
    browser = MagicMock()
    context = MagicMock()
    context.route = AsyncMock()
    browser.new_context = AsyncMock(return_value=context)

    result = await scraper.new_context(browser)

    browser.new_context.assert_awaited_once_with(
        viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 1000},
        locale="he-IL",
    )
    context.route.assert_awaited_once_with(

        scraper.block_heavy,
    )
    assert result is context

    expected = make_page_type(marker=".example")
    other = make_page_type(name="type_other", marker=".other")

        context,
        "example market",

    page.close.assert_awaited_once()

def test_build_api_request_replaces_item_code():
    request = SimpleNamespace(
        method="POST",
        url="https://example.test/api/products/12345678",
        post_data='{"code": "12345678"}',
        headers={
            "content-type": "application/json",
            "cookie": "session=abc",
            "host": "example.test",
            "x-item": "12345678",
        },
    )

    result = scraper.build_api_request(request, "12345678")

    assert result == scraper.ApiRequest(
        method="POST",
        url="https://example.test/api/products/{item_code}",
        body='{"code": "{item_code}"}',
        headers={
            "content-type": "application/json",
            "x-item": "{item_code}",
        },
    )


def test_api_request_render_replaces_item_code():
    api = scraper.ApiRequest(
        method="GET",
        url="https://example.test/api/{item_code}",
        body=None,
        headers={"x-item": "{item_code}"},
    )

    result = api.render("12345678")

    assert result == {
        "url": "https://example.test/api/12345678",
        "method": "GET",
        "data": None,
        "headers": {"x-item": "12345678"},
    }


def test_request_body_returns_post_data():
    request = SimpleNamespace(post_data='{"code": "123"}')

    assert scraper.request_body(request) == '{"code": "123"}'


def test_request_body_handles_binary_data():
    request = MagicMock()
    type(request).post_data = property(
        lambda self: (_ for _ in ()).throw(UnicodeDecodeError(
            "utf-8", b"\xff", 0, 1, "invalid start byte"
        ))
    )

    assert scraper.request_body(request) is None


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_match_api_returns_matching_request():
    request = SimpleNamespace(
        resource_type="fetch",
        method="GET",
        url="https://example.test/api/12345678",
        post_data=None,
        headers={"accept": "application/json"},
    )

    response = MagicMock()
    response.request = request
    response.json = AsyncMock(
        return_value={"product": {"code": "12345678"}}
    )

    page_type = make_page_type(
        name="type_api",
        marker=None,
        matches=lambda payload, code: (
            payload["product"]["code"] == code
        ),
    )

    result = await scraper.match_api(
        response,
        "12345678",
        [page_type],
    )

    assert result is not None
    detected_type, api = result

    assert detected_type is page_type
    assert api.url == "https://example.test/api/{item_code}"

# ============================================================
# Saving results

def test_save_result_writes_valid_json(tmp_path):
    result = {
        "item_code": "12345678",
        "name": "Example product",
        "description": "Hebrew text: חלב",
    }

    scraper.save_result(tmp_path, "12345678", result)

    path = tmp_path / "12345678.json"

    assert path.exists()
    assert json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == result
    assert not (tmp_path / "12345678.json.tmp").exists()


def test_save_result_creates_output_directory(tmp_path):
    out_dir = tmp_path / "nested" / "products"

    scraper.save_result(
        out_dir,
        "12345678",
        {"name": "Example"},
    )

    assert (out_dir / "12345678.json").exists()


def test_save_result_replaces_existing_file(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "12345678.json"
    path.write_text('{"old": true}', encoding="utf-8")

    scraper.save_result(
        tmp_path,
        "12345678",
        {"new": True},
    )

    assert json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == {"new": True}

def test_load_item_codes_uses_site_name():
    connection = MagicMock()
    cursor = MagicMock()
    cursor.fetchall.return_value = [
        ("12345678",),
        ("87654321",),
    ]

    connection.__enter__.return_value = connection
    connection.cursor.return_value.__enter__.return_value = cursor

    with patch("db.get_connection", return_value=connection):
        codes = scraper.load_item_codes("example market")

    cursor.execute.assert_called_once_with(
        scraper.SQL_ITEM_CODES,
        ("example market",),
    )
    assert codes == ["12345678", "87654321"]

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_worker_saves_successful_result(tmp_path):
    queue = asyncio.Queue()
    queue.put_nowait("12345678")

    stats = {"saved": 0, "missing": 0, "failed": 0}
    site = make_site()

    with (
        patch.object(
            scraper,
            "scrape_item",
            new_callable=AsyncMock,
            return_value={
                "item_code": "12345678",
                "name": "Example",
            },
        ),
        patch.object(scraper, "save_result") as save_result,
    ):
        await scraper.worker(
            1,
            MagicMock(),
            site,
            queue,
            stats,
            tmp_path,
            1,
        )

    save_result.assert_called_once_with(
        tmp_path,
        "12345678",
        {
            "item_code": "12345678",
            "name": "Example",
        },
    )
    assert stats == {"saved": 1, "missing": 0, "failed": 0}


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_worker_records_missing_item(tmp_path):
    queue = asyncio.Queue()
    queue.put_nowait("12345678")

    stats = {"saved": 0, "missing": 0, "failed": 0}

    with patch.object(
        scraper,
        "scrape_item",
        new_callable=AsyncMock,
        return_value=None,
    ):
        await scraper.worker(
            1,
            MagicMock(),
            make_site(),
            queue,
            stats,
            tmp_path,
            1,
        )

    assert stats == {"saved": 0, "missing": 1, "failed": 0}
    assert (
        tmp_path / "_missing.txt"
    ).read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "12345678\n"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_worker_records_failure_without_saving(tmp_path):
    queue = asyncio.Queue()
    queue.put_nowait("12345678")

    stats = {"saved": 0, "missing": 0, "failed": 0}

    with (
        patch.object(
            scraper,
            "scrape_item",
            new_callable=AsyncMock,
            side_effect=RuntimeError("network error"),
        ),
        patch.object(scraper, "save_result") as save_result,
    ):
        await scraper.worker(
            1,
            MagicMock(),
            make_site(),
            queue,
            stats,
            tmp_path,
            1,
        )

    assert stats == {"saved": 0, "missing": 0, "failed": 1}
    save_result.assert_not_called()
    assert not (tmp_path / "_missing.txt").exists()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_worker_reraises_driver_disconnection(tmp_path):
    queue = asyncio.Queue()
    queue.put_nowait("12345678")

    stats = {"saved": 0, "missing": 0, "failed": 0}

    with patch.object(
        scraper,
        "scrape_item",
        new_callable=AsyncMock,
        side_effect=RuntimeError("Pipe closed by peer"),
    ):
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Pipe closed by peer"):
            await scraper.worker(
                1,
                MagicMock(),
                make_site(),
                queue,
                stats,
                tmp_path,
                1,
            )

    assert stats == {"saved": 0, "missing": 0, "failed": 0}

from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from scrapers.product_pages.type_1 import (
    MARKER,
    _parse_info,
    _parse_nutrients,
    parse,
)


def test_marker():
    assert MARKER == ".productContainer"


def test_parse_returns_none_without_product_container():
    assert parse("<html><body>No product</body></html>") is None


def test_parse_basic_product():
    html = """
    <html>
      <body>
        <img itemprop="image" src="/milk.jpg" alt="Fresh Milk">
        <ul class="productContainer">
          <li>
            <div class="productCode">
              <span class="text">7291234567890</span>
            </div>
            <div class="title"><span class="mainInfo">Brand</span></div>
            <div class="info"><div>Example Brand</div></div>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </body>
    </html>
    """

    result = parse(html)

    assert result["page_code"] == "7291234567890"
    assert result["name"] == "Fresh Milk"
    assert result["images"] == ["/milk.jpg"]
    assert result["sections"] == [
        {"title": "Brand", "content": "Example Brand"}
    ]


def test_parse_missing_optional_fields():
    html = """
    <ul class="productContainer">
      <li>
        <div class="title"><span class="mainInfo">Description</span></div>
        <div class="info">Simple product</div>
      </li>
    </ul>
    """

    result = parse(html)

    assert result["page_code"] is None
    assert result["name"] is None
    assert result["images"] == []
    assert result["sections"] == [
        {"title": "Description", "content": "Simple product"}
    ]
    assert "product_details" not in result


def test_parse_removes_duplicate_images():
    html = """
    <img itemprop="image" src="/milk.jpg" alt="Milk">
    <img itemprop="image" src="/milk.jpg" alt="Milk">
    <ul class="productContainer"></ul>
    """

    result = parse(html)

    assert result["images"] == ["/milk.jpg"]


def test_parse_data_list_fields():
    html = """
    <div class="info">
      <ul class="dataList">
        <li class="box">
          <span class="name">Brand:</span>
          <span class="text">Example</span>
        </li>
        <li class="box">
          <span class="name">Weight:</span>
          <span class="text">500 g</span>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    """

    assert _parse_info(BeautifulSoup(
        html, "html.parser"
    ).select_one(".info")) == {
        "Brand": ["Example"],
        "Weight": ["500 g"],
    }


def test_parse_data_list_preserves_repeated_labels():
    html = """
    <div class="info">
      <ul class="dataList">
        <li class="box">
          <span class="name">Kashrut:</span>
          <span class="text">Certification A</span>
        </li>
        <li class="box">
          <span class="name">Kashrut:</span>
          <span class="text">Certification B</span>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    """

    

    info = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser").select_one(".info")

    assert _parse_info(info) == {
        "Kashrut": ["Certification A", "Certification B"]
    }


def test_parse_markings_are_unique():
    

    html = """
    <div class="info">
      <div class="markingItem"><span class="text">Vegan</span></div>
      <div class="markingItem"><span class="text">Kosher</span></div>
      <div class="markingItem"><span class="text">Vegan</span></div>
    </div>
    """

    info = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser").select_one(".info")

    assert _parse_info(info) == ["Vegan", "Kosher"]


def test_parse_features_list_splits_items():
    

    html = """
    <div class="info">
      <div class="featuresList">Milk, Water<br>Salt</div>
    </div>
    """

    info = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser").select_one(".info")

    assert _parse_info(info) == ["Milk", "Water", "Salt"]




def test_parse_components_text_collapses_whitespace():
    

    html = """
    <div class="info">
      <div class="componentsText">Milk   and
      water</div>
    </div>
    """

    info = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser").select_one(".info")

    assert _parse_info(info) == "Milk and water"

def test_parse_nutrition_section():
    html = """
    <ul class="productContainer">
      <li>
        <div class="title">
          <span class="mainInfo">Nutrition</span>
          <span class="subInfo">Per 100g</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info">
          <div class="nutritionList">
            <div class="nutritionItem">
              <span class="number" title="12"></span>
              <span class="name">g</span>
              <span class="text">Protein</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ul>
    """

    result = parse(html)

    assert result["sections"] == [
        {
            "title": "Nutrition",
            "content": {
                "for": "Per 100g",
                "nutrients": {
                    "Protein": {"value": 12, "unit": "g"}
                },
            },
        }
    ]

def test_parse_nutrients_converts_numeric_values():
    

    html = """
    <div>
      <div class="nutritionItem">
        <span class="number" title="12"></span>
        <span class="name">g</span>
        <span class="text">Protein</span>
      </div>
      <div class="nutritionItem">
        <span class="number" title="2.5"></span>
        <span class="name">g</span>
        <span class="text">Fat</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    """

    info = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

    assert _parse_nutrients(info) == {
        "Protein": {"value": 12, "unit": "g"},
        "Fat": {"value": 2.5, "unit": "g"},
    }


def test_parse_nutrients_skips_incomplete_items():
    

    html = """
    <div>
      <div class="nutritionItem">
        <span class="number" title="12"></span>
        <span class="name">g</span>
      </div>
      <div class="nutritionItem">
        <span class="number" title="5"></span>
        <span class="name">g</span>
        <span class="text">Salt</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    """

    info = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

    assert _parse_nutrients(info) == {
        "Salt": {"value": 5, "unit": "g"}
    }


def test_parse_product_details():
    html = """
    <html>
      <body>
        <div class="productDetails">
          <ul class="productShip">
            <li>Home delivery</li>
            <li>Home delivery</li>
          </ul>
          <ul class="productVariants">
            <li>Small</li>
            <li>Large</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <ul class="productContainer"></ul>
      </body>
    </html>
    """

    result = parse(html)

    assert result["product_details"] == {
        "shipping": ["Home delivery"],
        "variants": ["Small", "Large"],
    }

def test_parse_categories():
    html = """
    <section class="breadcrumbSection">
      <ol itemtype="https://schema.org/BreadcrumbList">
        <li>
          <span itemprop="item">
            <span itemprop="name">Food</span>
          </span>
        </li>
        <li>
          <span itemprop="item">
            <span itemprop="name">Dairy</span>
          </span>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </section>
    <ul class="productContainer"></ul>
    """

    result = parse(html)

    assert result["categories"] == [
        {"1": "Food"},
        {"1": "Dairy"},
    ]

from scrapers.product_pages.type_2 import (
    find_product,
    matches,
    parse,
)


# ============================================================
# find_product
# ============================================================

def test_find_product_returns_matching_product():
    payload = {
        "data": {
            "product": {
                "itemCode": "7291234567890",
                "name": "Fresh Milk",
            }
        }
    }

    assert find_product(payload, "7291234567890") == {
        "itemCode": "7291234567890",
        "name": "Fresh Milk",
    }


def test_find_product_searches_nested_lists():
    payload = {
        "data": [
            {"name": "Bread", "code": "111"},
            {"name": "Milk", "code": "7291234567890"},
        ]
    }

    assert find_product(payload, "7291234567890") == {
        "name": "Milk",
        "code": "7291234567890",
    }


def test_find_product_returns_none_when_code_missing():
    payload = {
        "data": {
            "product": {
                "code": "111",
                "name": "Bread",
            }
        }
    }

    assert find_product(payload, "7291234567890") is None


def test_find_product_accepts_numeric_item_code():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": 7291234567890,
            "name": "Milk",
        }
    }

    assert find_product(payload, "7291234567890") == payload["product"]


def test_find_product_handles_empty_payload():
    assert find_product({}, "123") is None
    assert find_product([], "123") is None
    assert find_product(None, "123") is None


# ============================================================
# matches
# ============================================================

def test_matches_returns_true_for_matching_product():
    payload = {
        "data": {
            "product": {
                "code": "7291234567890",
                "name": "Milk",
            }
        }
    }

    assert matches(payload, "7291234567890") is True


def test_matches_returns_false_for_unrelated_payload():
    payload = {
        "data": {
            "product": {
                "code": "111",
                "name": "Bread",
            }
        }
    }

    assert matches(payload, "7291234567890") is False


# ============================================================
# parse
# ============================================================

def test_parse_basic_product():
    payload = {
        "data": {
            "product": {
                "code": "7291234567890",
                "name": "  Fresh   Milk  ",
                "images": {
                    "main": "/images/milk.jpg",
                },
                "price": 8.90,
            }
        }
    }

    result = parse(
        payload,
        "7291234567890",
        "https://www.example.com/product/7291234567890",
    )

    assert result == {
        "page_code": "7291234567890",
        "name": "Fresh Milk",
        "images": [
            "https://img.example.com/images/milk.jpg",
        ],
        "details": payload["data"]["product"],
    }


def test_parse_returns_none_when_product_not_found():
    payload = {
        "data": {
            "product": {
                "code": "111",
                "name": "Bread",
            }
        }
    }

    assert parse(
        payload,
        "7291234567890",
        "https://www.example.com",
    ) is None


def test_parse_uses_name_keys_in_priority_order():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "title": "Product Title",
            "name": "Product Name",
            "product_name": "Product Name Field",
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://example.com")

    assert result["name"] == "Product Name"


def test_parse_uses_fallback_name_keys():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "title": "Product Title",
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://example.com")

    assert result["name"] == "Product Title"


def test_parse_returns_none_name_when_no_name_key_exists():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "price": 10,
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://example.com")

    assert result["name"] is None


def test_parse_returns_none_name_when_name_is_empty():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "name": "   ",
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://example.com")

    assert result["name"] is None

# Image extraction

def test_parse_nested_images():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "name": "Milk",
            "images": {
                "main": "main.jpg",
                "gallery": [
                    "front.jpg",
                    "back.webp",
                ],
            },
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://example.com/product/123")

    assert result["images"] == [
        "https://example.com/back.webp",
        "https://example.com/front.jpg",
        "https://example.com/main.jpg",
    ]



def test_parse_removes_duplicate_images():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "images": {
                "main": "/images/milk.jpg",
                "gallery": [
                    "/images/milk.jpg",
                    "/images/back.jpg",
                ],
            },
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://example.com")

    assert result["images"] == [
        "https://example.com/images/back.jpg",
        "https://example.com/images/milk.jpg",
    ]


def test_parse_ignores_non_image_values():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "images": {
                "main": "/images/milk.jpg",
                "description": "Fresh milk",
                "id": "12345",
                "other": "/images/document.pdf",
            },
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://example.com")

    assert result["images"] == [
        "https://example.com/images/milk.jpg",
    ]


def test_parse_ignores_images_outside_images_field():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "name": "Milk",
            "banner": "/images/banner.jpg",
            "images": {
                "main": "/images/milk.jpg",
            },
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://example.com")

    assert result["images"] == [
        "https://example.com/images/milk.jpg",
    ]


def test_parse_handles_missing_images():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "name": "Milk",
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://example.com")

    assert result["images"] == []


def test_parse_handles_relative_image_paths():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "images": {
                "main": "images/milk.jpg",
            },
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://www.example.com")

    assert result["images"] == [
        "https://img.example.com/images/milk.jpg",
    ]


def test_parse_case_insensitive_image_extensions():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "name": "Milk",
            "images": [
                "milk.jpg",
                "milk.AVIF",
            ],
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://example.com/product/123")

    assert result["images"] == [
        "https://example.com/milk.AVIF",
        "https://example.com/milk.jpg",
    ]


def test_parse_preserves_full_product_details():
    payload = {
        "product": {
            "code": "123",
            "name": "Milk",
            "price": 8.90,
            "manufacturer": "Example",
            "nutrition": {
                "protein": 3.2,
                "fat": 2.0,
            },
            "unknown_field": ["A", "B"],
        }
    }

    result = parse(payload, "123", "https://example.com")

    assert result["details"] == payload["product"]

import json
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch

import pytest

from scrapers import browser as scraper


@pytest.fixture
def retailer():
    return {
        "chain_id": "test-chain",
        "retailer_id": "test-retailer",
        "name_en_normalized": "test retailer",
        "name_en": "Test Retailer",
        "web_site": "https://example.com/",
        "data_url": "https://example.com/data.js",
    }


@pytest.fixture
def categories():
    return [
        {"id": "100", "name": "Category A"},
        {"id": "200", "name": "Category B"},
    ]


def test_retailer_name_prefers_normalized_name():
    assert scraper.retailer_name({
        "name_en_normalized": "test retailer",
        "name_en": "Test Retailer",
        "name": "Generic Retailer",
    }) == "test retailer"


def test_retailer_name_falls_back_to_name():
    assert scraper.retailer_name({"name": "Generic Retailer"}) == "Generic Retailer"


def test_retailer_name_returns_none_when_missing():
    assert scraper.retailer_name({}) is None


def test_extract_frontend_data():
    expected = {
        "tree": {
            "categories": [
                {"id": "100", "name": "Category A"},
            ]
        }
    }

    with patch.object(
        scraper,
        "extract_js_object",
        return_value=json.dumps(expected),
    ) as extract:
        result = scraper.extract_frontend_data(
            "mock JavaScript containing frontend data"
        )

    extract.assert_called_once_with(
        "mock JavaScript containing frontend data",
        "frontendData",
    )
    assert result == expected


def test_extract_frontend_data_invalid_json():
    with (
        patch.object(scraper, "extract_js_object", return_value="{invalid"),
        pytest.raises(ValueError, match="frontendData is not valid JSON"),
    ):
        scraper.extract_frontend_data("mock JavaScript")


def test_get_categories():
    source_categories = [
        {"id": "1", "name": "Category A"},
        {"id": "2", "name": "Category B"},
    ]

    with patch.object(
        scraper,
        "get_all_categories",
        return_value=source_categories,
    ) as flatten:
        result = scraper.get_categories({
            "tree": {"categories": source_categories}
        })

    flatten.assert_called_once_with(source_categories)
    assert result == source_categories


def test_get_categories_missing_tree():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="tree.categories"):
        scraper.get_categories({})


def test_get_categories_invalid_type():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="not a list"):
        scraper.get_categories({"tree": {"categories": {}}})


def test_save_and_load_categories(retailer, categories, tmp_path):
    with (
        patch.object(scraper, "RAW_DIR", tmp_path),
        patch.object(scraper, "ROOT", tmp_path),
    ):
        path = scraper.save_categories(retailer, categories)

        assert path.exists()

        saved = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        assert saved["categories_count"] == 2
        assert saved["categories"] == categories

        assert scraper.load_saved_categories(retailer) == categories


def test_load_saved_categories_missing_file(retailer, tmp_path):
    with (
        patch.object(scraper, "RAW_DIR", tmp_path),
        patch.object(scraper, "ROOT", tmp_path),
        pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError),
    ):
        scraper.load_saved_categories(retailer)


def test_load_retailers(tmp_path):
    coverage_file = tmp_path / "coverage.json"
    coverage_file.write_text(
        json.dumps({
            "test-chain": {
                "name_en_normalized": "test retailer",
                "available": False,
            }
        }),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    with patch.object(scraper, "COVERAGE_FILE", coverage_file):
        result = scraper.load_retailers()

    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0]["chain_id"] == "test-chain"


def test_load_retailers_rejects_non_dictionary(tmp_path):
    coverage_file = tmp_path / "coverage.json"
    coverage_file.write_text(json.dumps([]), encoding="utf-8")

    with (
        patch.object(scraper, "COVERAGE_FILE", coverage_file),
        pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Expected a dictionary"),
    ):
        scraper.load_retailers()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_scrape_category_saves_all_products(retailer, tmp_path):
    products = [
        {"code": "item-001", "name": "Product A"},
        {"code": "item-002", "name": "Product B"},
    ]

    api_response = MagicMock()
    api_response.status = 200
    api_response.url = (
        "https://example.com/categories/100/products?from=0&size=2"
    )
    api_response.headers = {"content-type": "application/json"}
    api_response.json = AsyncMock(return_value={
        "products": products,
        "total": 2,
    })

    page = AsyncMock()
    page.url = "https://example.com/categories/100/products"
    page.title = AsyncMock(return_value="Category A")
    page.goto = AsyncMock()
    page.wait_for_load_state = AsyncMock()
    page.close = AsyncMock()

    def register_listener(event, callback):
        if event == "response":
            callback(api_response)

    page.on = MagicMock(side_effect=register_listener)

    context = MagicMock()
    context.new_page = AsyncMock(return_value=page)

    with (
        patch.object(scraper, "RAW_DIR", tmp_path),
        patch.object(scraper, "ROOT", tmp_path),
    ):
        result = await scraper.scrape_category(
            context, retailer, "100"
        )

    assert result is True

    output = tmp_path / "test retailer" / "100.json"
    assert output.exists()

    saved = json.loads(output.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert saved["total"] == 2
    assert saved["products"] == products
    assert saved["_metziah"]["chain_id"] == "test-chain"
    assert saved["_metziah"]["category_id"] == "100"
    page.close.assert_awaited_once()

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_scrape_category_skips_empty_category(retailer, tmp_path):
    api_response = MagicMock()
    api_response.status = 200
    api_response.url = "https://example.com/categories/100/products"
    api_response.headers = {"content-type": "application/json"}
    api_response.json = AsyncMock(return_value={
        "products": [],
        "total": 0,
    })

    page = AsyncMock()
    page.url = "https://example.com/categories/100/products"
    page.title = AsyncMock(return_value="Empty Category")
    page.goto = AsyncMock()
    page.wait_for_load_state = AsyncMock()
    page.close = AsyncMock()

    def register_listener(event, callback):
        if event == "response":
            callback(api_response)

    page.on = MagicMock(side_effect=register_listener)

    context = MagicMock()
    context.new_page = AsyncMock(return_value=page)

    with patch.object(scraper, "RAW_DIR", tmp_path):
        result = await scraper.scrape_category(
            context, retailer, "100"
        )

    assert result is False
    assert not (tmp_path / "test retailer" / "100.json").exists()
    page.close.assert_awaited_once()

def test_extract_js_object():
    text = '''
    const config = {
        frontendData: {
            "name": "Store",
            "nested": {"items": [1, 2]},
            "text": "a } inside a string"
        }
    };
    '''

    result = generic.extract_js_object(
        text,
        "frontendData",
    )

    assert json.loads(result) == {
        "name": "Store",
        "nested": {"items": [1, 2]},
        "text": "a } inside a string",
    }


def test_extract_js_object_missing_key():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Could not find missing"):
        generic.extract_js_object(
            "const data = {};",
            "missing",
        )

def test_scrape_category_paginates():
    class FakeResponse:
        def __init__(self, data):
            self.data = data

        def raise_for_status(self):
            pass

        def json(self):
            return self.data

    class FakeClient:
        def __init__(self):
            self.offsets = []

        def get(self, url, params):
            self.offsets.append(params["from"])

            if params["from"] == 0:
                return FakeResponse(
                    {
                        "total": 3,
                        "products": [{"id": 1}, {"id": 2}],
                    }
                )

            return FakeResponse(
                {
                    "total": 3,
                    "products": [{"id": 3}],
                }
            )

    client = FakeClient()
    retailer = {
        "chain_id": "7442",
        "retailer_id": "retailer-1",
        "name_en_normalized": "store_a",
        "scraping_url": (
            "https://example.com/branches/{branch_id}/"
            "categories/{category_id}"
        ),
    }

    result = generic.scrape_category(
        client,
        retailer,
        branch_id="10",
        category_id=20,
    )

    assert client.offsets == [0, 2]
    assert result["total"] == 3
    assert result["products"] == [
        {"id": 1},
        {"id": 2},
        {"id": 3},
    ]
    assert result["_metziah"] == {
        "chain_id": "7442",
        "retailer_id": "retailer-1",
        "branch_id": "10",
        "category_id": 20,
    }

def test_scrape_retailer_saves_category_json(
    monkeypatch,
    tmp_path,
):
    output_dir = tmp_path / "raw"
    monkeypatch.setattr(generic, "OUTPUT_DIR", output_dir)

    frontend_data = {
        "tree": {
            "categories": [
                {"id": 20, "subCategories": [{"id": 21}]},
            ],
        },
        "retailer": {
            "branches": [{"id": 10}],
        },
    }

    class FakeResponse:
        def __init__(self, data=None, text=""):
            self.data = data
            self.text = text

        def raise_for_status(self):
            pass

        def json(self):
            return self.data

    class FakeClient:
        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
            assert kwargs["timeout"] == generic.REQUEST_TIMEOUT
            self.category_calls = []

        def __enter__(self):
            return self

        def __exit__(self, *args):
            pass

        def get(self, url, params=None):
            if url == "https://example.com/frontend":
                return FakeResponse(
                    text=(
                        "frontendData: "
                        + json.dumps(frontend_data)
                    )
                )

            self.category_calls.append(url)

            return FakeResponse(
                {
                    "total": 1,
                    "products": [{"id": 99, "name": "Milk"}],
                }
            )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        generic.httpx,
        "Client",
        FakeClient,
    )

    retailer = {
        "chain_id": "7442",
        "retailer_id": "retailer-1",
        "name_en_normalized": "store_a",
        "data_url": "https://example.com/frontend",
        "scraping_url": (
            "https://example.com/{branch_id}/{category_id}"
        ),
    }

    assert generic.scrape_retailer(retailer) is True

    first_file = output_dir / "store_a" / "20.json"
    second_file = output_dir / "store_a" / "21.json"

    assert first_file.exists()
    assert second_file.exists()

    saved = json.loads(first_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    assert saved["products"] == [
        {"id": 99, "name": "Milk"},
    ]
    assert saved["_metziah"] == {
        "chain_id": "7442",
        "retailer_id": "retailer-1",
        "branch_id": "10",
        "category_id": 20,
    }


def test_scrape_retailer_skips_existing_category(
    monkeypatch,
    tmp_path,
):
    output_dir = tmp_path / "raw"
    monkeypatch.setattr(generic, "OUTPUT_DIR", output_dir)

    retailer_dir = output_dir / "store_a"
    retailer_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    existing_file = retailer_dir / "20.json"
    existing_file.write_text(
        '{"products": [{"id": 1}]}',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    frontend_data = {
        "tree": {"categories": [{"id": 20}]},
        "retailer": {"branches": [{"id": 10}]},
    }

    class FakeResponse:
        text = (
            "frontendData: "
            + json.dumps(frontend_data)
        )

        def raise_for_status(self):
            pass

    class FakeClient:
        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
            pass

        def __enter__(self):
            return self

        def __exit__(self, *args):
            pass

        def get(self, url, params=None):
            assert url == "https://example.com/frontend"
            return FakeResponse()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        generic.httpx,
        "Client",
        FakeClient,
    )

    retailer = {
        "chain_id": "7442",
        "retailer_id": "retailer-1",
        "name_en_normalized": "store_a",
        "data_url": "https://example.com/frontend",
        "scraping_url": "https://example.com/{branch_id}/{category_id}",
    }

    assert generic.scrape_retailer(retailer) is True

    assert json.loads(
        existing_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    ) == {"products": [{"id": 1}]}

def test_get_missing_file_sizes():
    cur = MagicMock()
    cur.fetchall.return_value = [
        (1, "123", "45", "Price", "price.xml"),
        (2, "123", "46", "Promo", "promo.xml"),
    ]

    conn = MagicMock()
    conn.cursor.return_value.__enter__.return_value = cur

    result = populate_file_sizes.get_missing_file_sizes(conn)

    cur.execute.assert_called_once()

    query = cur.execute.call_args.args[0]

    assert "downloaded = TRUE" in query
    assert "file_size IS NULL" in query
    assert "ORDER BY id" in query

    assert result == [
        (1, "123", "45", "Price", "price.xml"),
        (2, "123", "46", "Promo", "promo.xml"),
    ]


def test_update_file_size():
    cur = MagicMock()

    conn = MagicMock()
    conn.cursor.return_value.__enter__.return_value = cur

    populate_file_sizes.update_file_size(
        conn=conn,
        file_tracking_id=123,
        file_size=4567,
    )

    cur.execute.assert_called_once()

    query, params = cur.execute.call_args.args

    assert "UPDATE file_tracking" in query
    assert "SET" in query
    assert "file_size = %s" in query
    assert "updated_at = now()" in query
    assert "WHERE id = %s" in query

    assert params == (4567, 123)


def test_main_updates_existing_files_and_skips_missing(monkeypatch):
    rows = [
        (1, "123", "45", "Price", "exists.xml"),
        (2, "123", "46", "Promo", "missing.xml"),
    ]

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        populate_file_sizes,
        "get_missing_file_sizes",
        lambda conn: rows,
    )

    existing = MagicMock()
    existing.is_file.return_value = True
    existing.stat.return_value.st_size = 1234

    missing = MagicMock()
    missing.is_file.return_value = False

    def get_path(**kwargs):
        if kwargs["filename"] == "exists.xml":
            return existing
        return missing

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        populate_file_sizes,
        "get_file_path",
        get_path,
    )

    update_file_size = MagicMock()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        populate_file_sizes,
        "update_file_size",
        update_file_size,
    )

    cur = MagicMock()
    cur.fetchone.return_value = (True,)

    conn = MagicMock()
    conn.__enter__.return_value = conn
    conn.cursor.return_value.__enter__.return_value = cur

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        populate_file_sizes,
        "get_connection",
        lambda: conn,
    )

    result = populate_file_sizes.main()

    assert result is None

    update_file_size.assert_called_once_with(
        conn=conn,
        file_tracking_id=1,
        file_size=1234,
    )

    conn.commit.assert_called_once()

    execute_calls = [
        call.args
        for call in cur.execute.call_args_list
    ]

    assert (
        "SELECT pg_try_advisory_lock(%s)",
        (populate_file_sizes.FILE_SIZE_LOCK_ID,),
    ) in execute_calls

    assert (
        "SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(%s)",
        (populate_file_sizes.FILE_SIZE_LOCK_ID,),
    ) in execute_calls


def test_main_skips_when_lock_unavailable(monkeypatch):
    get_missing = MagicMock()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        populate_file_sizes,
        "get_missing_file_sizes",
        get_missing,
    )

    cur = MagicMock()
    cur.fetchone.return_value = (False,)

    conn = MagicMock()
    conn.__enter__.return_value = conn
    conn.cursor.return_value.__enter__.return_value = cur

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        populate_file_sizes,
        "get_connection",
        lambda: conn,
    )

    result = populate_file_sizes.main()

    assert result == 0

    get_missing.assert_not_called()
    conn.commit.assert_not_called()

    cur.execute.assert_called_once_with(
        "SELECT pg_try_advisory_lock(%s)",
        (populate_file_sizes.FILE_SIZE_LOCK_ID,),
    )


def test_main_unlocks_when_processing_fails(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        populate_file_sizes,
        "get_missing_file_sizes",
        MagicMock(side_effect=RuntimeError("boom")),
    )

    cur = MagicMock()
    cur.fetchone.return_value = (True,)

    conn = MagicMock()
    conn.__enter__.return_value = conn
    conn.cursor.return_value.__enter__.return_value = cur

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        populate_file_sizes,
        "get_connection",
        lambda: conn,
    )

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="boom"):
        populate_file_sizes.main()

    execute_calls = [
        call.args
        for call in cur.execute.call_args_list
    ]

    assert (
        "SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(%s)",
        (populate_file_sizes.FILE_SIZE_LOCK_ID,),
    ) in execute_calls

import json

import pytest

from clients.html_client import Candidate
from utils.file_tracking import cache


def test_html_cache_path():
    result = cache._html_cache_path("shufersal")

    assert result == cache.CACHE_DIR / "shufersal.json"


def test_save_html_cache(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(cache, "CACHE_DIR", tmp_path)

    candidates = [
        Candidate(
            text="PriceFull file",
            href="https://example.com/file.xml",
            filename="PriceFull123.xml",
            file_size=1234,
        ),
        Candidate(
            text="Price file",
            href="https://example.com/file2.xml",
            filename="Price123.xml",
            file_size=5678,
        ),
        Candidate(
            text="Missing filename",
            href="https://example.com/file3.xml",
            filename=None,
            file_size=100,
        ),
    ]

    cache._save_html_cache("test_source", candidates)

    cache_path = tmp_path / "test_source.json"

    assert cache_path.is_file()

    with cache_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as file:
        saved = json.load(file)

    assert saved == {
        "files": [
            {
                "text": "PriceFull file",
                "url": "https://example.com/file.xml",
                "filename": "PriceFull123.xml",
                "file_size": 1234,
            },
            {
                "text": "Price file",
                "url": "https://example.com/file2.xml",
                "filename": "Price123.xml",
                "file_size": 5678,
            },
        ]
    }


def test_load_html_cache_returns_files(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(cache, "CACHE_DIR", tmp_path)

    cache_path = tmp_path / "test_source.json"

    data = {
        "files": [
            {
                "text": "Price file",
                "url": "https://example.com/file.xml",
                "filename": "Price.xml",
                "file_size": 123,
            }
        ]
    }

    with cache_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
        json.dump(data, file)

    result = cache.load_html_cache("test_source")

    assert result == data["files"]

    result = cache.load_html_cache("does_not_exist")

    assert result == []

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_fetch_and_cache_source(monkeypatch):
    candidates = [
        Candidate(
            text="Price file",
            href="https://example.com/file.xml",
            filename="Price.xml",
            file_size=123,
        )
    ]

    class FakeClient:
        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
            self.kwargs = kwargs

    async def fake_get_all_html_candidates(client, listing):
        assert client.kwargs["name"] == "test_source"
        assert client.kwargs["base_url"] == "https://example.com"
        assert listing == {
            "base_url": "https://example.com",
            "page": 1,
        }

        return candidates

    saved = {}

    def fake_save_html_cache(source_name, candidates_arg):
        saved["source_name"] = source_name
        saved["candidates"] = candidates_arg

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        cache,

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_refresh_html_caches_handles_source_failure(monkeypatch):

        if source["name"] == "broken":
            raise RuntimeError("boom")

        return source["name"], []

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        cache,
        "_fetch_and_cache_source",
        fake_fetch,
    )

        {
            "name": "broken",
        },
        {
            "name": "working",
        },
    ]

        {"filename": "c.xml"},
    ]

    statuses = iter([True, False, True])

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        load_file_tracking,

        lambda record: next(statuses),
    )

    load_file_tracking._set_downloaded_status(records)

    assert records == [
        {"filename": "a.xml", "downloaded": True},
        {"filename": "b.xml", "downloaded": False},

    ]

def test_generate_report(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        load_file_tracking,
        "REPORTS_DIR",
        tmp_path,
    )

    records = [
        {
            "filename": "Price123.xml",
            "source": "test",
            "file_type": "Price",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "sub_chain_id": "001",
            "store_id": "41",
            "file_date": "2026-09-24",
            "file_size": 100,
            "downloaded": True,
        },
        {
            "filename": "Promo123.xml",
            "source": "test",
            "file_type": "Promo",
            "chain_id": "123",
            "sub_chain_id": "001",
            "store_id": "41",
            "file_date": "2026-09-24",
            "file_size": None,
            "downloaded": False,
        },
    ]

    report_path = load_file_tracking.generate_report(records)

    assert report_path == (
        tmp_path / "file_tracking.csv"
    )
    assert report_path.exists()

    with report_path.open(
        encoding="utf-8-sig",
        newline="",
    ) as file:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(file))

    assert len(rows) == 2
    assert rows[0]["filename"] == "Price123.xml"
    assert rows[0]["downloaded"] == "True"
    assert rows[1]["filename"] == "Promo123.xml"

def test_normalize_uses_loose_fallback_only_in_report_mode(monkeypatch):
    filename = "PriceFull7290661400001_018_20261021_extra.xml"

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        load_file_tracking,
        "_REPORT_MODE",

    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(

        "normalize_file",

    )

    assert load_file_tracking._normalize(filename) is None

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        load_file_tracking,
        "_REPORT_MODE",
        True,

import json
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from utils.file_tracking.parser_file_tracking import (
    FEEDS_DIR,
    extract_time_suffix,
    get_local_path,
    normalize_file,
    parse_filename,
)

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]

PATTERNS_FILE = (
    BASE_DIR
    / "monitoring"
    / "data"
    / "filename_patterns.json"
)


def load_filename_examples():
    with PATTERNS_FILE.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    examples = []

    for structure in data["structures"]:
        examples.extend(structure["examples"])

    return examples


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "filename",
    load_filename_examples(),
)
def test_parse_real_filename_examples(filename):
    result = parse_filename(filename)

    assert result["filename"] == filename
    assert result["chain_id"].isdigit()
    assert len(result["chain_id"]) == 13
    assert result["file_type"] in {
        "Price",
        "PriceFull",
        "Promo",
        "PromoFull",
        "Stores",
    }
    assert result["file_date"] is not None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "filename",
    [
        "invalid.xml",
        "Price-7290058140886-001-001-20260924-070011.gz",
        "Price7290058140886-20260924.gz",
        "Price7290058140886-001-001-20261301-070011.gz",
        "Unknown7290058140886-001-001-20260924-070011.gz",
        "Price123-001-001-20260924-070011.gz",
    ],
)
def test_parse_filename_invalid(filename):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_filename(filename)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "file_type, directory",
    [
        ("Price", "prices"),
        ("PriceFull", "pricesfull"),
        ("Promo", "promos"),
        ("PromoFull", "promosfull"),
    ],
)
def test_get_local_path(file_type, directory):
    filename = (
        f"{file_type}7290058140886-001-001-20260924-070011.gz"
    )

    record = parse_filename(filename)

    assert get_local_path(record) == (
        FEEDS_DIR
        / "7290058140886"
        / "001"
        / directory
        / filename
    )


def test_get_local_path_stores():
    filename = "StoresFull7290058140886-20260924-070011.gz"

    record = parse_filename(filename)

    assert get_local_path(record) == (
        FEEDS_DIR
        / "7290058140886"
        / "stores"
        / filename
    )


def test_normalize_file_invalid_filename():
    assert normalize_file("invalid.xml") is None


def test_normalize_file_old_date():
    filename = "Price7290058140886-001-001-20260923-070011.gz"

    assert normalize_file(filename, file_size=123) is None


def test_normalize_file_today(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    today = date.today().strftime("%Y%m%d")

    filename = (
        f"Price7290058140886-001-001-{today}-070011.gz"
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "utils.file_tracking.parser_file_tracking.FEEDS_DIR",

    )

    file_path = (
        tmp_path
        / "7290058140886"
        / "001"
        / "prices"
        / filename
    )

    file_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    file_path.touch()

    result = normalize_file(filename, file_size=123)

    assert result["file_size"] == 123
    assert result["downloaded"] is True

from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, Mock

import pytest

import utils.prices.load_prices as module


CHAIN_ID = "7290000000001"
SUB_CHAIN_ID = "1"
STORE_ID = "42"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def make_pricefull(
    tmp_path,
    filename,
    chain_id=CHAIN_ID,
    store_id=STORE_ID,
):
    path = (
        tmp_path
        / chain_id
        / store_id
        / "pricesfull"
        / filename
    )
    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )
    path.touch()
    return path


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# find_pricefull_files
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_find_pricefull_files_returns_latest_per_chain_subchain_store(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
):
    old = make_pricefull(tmp_path, "old.xml")
    new = make_pricefull(tmp_path, "new.xml")

    parse_results = {
        "old.xml": {
            "file_type": "PriceFull",
            "chain_id": CHAIN_ID,
            "sub_chain_id": SUB_CHAIN_ID,
            "store_id": STORE_ID,
            "file_date": "2026-09-23",
        },
        "new.xml": {
            "file_type": "PriceFull",
            "chain_id": CHAIN_ID,
            "sub_chain_id": SUB_CHAIN_ID,
            "store_id": STORE_ID,
            "file_date": "2026-09-24",
        },
    }

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "parse_filename",
        lambda filename: parse_results[filename],
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "extract_time_suffix",
        lambda filename: "120000",
    )

    result = list(
        module.find_pricefull_files(tmp_path)
    )

    assert result == [
        (new, "PriceFull", True),
    ]

# tests/utils/prices/test_update_prices.py

from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, Mock

import pytest

import utils.prices.update_prices as module
from database.records import PriceRecord


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CHAIN_ID = "7290000000001"
STORE_ID = "1"


def make_price_record(
    chain_id=CHAIN_ID,
    store_id=STORE_ID,
    item_code="123",
    price=Decimal("10.00"),
    unit_price=Decimal("10.00"),
    quantity=Decimal("1"),
    unit_qty="1",
    unit_measure="unit",
    weighted=False,
    package_quantity=None,
    allow_discount=True,
    status=None,
    price_update_time=None,
    last_sale_datetime=None,
):
    return PriceRecord(
        chain_id=chain_id,
        store_id=store_id,
        item_code=item_code,
        price=price,
        unit_price=unit_price,
        quantity=quantity,
        unit_qty=unit_qty,
        unit_measure=unit_measure,
        weighted=weighted,
        package_quantity=package_quantity,
        allow_discount=allow_discount,
        status=status,
        price_update_time=price_update_time,
        last_sale_datetime=last_sale_datetime,
    )


def make_path(tmp_path, file_type="Price"):
    feeds_dir = tmp_path / "feeds"

    directory = (
        feeds_dir
        / CHAIN_ID
        / STORE_ID
        / (
            "pricesfull"
            if file_type == "PriceFull"
            else "prices"
        )
    )

    directory.mkdir(parents=True)

    filepath = (
        directory
        / f"{file_type}{CHAIN_ID}-001-20260924.xml"
    )

    return feeds_dir, filepath


def patch_common(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "ensure_chain",
        Mock(),
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "update_store_subchain",
        Mock(),
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "parse_filename",
        Mock(
            return_value={
                "chain_id": CHAIN_ID,
                "sub_chain_id": "001",
            }
        ),
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# _dedupe_price_records
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_dedupe_keeps_unique_records():
    records = [
        make_price_record(item_code="1"),
        make_price_record(item_code="2"),
    ]

    result = module._dedupe_price_records(records)

    assert len(result) == 2
    assert {record.item_code for record in result} == {
        "1",
        "2",
    }


def test_dedupe_latest_timestamp_wins():
    older = make_price_record(
        item_code="1",
        price=Decimal("10.00"),
        price_update_time=datetime(
            2026, 9, 24, 10, 0
        ),
    )

    newer = make_price_record(
        item_code="1",
        price=Decimal("20.00"),
        price_update_time=datetime(
            2026, 9, 24, 11, 0
        ),
    )

    result = module._dedupe_price_records(
        [older, newer]
    )

    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].price == Decimal("20.00")


def test_dedupe_older_timestamp_does_not_replace_newer():
    newer = make_price_record(
        item_code="1",
        price=Decimal("20.00"),
        price_update_time=datetime(
            2026, 9, 24, 11, 0
        ),
    )

    older = make_price_record(
        item_code="1",
        price=Decimal("10.00"),
        price_update_time=datetime(
            2026, 9, 24, 10, 0
        ),
    )

    result = module._dedupe_price_records(
        [newer, older]
    )

    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].price == Decimal("20.00")


def test_dedupe_timestamped_record_replaces_none():
    without_timestamp = make_price_record(
        item_code="1",
        price=Decimal("10.00"),
        price_update_time=None,
    )

    timestamped = make_price_record(
        item_code="1",
        price=Decimal("20.00"),
        price_update_time=datetime(
            2026, 9, 24, 10, 0
        ),
    )

    result = module._dedupe_price_records(
        [without_timestamp, timestamped]
    )

    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].price == Decimal("20.00")


def test_dedupe_none_timestamp_does_not_replace_timestamped():
    timestamped = make_price_record(
        item_code="1",
        price=Decimal("10.00"),
        price_update_time=datetime(
            2026, 9, 24, 10, 0
        ),
    )

    without_timestamp = make_price_record(
        item_code="1",
        price=Decimal("20.00"),
        price_update_time=None,
    )

    result = module._dedupe_price_records(
        [timestamped, without_timestamp]
    )

    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].price == Decimal("10.00")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# _fetch_existing_prices
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_fetch_existing_prices():
    conn = MagicMock()

    cursor = MagicMock()
    cursor.fetchall.return_value = [
        ("ITEM-1", Decimal("10.00"), Decimal("20.00")),
        ("ITEM-2", Decimal("5.50"), Decimal("11.00")),
    ]

    conn.cursor.return_value.__enter__.return_value = cursor

    result = module._fetch_existing_prices(
        conn,
        CHAIN_ID,
        STORE_ID,
    )

    assert result == {
        "ITEM-1": (Decimal("10.00"), Decimal("20.00")),
        "ITEM-2": (Decimal("5.50"), Decimal("11.00")),
    }

    cursor.execute.assert_called_once()

    query, params = cursor.execute.call_args.args

    assert "SELECT" in query
    assert "item_code" in query
    assert "price" in query
    assert "unit_price" in query
    assert "FROM prices" in query
    assert "chain_id = %s" in query
    assert "store_id = %s" in query
    assert params == (CHAIN_ID, STORE_ID)

def test_log_price_changes_logs_added(monkeypatch):
    logger = Mock()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "change_logger",
        logger,
    )

    record = make_price_record(
        item_code="ITEM-1",
        price=Decimal("10.00"),
    )

    module._log_price_changes(
        CHAIN_ID,
        STORE_ID,
        [record],
        {},
        {"ITEM-1": "Milk"},
    )

    logger.info.assert_called_once()

    args = logger.info.call_args.args

    assert args[0] == (
        "PRICE ADDED "
        "chain_id=%s "
        "store_id=%s "
        "item_code=%s "
        "name=%s "
        "price=%s"
    )

    assert args[1:] == (
        CHAIN_ID,
        STORE_ID,
        "ITEM-1",
        "Milk",
        Decimal("10.00"),
    )

def test_load_one_file_empty_document_returns_false(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
):
    conn = Mock()

    feeds_dir, filepath = make_path(
        tmp_path,
        "Price",
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "iter_xml_from_path",
        lambda _: [b"<xml/>"],
    )

    parser = Mock()
    parser.parse_price_file.return_value = []

    result = module.load_one_file(
        conn=conn,
        parser=parser,
        filepath=filepath,

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deduplication inside load_one_file
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_duplicate_item_codes_are_deduped_before_upsert(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
):
    conn = Mock()

    feeds_dir, filepath = make_path(
        tmp_path,
        "Price",
    )

    product_1 = SimpleNamespace(
        chain_id=CHAIN_ID,
        store_id=STORE_ID,
    )

    product_2 = SimpleNamespace(
        chain_id=CHAIN_ID,
        store_id=STORE_ID,
    )

    record_1 = make_price_record(
        item_code="ITEM-1",
        price=Decimal("10.00"),
        price_update_time=datetime(
            2026, 9, 24, 10, 0
        ),
    )

    record_2 = make_price_record(
        item_code="ITEM-1",
        price=Decimal("20.00"),
        price_update_time=datetime(
            2026, 9, 24, 11, 0
        ),
    )

    parser = Mock()
    parser.parse_price_file.return_value = [
        product_1,
        product_2,
    ]

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "iter_xml_from_path",
        lambda _: [b"<xml/>"],
    )

    patch_common(monkeypatch)

    records = iter([
        record_1,
        record_2,
    ])

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "split_product",
        lambda *args: (
            None,
            None,
            next(records),
        ),
    )

    upsert = Mock()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "upsert_prices",
        upsert,
    )

    result = module.load_one_file(
        conn=conn,
        parser=parser,
        filepath=filepath,
        feeds_dir=feeds_dir,
        chain_metadata={
            CHAIN_ID: {
                "name_he_normalized": "Test",
                "name_en_normalized": "Test",
            }
        },
        file_type="Price",
        snapshot=False,
        log_changes=False,
    )

    assert result is True

    upsert.assert_called_once()

    upsert_records = upsert.call_args.args[1]

    assert len(upsert_records) == 1
    assert upsert_records[0].item_code == "ITEM-1"
    assert upsert_records[0].price == Decimal("20.00")

    )

        [product_1],

    ]

    monkeypatch.setattr(

        make_price_record(item_code="ITEM-1"),
        make_price_record(item_code="ITEM-2"),
    ])

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "split_product",
        lambda *args: (
            None,
            None,
            next(records),
        ),
    )

    upsert = Mock()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "upsert_prices",
        upsert,
    )

    result = module.load_one_file(
        conn=conn,
        parser=parser,
        filepath=filepath,
        feeds_dir=feeds_dir,
        chain_metadata={
            CHAIN_ID: {
                "name_he_normalized": "Test",

            }
        },
        file_type="Price",
        snapshot=False,
        log_changes=False,
    )

    assert result is True

    assert parser.parse_price_file.call_count == 2

def test_load_files_marks_successfully_loaded_file(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
):
    conn = Mock()

    filepath = tmp_path / "Price.xml"

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "_load_chain_metadata",
        lambda: {},
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "load_one_file",
        Mock(return_value=True),
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "mark_files_loaded",
        Mock(),
    )

    result = module.load_files(
        conn,

        log_changes=False,
    )

    assert result == [filepath]

    module.load_one_file.assert_called_once_with(
        conn,

        filepath,
        tmp_path,
        {},
        "Price",
        snapshot=False,
        log_changes=False,
    )

    module.mark_files_loaded.assert_called_once_with(
        conn,
        ["Price.xml"],
    )

    conn.commit.assert_called_once()

    monkeypatch.setattr(

    )

    load_one_file = Mock(
        side_effect=[

            True,
        ]
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(

        load_one_file,
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module,
        "mark_files_loaded",
        Mock(),
    )

    result = module.load_files(
        conn,

        ],
        tmp_path,

    )

    assert load_one_file.call_count == 2
    assert conn.rollback.call_count == 1

import pytest

from utils.processing.delete_suspicious_products import (
    DELETE_SEVERITIES,
    determine_severity,
    is_placeholder_name,
    normalize,
)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("value", "expected"),
    [
        (None, None),
        ("", None),
        ("   ", None),
        (" Milk ", "Milk"),
        (123, "123"),
    ],
)
def test_normalize(value, expected):
    assert normalize(value) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "name",
    [
        "לא ידוע",
        "לא ידוע.",
        "UNKNOWN",
        "unk",
        "n/a",
        "NA",
        "none",
        "null",
        "לא זמין",
        "ללא שם",
    ],
)
def test_is_placeholder_name(name):
    assert is_placeholder_name(name)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "name",
    [None, "", "Milk", "123", "Unknown product"],
)
def test_is_not_placeholder_name(name):
    assert not is_placeholder_name(name)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("conditions", "expected"),
    [
        (
            {
                "appear_once": True,
                "zero_price": True,
                "missing_name": True,
            },
            "delete",
        ),
        (
            {
                "appear_once": True,
                "zero_price": True,
                "missing_name": False,
            },
            "ultra_high",
        ),
        (
            {
                "all_prices_zero": True,
                "appear_once": False,
            },
            "very_high",
        ),
        (
            {
                "appear_once": True,
                "missing_name": True,
            },
            "high",
        ),
        (
            {"placeholder_name": True},
            "high",
        ),
        (
            {"missing_name": True},
            "medium",
        ),
        (
            {"only_null_prices": True},
            "medium",
        ),
        (
            {"short_name": True},
            "medium",
        ),
        (
            {"numeric_only_name": True},
            "medium",
        ),
        (
            {"completely_unused": True},
            "medium",
        ),
        ({}, None),
    ],
)
def test_determine_severity(conditions, expected):
    defaults = {
        "appear_once": False,
        "zero_price": False,
        "all_prices_zero": False,
        "missing_name": False,
        "placeholder_name": False,
        "completely_unused": False,
        "only_null_prices": False,
        "short_name": False,
        "numeric_only_name": False,
    }
    defaults.update(conditions)

    assert determine_severity(**defaults) == expected


def test_only_delete_and_ultra_high_are_deletion_severities():
    assert DELETE_SEVERITIES == {"delete", "ultra_high"}

import io
import json
from unittest.mock import Mock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, Mock
import httpx
import pytest
from PIL import Image

from utils.processing import download_img as downloader


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

def make_image_bytes(image_format="JPEG"):
    image = Image.effect_noise((100, 100), 100).convert("RGB")

    output = io.BytesIO()
    image.save(output, format=image_format)

    return output.getvalue()


def make_response(
    content=b"",
    status_code=200,
):
    return httpx.Response(
        status_code=status_code,
        content=content,
        request=httpx.Request(
            "GET",
            "https://example.com/image.jpg",
        ),
    )


def read_image(path):
    with Image.open(path) as image:
        image.load()
        return image


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# record_item_code
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("record", "expected"),
    [
        ({"item_code": "123"}, "123"),
        ({"barcode": "456"}, "456"),
        ({"ean": "789"}, "789"),
        ({"gtin": "111"}, "111"),
        ({"itemCode": "222"}, "222"),
        (
            {
                "item_code": None,
                "barcode": "456",
            },
            "456",
        ),
        (
            {
                "item_code": " ",
                "barcode": "456",
            },
            "456",
        ),
        ({"item_code": " 123 "}, "123"),
        ({}, None),
    ],
)
def test_record_item_code(record, expected):
    assert downloader.record_item_code(record) == expected


def test_record_item_code_respects_key_priority():
    record = {
        "item_code": "111",
        "barcode": "222",
        "ean": "333",
    }

    assert downloader.record_item_code(record) == "111"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# image_urls
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_image_urls_extracts_supported_fields():
    record = {
        "main_image_url": " https://example.com/1.jpg ",
        "image_url": "https://example.com/2.jpg",
        "image": {
            "url": "https://example.com/3.jpg",
        },
        "images": [
            "https://example.com/4.jpg",
            {
                "url": "https://example.com/5.jpg",
            },
        ],
    }

    assert downloader.image_urls(record) == [
        "https://example.com/1.jpg",
        "https://example.com/2.jpg",
        "https://example.com/3.jpg",
        "https://example.com/4.jpg",
        "https://example.com/5.jpg",
    ]


def test_image_urls_removes_duplicates():
    record = {
        "main_image_url": "https://example.com/1.jpg",
        "image_url": "https://example.com/1.jpg",
        "images": [
            "https://example.com/1.jpg",
            "https://example.com/2.jpg",
        ],
    }

    assert downloader.image_urls(record) == [
        "https://example.com/1.jpg",
        "https://example.com/2.jpg",
    ]


def test_image_urls_ignores_invalid_values():
    record = {
        "main_image_url": None,
        "image_url": 123,
        "image": {},
        "images": [
            None,
            123,
            {},
            {"url": ""},
            {"url": 123},
            " ",
        ],
    }

    assert downloader.image_urls(record) == []


def test_image_urls_handles_missing_fields():
    assert downloader.image_urls({}) == []


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# iter_parsed_records
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_iter_parsed_records_reads_jsonl_files(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
):
    parsed_dir = tmp_path / "parsed"

    company_a = parsed_dir / "company_a"
    company_b = parsed_dir / "company_b"

    company_a.mkdir(parents=True)
    company_b.mkdir(parents=True)

    file_a = company_a / "products.jsonl"
    file_b = company_b / "products.jsonl"

    file_a.write_text(
        '\n'
        '{"barcode": "111"}\n'
        '{"barcode": "222"}\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    file_b.write_text(
        '{"barcode": "333"}\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        downloader,
        "PARSED_DIR",
        parsed_dir,
    )

    records = list(downloader.iter_parsed_records())

    assert [record["barcode"] for _, record in records] == [
        "111",
        "222",
        "333",
    ]


def test_iter_parsed_records_skips_invalid_lines(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
):
    parsed_dir = tmp_path / "parsed"
    parsed_dir.mkdir()

    file = parsed_dir / "products.jsonl"

    file.write_text(
        '{"barcode": "111"}\n'
        'invalid json\n'
        '\n'
        '["not", "a", "dict"]\n'
        '{"barcode": "222"}\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        downloader,
        "PARSED_DIR",
        parsed_dir,
    )

    records = list(downloader.iter_parsed_records())

    assert [record["barcode"] for _, record in records] == [
        "111",

    ]

def test_collect_image_candidates_aggregates_across_sources(
    monkeypatch,
):
    records = [
        (
            None,
            {
                "barcode": "111",
                "image_url": "https://example.com/1.jpg",
            },
        ),
        (
            None,
            {
                "item_code": "111",
                "images": [
                    "https://example.com/2.jpg",
                    "https://example.com/1.jpg",
                ],
            },
        ),
        (
            None,
            {
                "barcode": "222",
                "image_url": "https://example.com/3.jpg",
            },
        ),
    ]

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        downloader,
        "iter_parsed_records",
        lambda: iter(records),
    )

    result = downloader.collect_image_candidates(
        {"111", "333"},
    )

    assert result == {
        "111": [
            "https://example.com/1.jpg",
            "https://example.com/2.jpg",
        ],
        "333": [],
    }


def test_collect_image_candidates_returns_empty_lists_for_missing_codes(

    )

        {"111", "222"},
    ) == {
        "111": [],
        "222": [],
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# expand_url_template
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_expand_url_template_without_template():
    url = "https://example.com/image.jpg"

    assert downloader.expand_url_template(url) == [url]


def test_expand_url_template_expands_size_and_extension():
    result = downloader.expand_url_template(
        "https://example.com/image_{{size}}.{{extension}}"
    )

    assert len(result) == (
        len(downloader.TEMPLATE_SIZES)
        * len(downloader.TEMPLATE_EXTENSIONS)
    )

    assert result[0] == (
        "https://example.com/image_large.jpg"
    )

    assert result[-1] == (
        "https://example.com/image_original.webp"
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "template",
    [
        "{{extension}}",
        "{{ extension }}",
        "{{extension || 'jpg'}}",
        "{{ extension || 'png' }}",
    ],
)
def test_expand_url_template_supports_extension_variants(template):
    result = downloader.expand_url_template(
        f"https://example.com/image.{template}"
    )

    assert result
    assert all("{{" not in url for url in result)
    assert all("}}" not in url for url in result)


def test_expand_url_template_does_not_return_unresolved_templates():
    result = downloader.expand_url_template(
        "https://example.com/{{unknown}}.jpg"
    )

    assert result == []

    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# image_bytes_to_jpeg
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_image_bytes_to_jpeg_converts_jpeg():
    data = make_image_bytes("JPEG")

    result = downloader.image_bytes_to_jpeg(data)

    assert result is not None

    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(result)) as image:
        assert image.format == "JPEG"
        assert image.mode == "RGB"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "image_format",
    ["PNG", "WEBP"],
)
def test_image_bytes_to_jpeg_converts_other_formats(image_format):
    data = make_image_bytes(image_format)

    result = downloader.image_bytes_to_jpeg(data)

    assert result is not None

    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(result)) as image:
        assert image.format == "JPEG"
        assert image.mode == "RGB"


def test_image_bytes_to_jpeg_rejects_small_files():
    assert downloader.image_bytes_to_jpeg(b"small") is None


def test_image_bytes_to_jpeg_rejects_invalid_data():
    data = b"x" * downloader.MIN_IMAGE_BYTES

    assert downloader.image_bytes_to_jpeg(data) is None


def test_image_bytes_to_jpeg_rejects_tiny_dimensions():
    output = io.BytesIO()

    Image.new("RGB", (1, 1)).save(
        output,
        format="JPEG",
    )

    # Pad the data to pass the minimum byte check.
    data = output.getvalue() + b" " * downloader.MIN_IMAGE_BYTES

    assert downloader.image_bytes_to_jpeg(data) is None


def test_image_bytes_to_jpeg_handles_transparency():
    image = Image.effect_noise((100, 100), 100).convert("RGBA")

    # Make the center pixel fully transparent.
    image.putpixel((50, 50), (255, 0, 0, 0))

    output = io.BytesIO()
    image.save(output, format="PNG")

    result = downloader.image_bytes_to_jpeg(output.getvalue())

    assert result is not None

    converted = Image.open(io.BytesIO(result)).convert("RGB")

    # Transparent pixels should become white.
    assert converted.getpixel((50, 50)) == (255, 255, 255)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# load_database_item_codes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_load_database_item_codes(monkeypatch):
    from contextlib import contextmanager

    cursor_context = MagicMock()
    cursor = cursor_context.__enter__.return_value

    cursor.fetchall.return_value = [
        ("123",),
        ("456",),
        (None,),
        (" 789 ",),
    ]

    @contextmanager
    def fake_connection():
        class Connection:
            def cursor(self):
                return cursor_context

        yield Connection()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "db.get_connection",
        fake_connection,
    )

    result = downloader.load_database_item_codes()

    assert result == {
        "123",
        "456",
        "789",
    }

    cursor.execute.assert_called_once()

    query = cursor.execute.call_args.args[0]

    assert "FROM products AS p" in query
    assert "INNER JOIN product_enrichment AS pe" in query
    assert "p.item_code IS NOT NULL" in query
